project.name: g6
project.description: Open-source harness engineering for AI agents: checks, gates and honest labels for what an agent's work has shown.

nodes.name: AGENT_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Guide written for AI coding agents that use G6 over MCP or from Python: the find, describe, invoke discovery flow, rules for reporting the three result labels without ever upgrading them, the five MCP-callable components, the stop switch, meta-harness limits and model provider settings.

nodes.name: NOTICE
nodes.summary: Apache-2.0 attribution notice naming the copyright holder and reserving a list for third-party material bundled with the distribution.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for G6: what the three result labels mean and why they never rise, install and use from MCP, the command line and Python, the component catalogue grouped by area, the harness, bundles, meta-harness and stop switch, and a status table of each capability against its validation studies.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index of the four offline demonstration scripts, describing what each one shows (persistent state, evidence-based revision, governed harness change, agent discovery) and stating what the demos do not prove.

nodes.name: demo_1_persistent_state.py
nodes.summary: Demonstration that the harness remembers a failed check across separate Python processes sharing one G6_HOME state folder, refusing a later standard that dropped the check, with a control run on an empty folder to show the memory caused the difference.

nodes.name: demo_2_evidence_revision.py
nodes.summary: Demonstration of claim checking through the same invoke reply an MCP client receives: unbacked sentences are blocked-escalated, supplying the right source yields a qualified-draft, and a source with a different figure is reported as a conflict.

nodes.name: demo_3_governed_change.py
nodes.summary: Demonstration of a governed harness change: builds a small git project, diagnoses a failing reply template, verifies a bad and a good template edit in separate git worktrees against the project tests and a held-out suite, and promotes or rolls back each one through govern_patch_promotion bound to the exact diff.

nodes.name: demo_4_agent_discovery.py
nodes.summary: Scripted walk through the calls a coding agent makes to discover and compose G6 components for checking a customer email: ranks components for a plain-words need, checks the email claims against sources, then runs the action gate until a verification plan and coordination context are supplied, and reports the weakest label.

nodes.name: build_bundles.py
nodes.summary: Build script that writes a small launcher per bundle and runs PyInstaller to produce one double-clickable executable per bundle, named by bundle id, operating system and machine architecture.

nodes.name: smoke_bundle.py
nodes.summary: Smoke check for a built bundle executable: launches it, waits for its local address, runs one offline sample task through the token-protected page API, asserts an honest completion label, and confirms that a request without the token is refused with 403.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Hatchling build configuration for the g6 package: Python 3.12 to 3.13, a tiny core dependency set with optional groups (mcp, abstraction, anthropic, formal, lora, site, dev), the g6 and g6-mcp console scripts, pytest and ruff settings, and import-linter contracts that keep core free of component imports and keep the meta-harness a top layer.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level package marker for the g6 library, documenting that every sub-package depends only on g6.core and holding the package version that the build reads.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the abstraction component that re-exports the combinator classes, gate, replay, CEGAR, library, lift, MDL, robustness and diagnostics APIs, and declares component metadata (beta maturity, Python API only, no MCP block).

nodes.name: abstractions.py
nodes.summary: Defines abstractions as first-class objects: an incremental base class and four combinators (Quotient similarity balls, Project binning, Sufficient per-arm statistics, Product conjunction) with covers, bound, prune, refine and spec operations, plus from_spec, which validates untrusted JSON specs against hard resource limits before construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Quotient uses numpy-vectorised neighbourhood queries, and the base class fit() takes an incremental path that absorbs only new trace records when the same domain prefix is extended.

nodes.name: cegar.py
nodes.summary: Counterexample-guided refinement loop: collects soundness counterexamples (gate bound violations, replay regrets) and precision counterexamples (overly coarse cells), refines an abstraction until no soundness counterexample remains, and binary-searches a tighter Lipschitz scale for mechanisms whose bounds never bind.

nodes.name: diagnostics.py
nodes.summary: Self-diagnosis of the abstraction library: audits its verification decisions for inert mechanisms, miscalibrated bounds, stale entries, winner's curse, degenerate or invalid specs, domains with no verified mechanism, underpowered meta-domains and short traces, returning severity-ranked findings that name the exact remediation tool call.

nodes.name: domain.py
nodes.summary: Concrete search domain model: parameter specs with validation and [0, 1] normalisation, trace records that reject NaN or infinite objectives, and ConcreteDomain built from rows, CSV or JSON with inferred parameter kinds, score orientation, vector embedding and validated active-mode append.

nodes.name: g6_adapter.py
nodes.summary: Fail-closed adapter that wraps abstraction library verdicts in a G6 envelope, mapping module statuses down-only so no input can produce a verified state (verified and provisional become qualified_draft, everything else blocked_escalated), always requiring human review and sanitising hostile entry objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Defensive Python: every attribute probe, str() call and container conversion is wrapped in try/except so objects with raising __str__, __getattr__ or to_dict still yield a total, JSON-safe result.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: Verification gate and counterfactual replay: Hypothesis property checks for extensivity, monotonicity and prospective bound soundness (aborted checks fail closed) with calibration statistics, and a replay of the recorded trace that skips pruned configs, refunds their budget and logs regret events.
nodes.languageNotes: Hypothesis @given/@settings decorators are applied to functions nested inside run_gate, with derandomize=True so the same inputs give the same counterexamples.

nodes.name: library.py
nodes.summary: Persistent library of evaluated abstractions: runs gate, replay, bootstrap permutations and MDL to compute a robust score and a status (verified, provisional, degenerate, rejected), deduplicates identical specs, tracks lineage and staleness, ranks a leaderboard, and saves or loads JSON state atomically while marking loaded entries as not re-established.

nodes.name: lift.py
nodes.summary: Lift functor that turns the library into a meta-domain (featurised abstraction specs scored by their recorded robust score) so trace-generic mechanisms can be reused on the search over abstractions, with a check that every dimension a spec names exists there.

nodes.name: mdl.py
nodes.summary: Heuristic two-part minimum description length score: compares the raw bit cost of a trace with its cost when covered configs are named by cell, plus the mechanism's spec length, for relative comparison of candidate abstractions on the same trace.

nodes.name: pruning.py
nodes.summary: Guarded prune or no-prune advice for fresh candidate configurations: pruning is allowed only for verified, re-established, non-stale entries, and each config is refused pruning when it is out of range or too far from observed data. Every guard can only turn pruning off.

nodes.name: robustness.py
nodes.summary: Robust valuation that replays an abstraction under many permutations of the trace, requires zero regret on every ordering, and uses a Bonferroni-adjusted low quantile of the benefit (an order-sensitivity stress test, not a confidence bound) to decide whether it is valuable.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: Optional FastMCP stdio server exposing the abstraction harness as tools: load and describe datasets, propose and evaluate abstractions, CEGAR refine and tighten, leaderboard, guarded pruning advice, active-mode evaluation recording, revalidation, lifting, bounded self-debugging, diagnosis and state persistence.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the three harness sessions in a shared temporary G6_HOME and a control session in an empty folder, printing each result, then removes both folders.

nodes.name: _show
nodes.summary: Calls grounding check_claims through invoke_reply for the draft and a source set, then prints the label, warning code, per-claim status with missing terms or conflicts, and the next action.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the three source scenarios: shipping policy only, refund policy added, and a refund source with a contradicting figure.

nodes.name: _suite
nodes.summary: Runs the project tests and the held-out suite with pytest in a subprocess and parses the pass and fail lines into a self_training RunSummary.

nodes.name: _propose
nodes.summary: Evaluates one proposed template change in its own git worktree: measures the regression delta, classifies the change scope, re-runs the failing task, asks govern_patch_promotion for a decision bound to the diff, appends the record to a log, and merges or rolls back.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Creates a throwaway git project and held-out suite, runs the failing task and its diagnosis, evaluates a bad and a good template change, then runs a later task on the updated project.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Scripts the discovery path for checking a customer email: finds and invokes grounding, then the action gate twice (without and with a verification contract and coordination context), and prints the weakest combined label.

nodes.name: artifact_name
nodes.summary: Builds the executable name from the bundle id, the operating system (macos, windows or linux) and the machine architecture.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Writes a launcher script for one bundle and runs PyInstaller in one-file mode, excluding the MCP and tkinter modules, and fails if no executable was produced.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Validates the requested bundle ids against the bundle catalogue (all bundles by default) and builds each one.

nodes.name: agent_change_sample
nodes.summary: Creates a one-function git repository with an uncommitted fix, giving the agent-change-check bundle the real repository input it needs.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Launches a bundle executable with a temporary G6_HOME, reads its local URL and page token, posts a sample task to api/run, asserts the completion label and rows, and confirms a request without the token gets 403.

nodes.name: SpecError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass raised when an agent-supplied abstraction spec breaks the validation limits.

nodes.name: Abstraction
nodes.summary: Base class for all abstraction mechanisms: incremental fit over a trace prefix and the covers, bound, prune, cell, refine, spec and MDL-bits interface that subclasses implement.

nodes.name: Quotient
nodes.summary: Similarity quotient that covers a config when any visited point lies within a radius, bounding its score by the best nearby score plus Lipschitz slack, with numpy-vectorised neighbourhood queries and radius-halving refinement.

nodes.name: Project
nodes.summary: Abstraction that projects configs onto chosen dimensions split into bins, keeping the best observed score per cell and a conservative bound for in-cell width and forgotten dimensions.

nodes.name: Sufficient
nodes.summary: Guidance-only abstraction that keeps per-arm score statistics for one dimension; its bound is infinite so it never prunes, and its value shows up through UCB reordering in replay.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: Conjunction of two abstractions whose coverage is the intersection and whose bound is the minimum of the component bounds, so composition only tightens.

nodes.name: from_spec
nodes.summary: Validates an untrusted JSON spec (object type, nesting depth, known kind) and constructs the matching abstraction, recursing for product children.

nodes.name: CexReport
nodes.summary: Holds soundness and precision counterexamples and serialises their counts plus the first ten of each.

nodes.name: find_counterexamples
nodes.summary: Gathers soundness counterexamples from gate bound violations and replay regrets, and precision counterexamples from cells whose score spread exceeds a fraction of the overall score span.

nodes.name: RefineResult
nodes.summary: Records the spec before and after refinement, the iteration count, the remaining soundness counterexamples and the per-iteration history.

nodes.name: refine_until
nodes.summary: Repeatedly refines an abstraction on its worst soundness counterexample until none remain or the iteration cap is reached, then reports how many counterexamples are left.

nodes.name: TightenResult
nodes.summary: Records the outcome of tightening: specs before and after, iterations, whether the spec changed, the history and an explanatory note.

nodes.name: tighten_until
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the smallest uniform scale on all Lipschitz fields that still passes the gate with zero regret on every bootstrap ordering, returning early with a note when the spec has no slack, is unsound, or is already tight.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: One diagnostic finding with severity, code, subject, detail and an optional machine-actionable remediation.

nodes.name: Diagnosis
nodes.summary: Collection of findings plus a summary, serialised with findings sorted by severity (act, warn, info).

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: Audits the live (non-superseded) library entries and the domains, emitting findings for invalid specs, inert mechanisms, miscalibrated bounds, staleness, winner's curse, degenerate entries, domains with no verified mechanism, underpowered meta-domains and low data.

nodes.name: ParamSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen spec for one search dimension (float, int or categorical) that validates values against bounds or choices and normalises them into [0, 1].

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: One evaluated trace point (config, objective, index) whose constructor rejects NaN or infinite objectives at every entry path.

nodes.name: ConcreteDomain
nodes.summary: The concrete search domain: parameter specs and an ordered evaluation trace, with constructors from rows, CSV and JSON that infer parameter kinds, plus score orientation, best record, vector embedding, validated append and a description.

nodes.name: surface_state
nodes.summary: Total, down-only map from a module status to completion state, badge and oracle strength; unknown, non-string or hostile statuses fail closed to blocked_escalated.

nodes.name: _entry_data
nodes.summary: Normalises a LibraryEntry or mapping into a plain dict, returning an empty dict for any object whose attribute probes or to_dict call raise.

nodes.name: _json_safe
nodes.summary: Deep-sanitises payload data to bounded-depth JSON-native values, converting anything else to a safe string.

nodes.name: _hard_blocked_envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the last-resort, fully blocked envelope with no caller data, used when envelope construction itself fails.

nodes.name: attach_abstraction_envelope
nodes.summary: Public entry point that wraps an abstraction verdict in an honest G6 envelope and falls back to the hard-blocked envelope on any exception.

nodes.name: _build_envelope
nodes.summary: Assembles the envelope from an entry: completion state and badge, a warning card with clipped counterexamples and regret events, evidence with calibration, robustness and MDL fields, merged so the adapter fields override any caller payload.

nodes.name: GateReport
nodes.summary: Gate outcome: pass flag, per-check results, counterexamples, notes and calibration statistics.

nodes.name: run_gate
nodes.summary: Runs Hypothesis property checks for extensivity and monotonicity on random sub-traces, then a prospective bound-soundness pass that records violations and calibration rates (coverage, finite bounds, violations, mean slack).

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs one mandatory property check and reports an aborted check as inconclusive and not passed.

nodes.name: ReplayReport
nodes.summary: Replay outcome: budget, best score with and without the abstraction, evaluations used and saved, horizon reached, regret events, reorder gain and the evaluated and skipped indices.

nodes.name: replay
nodes.summary: Counterfactually replays the recorded trace under an abstraction fitted only on records it actually evaluated, skipping pruned configs, refunding their budget to extend the horizon, and logging regret events.

nodes.name: LibraryEntry
nodes.summary: Record of one evaluated abstraction: spec, domain, gate, replay, robustness and MDL results, robust score, status, trace length, lineage and spec hash, with dict conversion and a staleness measure.

nodes.name: Library
nodes.summary: Evaluates abstractions into status-labelled entries, deduplicates repeat specs, counts candidates per domain for the Bonferroni adjustment, ranks a leaderboard, lists promotable kinds, and persists state atomically, flagging loaded entries as not re-established and invalid specs for diagnosis.

nodes.name: _featurise
nodes.summary: Flattens a possibly nested spec into numeric features: depth, kind counts and code, radius, Lipschitz, bins and arms.

nodes.name: meta_domain
nodes.summary: Builds a ConcreteDomain from library entries (featurised specs as configs, robust scores as the objective), requiring at least four entries.

nodes.name: referenced_dims
nodes.summary: Collects the dimension names a spec reads, including inside nested compositions.

nodes.name: liftable
nodes.summary: Checks that an abstraction is trace-generic and, when a meta-domain is given, that every dimension it references exists there.

nodes.name: lift
nodes.summary: Lifts a trace-generic abstraction to the meta-domain, rejecting domain-specific mechanisms and specs naming missing dimensions, and returns the fitted copy with the meta-domain.

nodes.name: _bits_per_config
nodes.summary: Computes the raw bit cost of one config from its parameter kinds (log2 of choices for categoricals, 16 bits for ints, 32 bits for floats).

nodes.name: MDLReport
nodes.summary: Raw, coded and mechanism bit counts with the derived compression ratio and net bits saved.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Computes the two-part code length by fitting the abstraction incrementally and charging covered configs a cell name plus a residual, then adds the mechanism's spec length.

nodes.name: support_distance
nodes.summary: Returns the normalised L-infinity distance from a config to the nearest observed record.

nodes.name: advise_pruning
nodes.summary: Applies a library entry to candidate configs and reports coverage, bound and a prune flag per config, disabling pruning for non-verified, state-file-loaded or stale entries and for out-of-range or poorly supported configs.

nodes.name: RobustReport
nodes.summary: Bootstrap valuation outcome: permutation count, benefits, total regret events, mean benefit, the adjusted low quantile and its level, candidate count, and the robust-soundness and value flags.

nodes.name: bootstrap_replay
nodes.summary: Replays the abstraction under the recorded order and K shuffled orders, computes the combined benefit per ordering, and marks it sound only with zero total regret and valuable only if the Bonferroni-adjusted quantile is positive.

nodes.name: load_dataset
nodes.summary: MCP tool that registers a concrete domain from a CSV or JSON dataset file and returns its description.

nodes.name: describe_domain
nodes.summary: MCP tool that describes a loaded domain: parameters, trace length and score range.

nodes.name: list_combinators
nodes.summary: MCP tool that lists the abstraction combinators with their validated parameter ranges and example specs.

nodes.name: propose_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that validates a candidate spec and runs the verification gate, returning the gate feedback for iteration.

nodes.name: evaluate_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that runs the full robust evaluation of a spec and records the resulting entry in the library.

nodes.name: find_counterexamples
nodes.summary: MCP tool that returns the soundness and precision counterexamples for a library entry.

nodes.name: refine_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that runs CEGAR refinement on an entry and records the refined mechanism as a new child entry, so the description-length trade-off shows on the leaderboard.

nodes.name: leaderboard
nodes.summary: MCP tool that returns library entries ranked status-first and then by robust score, showing only the frontier of non-superseded entries by default.

nodes.name: advise_pruning
nodes.summary: MCP tool wrapper around the guarded pruning advice for candidate configs, resolving the entry's domain first.

nodes.name: record_evaluation
nodes.summary: MCP tool that appends a caller-supplied evaluated point to a domain trace and reports which entries have gone stale.

nodes.name: revalidate
nodes.summary: MCP tool that re-evaluates an entry's spec on the current trace as a fresh child entry, keeping the old one for provenance.

nodes.name: lift_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that lifts a trace-generic entry to the meta-domain, registers that domain, and evaluates the lifted mechanism on it.

nodes.name: tighten_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that tightens an entry's Lipschitz slack and records the tightened spec as a new entry when it changed.

nodes.name: self_debug
nodes.summary: MCP tool for bounded closed-loop self-debugging: diagnoses, executes the safe re-analysis remediations (refine, tighten, revalidate) at most once per entry, re-diagnoses, and stops when healthy, converged or out of rounds; it never creates data.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: MCP tool that returns the severity-ordered self-diagnosis of the library and loaded domains.

nodes.name: save_state
nodes.summary: MCP tool that persists the library and all domains to a JSON state file.

nodes.name: load_state
nodes.summary: MCP tool that restores the library and domains from a state file, replacing the in-memory state.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that autoloads saved state when ABSTRACTION_MCP_STATE is set and runs the MCP server over stdio.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for action gating, a deterministic pre-flight check that decides whether an agent action is allowed, needs a person, or is blocked. Re-exports the block, evaluate_action, decide_gate and normalize_action_capsule, and declares the component marker and its action_logic and epistemic_integrity requirements.

nodes.name: action_gating_block.py
nodes.summary: Defines ActionGatingBlock, the canonical AIBlock wrapper that evaluates a proposed action and returns the gate decision or a plain-language risk message; it never executes the action. Also defines its typed input model with evaluate, explain, ops and help operations.

nodes.name: audit.py
nodes.summary: Audit logger for gate decisions: decides when an audit record is required and builds ActionGateAuditRecord entries tagged with an evidence provenance class. Optionally persists each record to the durable store and raises RuntimeError on any write failure so the caller fails closed.

nodes.name: audit_store.py
nodes.summary: Durable SQLite store for the action-gating audit trail under $G6_HOME, with WAL mode, a per-instance lock and a SHA-256 hash chain linking each entry to the one before it so edits or reordering can be detected. Supports lookup by audit id or action id, listing recent entries and verifying the chain; it never silently falls back to memory.
nodes.languageNotes: The hash chain uses a domain-separation prefix and a 64-zero genesis hash; this detects tampering but does not prevent a writer from rewriting the whole chain.

nodes.name: capabilities.py
nodes.summary: Reports what the action-gating component really provides: capability flags, supported action types and backends, and safety guards, with live native execution and the global policy bridge reported as absent. Also builds degradation notices and computes the worst degradation severity.

nodes.name: classifiers.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic classifiers that map an action capsule to a reversibility class and an ImpactAssessment. Unknown reach is never treated as low risk, sensitive domains such as security, identity, financial and privacy raise the aggregate to high, and a few action types are marked critical.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component metadata for action gating: Apache-2.0 license, core-platform owner, path to its component docs page, medium risk level, no allowed autonomy, and extension revert as the rollback method.

nodes.name: decision_engine.py
nodes.summary: Core decision pipeline for action gating: normalizes the action, classifies risk, builds scenarios, mitigation, uncertainty and user-model notes, runs safety QA, and combines them into a GateDecision with reason codes, a warning card and evidence. Adds monotonic gates for factual preconditions, verification contracts, coordination, weak signals and hypotheses, and writes a fail-closed durable audit record.
nodes.languageNotes: Every added gate only raises severity, using rank tables for severities and decisions, so a later check can never relax an earlier block or escalation.

nodes.name: explain.py
nodes.summary: Renders the user-facing risk explanation for a gate decision as a Markdown message covering known facts, uncertainties, hidden assumptions, worst plausible outcome, mitigation, residual risk and the required confirmation phrase.

nodes.name: honesty.py
nodes.summary: Registers two honesty detectors for the action-gating block: one flags outputs whose metadata carries a review-pending flag inherited from an unproven parent, and one flags outputs that report a verified completion_state while also showing the action was only simulated.

nodes.name: mitigation.py
nodes.summary: Builds template mitigation plans (preventive controls, pre-execution checks, confirmation, rollback or compensation, monitoring, stop and escalation steps) from an action's declared flags. Because none of the steps is executed, residual risk is kept equal to the assessed risk.

nodes.name: native_ops.py
nodes.summary: Constrained, simulated backend-native operations for action gating: describes the local write_file and iam permission_escalation ops, offers dry runs and evaluation, issues single-use gate tokens bound to a hash of the action scope, and runs a simulated execute that checks token validity, expiry, scope, authorization, declared safety approval and audit health. Nothing is ever really executed.
nodes.languageNotes: Every reply goes through one envelope helper that carries completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id, run_id and a stable G6_E_* error code.

nodes.name: normalizer.py
nodes.summary: Turns a proposed action (dict, model or string) into a frozen ActionCapsule with a stable id, filled-in backend and resource, missing dependencies and safety domains. Known action profiles set a risk floor that caller declarations can only raise, credential or permission words in the action name add security and identity domains, and declared authority is never treated as observed.

nodes.name: provenance.py
nodes.summary: Defines a shared evidence provenance vocabulary (model, tool, formal, human_approval) and deterministic classifiers that tag action-gating audit records and safety decisions with the kind of evidence behind them. Human approval counts only when a recorded approval receipt exists.

nodes.name: qa.py
nodes.summary: Runs safety QA checks on a gate input, flagging high-effect actions that lack a mitigation plan or a consequence-specific confirmation phrase, and any blocking degradation. Returns a SafetyQAAssurance with per-check results, detected issues and required fixes.

nodes.name: scenario_modeler.py
nodes.summary: Builds template consequence scenarios (best, expected, failure, partial failure, wrong assumption, misuse and rollback) for material actions. Severity follows assessed risk and recoverability follows declared reversibility; likelihood is always reported as unknown.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic data models for action gating: the frozen ActionCapsule and its optional declared contexts (factual preconditions, verification contract, coordination, world state, hypotheses), plus impact, scenario, mitigation, uncertainty, user-model, QA, degradation, capability, decision, audit-record and evaluation models. Also defines the literal types for completion_state, reversibility, risk level and decision names.
nodes.languageNotes: Every model sets ConfigDict(frozen=True), so capsules and decisions are immutable and updates go through model_copy.

nodes.name: token_store.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed durable gate-token ledger that stores policy decisions and linked audit records per token. It loads an authorization with its audit record and consumes a token exactly once with a conditional update.

nodes.name: uncertainty.py
nodes.summary: Builds a Rumsfeld uncertainty matrix for medium, high, unknown-risk or unknown-reversibility actions. Known unknowns come from the capsule's missing facts; the other lists are fixed prompts.

nodes.name: user_model.py
nodes.summary: Produces template user mental-model notes for risk communication (likely goal, assumptions, possible misunderstandings, missing acknowledgements, consent quality) from the action's declared flags, without measuring anything about the user or reporting a confidence.

nodes.name: ActionGatingInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the block: an operation (evaluate, explain, ops or help) and the proposed action dict.

nodes.name: ActionGatingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass (beta maturity) whose infer method lists ops or help, or evaluates the action through evaluate_action and returns the full evaluation or a rendered risk message, turning ValueError or TypeError into a failed Result.

nodes.name: audit_required
nodes.summary: Returns true when an action needs an audit record: it has an external, real-world or irreversible effect, or its assessed risk is medium, high, critical or unknown.

nodes.name: ActionGateAuditLogger
nodes.summary: Dataclass logger that builds an ActionGateAuditRecord from a capsule and decision, tags its provenance class, keeps it in memory, and appends it to an optional durable store, raising RuntimeError when unavailable or when any write fails.

nodes.name: ActionGateAuditStore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe SQLite audit store with a shared default instance; appends records with a hash link to the previous entry, counts and queries records by audit id, action id or recency, and verifies the whole hash chain.

nodes.name: build_degradation_notice
nodes.summary: Builds a DegradationNotice from missing dependencies, unavailable capabilities, severity, message and a blocks-execution flag, returning a non-degraded notice when nothing is missing.

nodes.name: degradation_level
nodes.summary: Returns the most severe level among a list of degradation notices, used for the warning card.

nodes.name: discover_capabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the ActionGatingCapabilities snapshot of what the component provides, adding a blocking degradation notice when audit logging is unavailable.

nodes.name: classify_reversibility
nodes.summary: Maps the capsule's declared reversibility and irreversible flag to a reversibility class, defaulting to unknown.

nodes.name: classify_impact
nodes.summary: Computes an ImpactAssessment with per-domain impact levels, an aggregate risk (low, unknown, high or critical), a confidence and a rationale from the capsule's effects, reach, reversibility and safety domains.

nodes.name: _confirmation_phrase
nodes.summary: Returns a consequence-specific confirmation phrase naming the action and target when risk is not low or the action has external, irreversible or real-world effects; otherwise none.

nodes.name: _warning_card
nodes.summary: Builds the cross-surface warning_card dict with completion_state, degradation level, user-visible message, degraded flag and the list of capabilities that were not verified.

nodes.name: _precondition_criticality
nodes.summary: Maps an action to the criticality its factual preconditions must meet: irreversible for external, irreversible or real-world actions, otherwise high, medium or info from aggregate risk.

nodes.name: _precondition_evidence
nodes.summary: Converts a factual precondition's evidence references into core EvidenceRecord objects for grading.

nodes.name: _evaluate_factual_preconditions
nodes.summary: Grades each factual precondition's evidence with the epistemic adjudicator (independence collapse, grade, contested check) against the minimum grade from risk_policy, and returns a block, review or notice severity plus reason codes and evidence items for unsupported premises.

nodes.name: _is_material_action
nodes.summary: Returns true for a material action: irreversible, external, real-world, touching more than one system, or with an account, organization, external-party or public blast radius.

nodes.name: _not_evaluated
nodes.summary: Handles a material action whose context for a control was not supplied: returns the given severity for an irreversible, external or real-world action and a notice otherwise, with a G6_E_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED reason and an evidence item naming what was missing.

nodes.name: _evaluate_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Checks a material action's closed-loop verification contract through action_logic: blocks a missing contract for the highest-risk actions or an incomplete declared contract, and records a complete one for audit.

nodes.name: _to_action_intent
nodes.summary: Converts an ActionIntentModel into the action_logic ActionIntent dataclass.

nodes.name: _evaluate_coordination
nodes.summary: Runs the action-collision check from action_logic against a declared coordination context, blocking collisions on material actions; with no context, sends a high-risk material action to human review.

nodes.name: _evaluate_weak_signals
nodes.summary: Builds an action_logic WorldState from the declared world state and runs the weak-signal check, which blocks a material action that ignores a worsening trend or looks at no future horizon; with no world state, high-risk material actions go to review.

nodes.name: _hypothesis_gate_enabled
nodes.summary: Reads the G6_ACTION_LOGIC_HYPOTHESIS_GATE environment flag, which is off by default, to decide whether the hypothesis gate runs.

nodes.name: _to_hypothesis
nodes.summary: Converts a HypothesisModel into the action_logic Hypothesis dataclass with its status enum.

nodes.name: _evaluate_hypotheses
nodes.summary: When enabled and a hypothesis context is declared, pauses the action for review if an in-use hypothesis has unresolved disconfirming evidence and blocks it if it relies on a falsified hypothesis without a valid replacement.

nodes.name: decide_gate
nodes.summary: Combines risk, scenario, mitigation, QA and degradation inputs into a GateDecision: sets the base decision and completion_state from risk and missing safeguards, then applies the precondition, verification-contract, coordination, weak-signal and hypothesis gates so they only raise severity, and picks the user message, reason codes, warning card and evidence. It never returns verified on its own.

nodes.name: _default_audit_logger
nodes.summary: Returns an audit logger backed by the default durable store, or an unavailable logger if the store cannot be opened, so actions that need an audit then block instead of falling back to memory.

nodes.name: evaluate_action
nodes.summary: Main public entry: normalizes the action, discovers capabilities, classifies impact, builds scenarios, mitigation, uncertainty and user-model notes, runs safety QA and decide_gate, writes the required audit record (blocking with G6_E_AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED if it fails), and returns an ActionGatingEvaluation with request and run ids.

nodes.name: render_user_risk_message
nodes.summary: Formats the capsule and gate decision into a multi-section Markdown risk message, using fallback text when the uncertainty matrix, mitigation plan or scenarios are absent.

nodes.name: detect_alias_inherits_unproven_parent
nodes.summary: Registered detector that returns true when an output's metadata has review_pending set to true.

nodes.name: detect_simulated_presented_as_real
nodes.summary: Registered detector that returns true when an output marks the action as executed while its metadata reports a verified completion_state, a sign that a simulated result is shown as real.

nodes.name: mitigation_required
nodes.summary: Returns true when an action is irreversible or its aggregate risk is high, critical or unknown.

nodes.name: build_mitigation_plan
nodes.summary: Builds a template MitigationPlan with checks, controls, confirmation, rollback or compensation, monitoring, stop and escalation steps, keeping residual risk equal to the assessed risk.

nodes.name: GateToken
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for an issued gate token: the token string, the hash of the action scope it is bound to, and its expiry time.

nodes.name: _envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the standard response envelope with completion_state, reliability label, warning_card, evidence, request_id and run_id, plus an optional G6_E_* error and extra fields.

nodes.name: discover_backend_ops
nodes.summary: Returns the simulated native op descriptors described for a backend id; an undescribed backend has none.

nodes.name: describe_backend_op
nodes.summary: Looks up one native op descriptor by backend id and op name, or returns none.

nodes.name: dry_run_backend_op
nodes.summary: Returns a simulated dry-run envelope for a backend op with its descriptor, a qualified-draft label and a warning that nothing was executed.

nodes.name: evaluate_backend_op
nodes.summary: Refuses args that try to override the operation identity, otherwise evaluates the backend op as an action and returns the evaluation dict.

nodes.name: issue_gate_token
nodes.summary: Normalizes and evaluates an action, then issues a random single-use gate token that expires in ten minutes, is bound to the action scope hash, and is saved with its decision and audit record in the durable ledger.

nodes.name: execute_backend_op
nodes.summary: Simulated execution that fails closed with a specific G6_E_* code on reserved args, a missing, unknown, consumed or expired token, a scope mismatch, an unauthorized policy decision, missing declared safety approval, missing audit availability or a failed single-use consume. On success it reports qualified-draft with executed false.

nodes.name: _normalize_preconditions
nodes.summary: Accepts factual preconditions as plain strings, dicts or models and keeps only entries with a non-empty statement.

nodes.name: _normalize_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Passes a declared verification contract dict or model through and turns absent or empty values into none, so the contract gate stays opt-in.

nodes.name: _normalize_optional_model
nodes.summary: Passes an optional coordination, world-state or hypothesis context through and turns absent or empty values into none.

nodes.name: normalize_action_capsule
nodes.summary: Builds an ActionCapsule from untrusted input: resolves action type, backend and resource, records missing dependencies, applies the action profile as a floor that declarations can only raise, adds safety domains, sets a default owner authority requirement, never accepts declared authority as observed, and normalizes optional declared contexts. Already-built capsules are returned unchanged.

nodes.name: EvidenceProvenance
nodes.summary: String enum of the four provenance classes of an audit entry: model, tool, formal and human_approval.

nodes.name: classify_provenance
nodes.summary: Picks a provenance class from explicit signals with fixed precedence: human approval, then formal proof, then tool call, otherwise model.

nodes.name: classify_audit_record
nodes.summary: Derives the provenance class of a stored audit record from its approval receipt and the capsule's actor type and target backend.

nodes.name: classify_csf_provenance
nodes.summary: Returns formal provenance for a safety decision backed by Z3 or Lean verification, otherwise model.

nodes.name: provenance_for_decision
nodes.summary: Write-time classifier that derives the provenance class from the capsule and gate decision being recorded.

nodes.name: run_safety_qa
nodes.summary: Checks policy, authority, consent, reversibility, mitigation, degradation and explanation for a gate input and returns a SafetyQAAssurance with detected issues, required fixes and a lower confidence when issues exist.

nodes.name: scenario_required
nodes.summary: Returns true when an action is irreversible, external or real-world, or its aggregate risk is high, critical or unknown.

nodes.name: build_action_scenarios
nodes.summary: Builds an ActionScenarioModel of fixed consequence narratives for the action, with severity from assessed risk, recoverability from declared reversibility and likelihood left unknown.

nodes.name: FactualEvidenceRef
nodes.summary: Frozen model for one evidence reference behind a factual precondition (source id, source type, supports or opposes, independence group, authority), rebuilt as an EvidenceRecord at grading time.

nodes.name: FactualPrecondition
nodes.summary: Frozen model for a factual claim an action depends on, with its evidence references; graded before external, irreversible or real-world actions run.

nodes.name: VerificationContractModel
nodes.summary: Frozen model for the closed-loop verification plan a material action must carry: expected result, observation window, indicators, monitor, verification time, stop threshold, rollback procedure and model-update rule.

nodes.name: ActionIntentModel
nodes.summary: Frozen model of declared facts about an intervention (target, direction, shared resources, costs, time window, assumptions relied on or invalidated, idempotency key) used for collision detection.

nodes.name: CoordinationContextModel
nodes.summary: Frozen model pairing a proposed action intent with the active or scheduled intents and resource budgets it must be coordinated against.

nodes.name: ControlVariableModel
nodes.summary: Frozen model of a monitored variable as value, threshold and trend, with flags for finite resources and acknowledged risk.

nodes.name: WorldStateModel
nodes.summary: Frozen snapshot of monitored variables plus the future horizons evaluated, read by the weak-signal gate.

nodes.name: HypothesisModel
nodes.summary: Frozen wire model of an operational hypothesis with statement, confidence, supporting and disconfirming evidence, falsification condition and status.

nodes.name: HypothesisContextModel
nodes.summary: Frozen model listing active hypotheses plus the relied-on and replacement hypotheses read by the hypothesis gate, which is off by default.

nodes.name: ActionCapsule
nodes.summary: Central frozen record of a proposed action: id, requester, actor type, action type, backend and resource, inputs, effect flags, reversibility, blast radius, affected entities and systems, required and observed authority, dependencies, safety domains, and optional declared preconditions and contexts.

nodes.name: ImpactAssessment
nodes.summary: Frozen model of per-domain impact levels (financial, privacy, security, legal, reputational, data integrity, operational) with aggregate risk, confidence and rationale.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Frozen model of one consequence scenario with summary, likely consequences, affected entities, severity, likelihood, detectability, recoverability and assumptions.

nodes.name: ActionScenarioModel
nodes.summary: Frozen set of best, expected, failure, partial failure, wrong assumption, misuse and optional rollback scenarios for an action.

nodes.name: MitigationPlan
nodes.summary: Frozen model of suggested preventive controls, confirmations, pre-execution checks, rollback and compensation steps, monitoring, stop conditions, escalation paths and residual risk.

nodes.name: RumsfeldMatrix
nodes.summary: Frozen model of known knowns, known unknowns, unknown knowns and unknown unknowns plus assumptions to validate, hidden-knowledge prompts, tripwires and contingency plans.

nodes.name: UserMentalModelEstimate
nodes.summary: Frozen model of template notes about the user (goal, assumptions, misunderstandings, missing acknowledgements, capability signals, communication needs, consent quality) with confidence left empty.

nodes.name: SafetyQAAssurance
nodes.summary: Frozen model of safety QA results: pass flags for policy, authority, consent, reversibility, mitigation, degradation and explanation, plus detected issues, required fixes and confidence.

nodes.name: DegradationNotice
nodes.summary: Frozen model describing a degraded state: severity, missing dependencies, unavailable capabilities, affected features, assurance impact, fallback, user message and whether it blocks execution.

nodes.name: ActionGatingCapabilities
nodes.summary: Frozen model of the component capability snapshot: capability flags, supported action types and backends, degradation notices and safety guard flags.

nodes.name: BackendNativeOpDescriptor
nodes.summary: Frozen descriptor of a backend-native op: backend and op name, side effect type, reversibility, confirmation, dry-run and rollback support, required permissions and dependencies, risk domains and safety notes.

nodes.name: GateDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen result of the gate: decision name, reason codes, risk, degradation, attached analyses, required user message and confirmation phrase, optional gate token, audit and action ids, completion_state, warning_card and evidence.

nodes.name: ActionGateAuditRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen audit entry that snapshots the capsule, capabilities, degradation, risk and analyses, the decision and reason codes, confirmation and gate-token fields, execution flags and the evidence provenance class.

nodes.name: ActionGatingEvaluation
nodes.summary: Frozen top-level result of evaluate_action holding the capsule, capabilities, degradation, gate decision, optional audit record, request, task and run ids, completion_state, reliability label, warning_card and evidence; to_response_dict dumps it as JSON-ready data.

nodes.name: ActionGatingStore
nodes.summary: Durable gate-token ledger over SQLite: creates the policy-decision and audit-record tables, saves an authorization (authorized only when the decision is allow and nothing escalated), loads it with its audit record, and consumes a token exactly once.

nodes.name: rumsfeld_required
nodes.summary: Returns true when aggregate risk is medium, high, critical or unknown, or reversibility is unknown.

nodes.name: build_rumsfeld_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds a RumsfeldMatrix whose known unknowns and assumptions come from missing backend, resource, reversibility, authority or risk facts, with fixed prompts for the other lists.

nodes.name: estimate_user_mental_model
nodes.summary: Returns a template UserMentalModelEstimate whose misunderstandings, missing acknowledgements and consent quality depend on whether the action has external, irreversible or real-world effects.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the action-logic component: documents the deterministic closed-loop control floor based on Dörner's Logic of Failure and re-exports its block, controls, hypothesis checks, schema types and the core decision-record and objective-contract primitives.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level __g6_component__ and __g6_block__ markers let the component registry discover the package; __all__ lists ActionLogicBlock first because the registry loads the first AIBlock it finds there.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Generic-invoke block over the action-logic controls: validates a JSON op request with a Pydantic model, rebuilds the frozen schema records, and dispatches to the unchanged deterministic controls, returning a Result.
nodes.languageNotes: The block is a generic AIBlock[Input, Output, State] subclass decorated with @component_maturity; a dict maps op names to small adapter functions that convert JSON lists to the tuples the frozen dataclasses declare.

nodes.name: ActionLogicInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model naming the op to run and carrying every op's optional JSON payload: verification contract, proposed and active actions, budgets, world state, monitoring baseline and crisis records, hypotheses and outcome notes.

nodes.name: ActionLogicBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass whose infer method returns the op catalogue for "ops" or "help", otherwise looks up the op handler, runs it, and wraps the output or a readable error in a Result; assess_material_action answers are marked as advisory declared materiality.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component metadata for action_logic: Apache-2.0 license, owning team, the spec document path, related components (action_gating, reliability_pipeline, epistemic_integrity, core), a high risk level, no allowed autonomy and a stateless rollback method.

nodes.name: controls.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, model-free action-logic controls that block material actions lacking a complete verification plan, detect collisions between proposed and active actions, flag deteriorating weak signals and breached thresholds, and check that crisis monitoring does not fall below its baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Each control returns a (severity, reason codes, evidence) tuple in the notice < review < block vocabulary so results combine monotonically through raise_severity.

nodes.name: evaluate_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Returns block with G6_E_BALLISTIC_ACTION_BLOCKED when a material action has no complete verification contract, listing the missing elements as evidence.

nodes.name: _interval
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 "start/end" window into two ordered datetimes, returning None when the text cannot be parsed or the start is not before the end.

nodes.name: _windows_overlap
nodes.summary: Decides whether two action time windows overlap by comparing ISO-8601 intervals or bucket tokens; any other form is treated as overlapping so separation is never assumed.

nodes.name: detect_conflicts
nodes.summary: Finds collisions between a proposed action and active ones from declared intent fields: contradictory objectives, duplicate effects, shared-resource contention in overlapping windows, combined budget breaches and invalidated assumptions.

nodes.name: evaluate_coordination
nodes.summary: Turns detect_conflicts output into a severity verdict: block for a material action with collisions, notice for a non-material one.

nodes.name: sequence_if_separable
nodes.summary: Returns a serial order of action ids when every collision can be removed by running actions one at a time, or None when contradictions, invalidated assumptions, single-action budget breaches, non-idempotent duplicates or reused ids make sequencing unsafe.

nodes.name: is_deteriorating
nodes.summary: Detects a weak signal: a control variable still on the acceptable side of its threshold whose trend is moving it toward that threshold.

nodes.name: is_breached
nodes.summary: Reports whether a control variable is already past its threshold, meaning a resource below its floor or a load above its ceiling.

nodes.name: assess_weak_signals
nodes.summary: Blocks a material action that evaluates no future horizon, leaves a deteriorating signal unacknowledged, or goes ahead past a breached threshold; an acknowledged weak signal is downgraded to a notice.

nodes.name: check_crisis_monitoring
nodes.summary: Blocks when crisis-time monitoring (telemetry, verification frequency, audit logging, anomaly detection, escalation readiness) drops below the baseline, and returns review when the baseline records no coverage at all.

nodes.name: assess_material_action
nodes.summary: Combines the verification-contract, coordination and weak-signal checks into one ActionLogicAssessment carrying the highest severity, de-duplicated reason codes and the evidence items.

nodes.name: hypotheses.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic hypothesis reflection controls: update a hypothesis after an observed outcome (success caps at SUPPORTED, disconfirmation falsifies and stays sticky), record disconfirming evidence, and raise review or block when actions rely on disconfirmed or falsified hypotheses.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions never mutate their input: each returns a new frozen Hypothesis, and confidence moves by fixed heuristic steps clamped to a range rather than by calibration.

nodes.name: update_on_outcome
nodes.summary: Applies the reflection rules to a hypothesis after an outcome: confirmation moves it to SUPPORTED with capped confidence, partial confirmation raises it less, disconfirmation or harm falsifies it, and a falsified hypothesis is never revived.

nodes.name: apply_disconfirming_evidence
nodes.summary: Adds a disconfirming note to a hypothesis, marks it weakened and cuts its confidence without falsifying it.

nodes.name: disconfirming_evidence_severity
nodes.summary: Returns review with G6_E_DISCONFIRMING_EVIDENCE_PENDING when an in-use hypothesis carries disconfirming evidence, pausing the actions that depend on it for re-evaluation.

nodes.name: _is_valid_replacement
nodes.summary: Checks that a replacement hypothesis is well formed, states something different from the falsified one, and brings new non-blank supporting evidence.

nodes.name: reauthorisation_severity
nodes.summary: Blocks reliance on a falsified hypothesis with G6_E_FALSIFIED_HYPOTHESIS_REUSED unless a valid, evidence-backed new hypothesis replaces it.

nodes.name: reauthorisation_severity_from_registry
nodes.summary: Looks up the relied-on hypothesis in a caller-supplied mapping and delegates to reauthorisation_severity.

nodes.name: _with
nodes.summary: Builds a new frozen Hypothesis copy with an updated status, confidence and supporting or disconfirming evidence.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclasses and enums for the action-logic controls (verification contract, action intent and conflict, control variables, world state, monitoring coverage, hypotheses, outcomes and the combined assessment) plus the shared notice/review/block severity ladder.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain frozen dataclasses and str-based Enums keep records immutable and JSON friendly; severity is a string ranked through the SEVERITY_RANK dict so it matches the action gate without a translation layer.

nodes.name: raise_severity
nodes.summary: Combines two severities on the notice/review/block ladder monotonically, never lowering a severity that is already higher.

nodes.name: VerificationContract
nodes.summary: The closed-loop verification plan a material action must carry (expected result, observation window, leading and lagging indicators, monitor, stop threshold, rollback, model update rule); missing_elements lists gaps and is_complete is a syntactic check.

nodes.name: ActionIntent
nodes.summary: Declared intent of one action: id, target, direction, shared resources, costs, effect signature, time window, assumptions relied on or invalidated, and an idempotency key.

nodes.name: ActionConflict
nodes.summary: A detected collision recording its kind, the other action id and a detail string, serialisable with to_dict.

nodes.name: ControlVariable
nodes.summary: A monitored variable with value, threshold, trend, resource flag and acknowledgement, used by the weak-signal and breach checks.

nodes.name: WorldState
nodes.summary: Caller-declared snapshot of the control variables and the future horizons that were evaluated.

nodes.name: MonitoringCoverage
nodes.summary: Monitoring coverage record (telemetry signals, verification frequency, audit logging, anomaly detection, escalation readiness) compared between the baseline and a crisis.

nodes.name: HypothesisStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of hypothesis lifecycle states: active, supported, weakened and falsified, with no terminal proven state.

nodes.name: Hypothesis
nodes.summary: An operational hypothesis with statement, confidence, supporting and disconfirming evidence, falsification condition and status; is_well_formed and to_dict support validation and serialisation.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Enum of observed outcome classes used by the reflection rules: confirmed, partially confirmed, disconfirmed, inconclusive, harmful and confounded.

nodes.name: ActionLogicAssessment
nodes.summary: Combined per-action verdict holding the severity, reason codes and evidence items, with blocks() and to_dict helpers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the bundle framework: the Field form descriptor, the Bundle record, the BundleResult that wraps output in the reliability envelope with a warning card for anything short of verified, the weakest-label combiner, and the catalog of shipped bundles.
nodes.languageNotes: reliability_envelope is imported inside to_dict and shipped inside catalog, which avoids circular imports with the bundle modules that import this package.

nodes.name: Field
nodes.summary: Frozen description of one form input on a bundle page: name, label, textarea or text kind, placeholder and help text.

nodes.name: BundleResult
nodes.summary: A bundle's labelled outcome (completion state, summary, table rows, notes, warning code); it rejects unknown states and serialises into the library envelope, adding a warning card for anything short of verified.

nodes.name: weakest
nodes.summary: Returns the weakest completion state among several results (blocked-escalated over qualified-draft over verified), defaulting to qualified-draft for an empty list.

nodes.name: Bundle
nodes.summary: Frozen bundle definition: id, title, summary, form fields, run callable, whether it needs a model, and an optional disclaimer.

nodes.name: catalog
nodes.summary: Imports the shipped bundles on demand and returns them keyed by bundle id.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Module entry point for "python -m g6.bundles" that forwards its arguments to the g6 CLI bundle command, which starts a bundle's local page or lists the bundles.

nodes.name: agent_change.py
nodes.summary: Offline bundle that checks whether a coding agent really fixed a task: it reads the git change, runs the named or derived tests, reruns original test files on the new code, compares changed tests by syntax tree for weakening, scans the diff for shortcuts, tries small deliberate mistakes on changed lines, and holds the agent's report to that evidence.

nodes.name: _mutations
nodes.summary: Applies small deliberate mistakes to the changed lines of each changed source file within a time budget, reruns the tests for each, and reports how many were caught plus notes on the ones the tests missed.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs the full agent-change check on a repository folder and returns a BundleResult with rows for the test run, original-test reruns, weakened tests, diff shortcuts, mutation results and the report verdict, never better than qualified-draft.

nodes.name: bookkeeping_check.py
nodes.summary: Offline Australian bookkeeping and GST bundle that matches bank and ledger CSV lines one to one, lists unmatched, duplicate and out-of-period lines, checks each ledger line's GST coding against the 1/11 rule, recomputes BAS G1, 1A and 1B, and runs a Benford first-digit test on large sets.
nodes.languageNotes: Amounts are decimal.Decimal values quantised to the cent with ROUND_HALF_UP, so GST arithmetic avoids float rounding errors.

nodes.name: _lines
nodes.summary: Parses a bank or ledger CSV into rows with dates, amounts and GST fields, reporting an unreadable date or amount as a problem row instead of reading it as zero.

nodes.name: _match
nodes.summary: Matches bank lines to ledger lines one to one on exact amount and a date within a window, returning matches, unmatched lines on each side and amount-only suggestions.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Validates the date format, period and inputs, reconciles bank against ledger, checks GST per line and the BAS totals, and returns a labelled table of findings.

nodes.name: check_claims.py
nodes.summary: Offline bundle that checks each sentence of a pasted draft against user-supplied sources with g6.grounding, labelling claims as quoted, supported, partial, conflicting or not found, and never better than qualified-draft.

nodes.name: parse_sources
nodes.summary: Splits pasted source text on "---" lines into named sources, using an optional "source: <name>" first line as the name.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Checks every claim in the draft against the parsed sources and returns per-claim rows with advice, the matching source sentence and the weakest label.

nodes.name: code_review.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed code review bundle that asks a reviewer model for findings with exactly quoted lines, then confirms each quote is in the pasted code and marks findings it cannot locate as unconfirmed.

nodes.name: locate
nodes.summary: Returns the 1-based line where a whitespace-normalised quote appears in the code, or None for quotes that are too short or not found.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Sends the code to the model, parses its JSON findings, locates each quote, and returns severity-sorted rows labelled qualified-draft or flagged as unconfirmed.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Offline GDPR and HIPAA compliance gap bundle that triages user answers against a built-in requirement table and computes breach-notice and request deadlines from dated records; unknown answers stay not assessed, "no" answers and overdue deadlines are gaps, and an optional model may only point at quoted passages.
nodes.languageNotes: Month arithmetic clamps to the last day of the month with calendar.monthrange, and each moment keeps an earliest and latest instant so a bare date is treated as spanning the whole day.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen requirement row: id, regulation, citation, title, the requirement in plain words, the evidence that would show it is met, and a reviewed flag that stays False.

nodes.name: When
nodes.summary: A written moment with its date and the earliest and latest instant it can mean, so a date without a time spans the whole day.

nodes.name: _answer_row
nodes.summary: Turns a requirement and the user's answer into a table row: unanswered or unknown is not assessed, no is a gap, yes without evidence is flagged, and yes with evidence is shown as an unchecked claim.

nodes.name: _deadline_row
nodes.summary: Builds a deadline row from start and end moments as overdue, within the limit, or still open as of the judgement date, with a problem row when the end comes before the start.

nodes.name: _gdpr_breach
nodes.summary: Evaluates the GDPR Art. 33(1) 72-hour breach-notice window in hours, using the uncertainty bounds of the given times to report within, open, overdue or cannot tell.

nodes.name: _hipaa_breach
nodes.summary: Evaluates HIPAA breach-notice deadlines for individuals (60 days), media (over 500 residents of one State) and HHS (with the individual notices, or after the calendar year), reporting what the record cannot tell.

nodes.name: _request
nodes.summary: Computes the GDPR one-month (three months when extended) or HIPAA 30-day (60 days when extended) deadline for a data-subject or access request.

nodes.name: _parse_record
nodes.summary: Parses one incident or request record line into its regulation, kind and typed fields (ISO moments, counts, extension flag), raising a readable error for anything it cannot read.

nodes.name: _pointers
nodes.summary: Optionally asks a model for pointers from policy text to requirement ids, skipping the model when the text trips the instruction check, and keeps only pointers whose quote appears verbatim; pointers never change answers, counts or labels.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Parses the chosen regulations, answers and records, builds answer and deadline rows, adds any model pointers, and returns the labelled table with counts by result.

nodes.name: contract_review.py
nodes.summary: Offline contract and document wording review bundle: it finds clause types by their usual words, defined terms used but undefined or never used, dangling cross-references, words-versus-figures mismatches and terms to read closely, quoting the document in every row; an optional model's issues are kept only when their quote is in the original text.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of precompiled regular expressions with word-boundary lookarounds, so for example "cap" inside "capacity" is not read as a liability cap.

nodes.name: _span
nodes.summary: Finds the sentence or line boundaries around a match within a radius, used to cut a readable quote from the document.

nodes.name: _clauses
nodes.summary: Checks each known clause family by heading or by its usual words, returning found or not-found rows with quotes and a map of the quotes for found clauses.

nodes.name: _focus
nodes.summary: Reports each user focus area as found as a clause type, found by its words, only partly found, or not found at all, which is blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: _counts
nodes.summary: Counts occurrences of each term together with its plural in one pass over the tokens, matching capitalised terms case-sensitively.

nodes.name: _defined_terms
nodes.summary: Finds defined terms from "means" clauses, definition lines and parenthesised short forms, then reports capitalised terms used but not defined and defined terms that are never used.

nodes.name: _cross_references
nodes.summary: Collects the clause numbers and schedules present in the text and reports references to clauses, schedules or annexures whose numbering is missing.

nodes.name: _words_value
nodes.summary: Converts a list of English number words into an integer, or None when a word that is not part of a number appears.

nodes.name: _number_in_words
nodes.summary: Extracts the number written in words at the end of a text segment, allowing a trailing unit such as "days".

nodes.name: _figures
nodes.summary: Finds "words (figure)" and "figure (words)" pairs and reports those where the written number and the figure disagree.

nodes.name: _read_closely
nodes.summary: Lists vague or wide phrases found in the document with counts and questions to ask, without calling them defects.

nodes.name: _model_review
nodes.summary: Sends the unaltered document to a model only when the instruction check is clean, keeps only proposed issues whose quote is in the document, marks statements about the law as unchecked opinion, and reports dropped issues by reason.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Validates the document, runs every wording check and the optional model review, caps noisy row groups, and returns a summary with the weakest label.

nodes.name: grounded_answer.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed bundle in which a model answers a question from pasted sources and G6 checks every sentence of the answer against those sources, after screening each source for text that reads like instructions; sentences backed only by a flagged source are blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Screens the sources for instruction-like text, asks the model for a source-only answer, checks each sentence with g6.grounding, and returns per-sentence rows with the weakest label.

nodes.name: ml_check.py
nodes.summary: Offline ML result check bundle: it looks for train/test leakage (shared rows, target copies, perfect predictors, shared identifiers), scores pasted or sandbox-generated predictions against held-back labels with bootstrap intervals and a baseline, and compares any claimed score with its own.
nodes.languageNotes: Bootstrap intervals use a fixed-seed random.Random(0), so repeated runs on the same data give the same interval.

nodes.name: _leaks
nodes.summary: Detects leakage between the train and test tables: shared identifier values, duplicated rows, columns equal to the target and columns that alone determine the target.

nodes.name: _intervals
nodes.summary: Computes each metric's point value with a seeded bootstrap 95% interval over the test rows, reducing resamples on large test sets.

nodes.name: _claims
nodes.summary: Parses claimed metric values (accuracy, F1, MAE, RMSE) from text with a rounding tolerance of half a unit of the last written digit.

nodes.name: _predictions
nodes.summary: Gets the predictions from the pasted column or by running the user's script in g6.core.sandbox with the training data and label-free test features, returning a problem row on failure.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Parses the tables and target, checks for leakage, scores the predictions with intervals and a simple baseline, compares claimed scores, and returns the labelled findings.

nodes.name: premortem.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed plan pre-mortem bundle: the model proposes failure stories, and G6 requires each to carry an observable early warning sign and a cheap test, checking statements about the plan against the plan's own text.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Asks the model for structured risks, drops those missing an early signal or cheap test, marks each plan fact as "from your plan" or "assumption" with check_claim, and returns severity-sorted rows.

nodes.name: runbook.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed runbook safety bundle: a model only reads the runbook into structured steps, then each step goes through g6.action_gating and fixed rules check for a backup or check before irreversible steps, a rollback section and a final verification.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Parses the model's structured steps, gates each through evaluate_action with the facts it read, applies the structural rules, and returns per-step rows with the weakest label.

nodes.name: safe_actions.py
nodes.summary: Offline bundle that gates proposed agent actions, one per line with optional facts (reversible, reach, backend, external), through g6.action_gating.evaluate_action without executing anything; facts left out stay unknown and are never treated as low risk.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Parses an action line into a dict with the action type, target and recognised facts, collecting unrecognised words as problems.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Parses each line, evaluates it with the action gate, and returns rows with the gate decision, advice and open questions, explaining why irreversible actions without a verification plan are blocked.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: Local bundle runner that serves a bundle's form page on 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch token, Host and Origin checks and strict security headers, stores model provider settings with owner-only file permissions, and runs the bundle so every result carries a reliability label.
nodes.languageNotes: Built on the standard library only: ThreadingHTTPServer, a handler class created inside a closure, and secrets.compare_digest for constant-time token comparison.

nodes.name: settings_path
nodes.summary: Returns the path of the bundles settings.json file under the G6 state directory.

nodes.name: load_settings
nodes.summary: Reads the stored model settings (provider, model, provider key), falling back to provider "none" on missing or invalid data.

nodes.name: save_settings
nodes.summary: Validates the provider and writes the model settings with owner-only file permissions, keeping or clearing the stored provider key.

nodes.name: public_settings
nodes.summary: Returns the settings that are safe to show the page: provider, model and whether a key is saved, never the key itself.

nodes.name: caller_from_settings
nodes.summary: Builds a model caller from stored settings by mapping them into the environment variables that g6.core.llm reads.

nodes.name: run_bundle
nodes.summary: Runs a bundle once, with a model caller when the bundle needs one, and always returns a labelled envelope; any exception becomes blocked-escalated with G6_E_BUNDLE_FAILED.

nodes.name: render_page
nodes.summary: Renders the self-contained HTML page for a bundle: escaped form fields, an optional model settings panel, the disclaimer, and inline script that posts to the token-protected endpoints and renders the labelled result table.

nodes.name: make_handler
nodes.summary: Builds the HTTP request handler class that serves the page, settings and run endpoints, enforcing Host and Origin checks, the launch token, body size limits and security headers.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the threaded HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 in a background thread with a fresh random token and returns the server, URL and token.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: Starts the runner, prints its address, optionally opens the browser, and waits until interrupted before shutting the server down.

nodes.name: shipped.py
nodes.summary: Registry of the bundles shipped in this version: imports each bundle module's BUNDLE and lists the eleven bundles in a fixed order; a bundle is listed only once it has an offline end-to-end test.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for counterexample-guided synthesis (CEGIS) of sketch holes. It re-exports Sketch, cegis, CegisResult, the input-domain and oracle types, the subprocess runner and the Z3 verifier, and its docstring shows the usage path and states that a result is at most qualified-draft.

nodes.name: _child.py
nodes.summary: Child process run as `python -I -m g6.cegis._child`, the only place candidate code runs. It reads one JSON request from stdin, lowers its own memory, CPU and file limits where the OS allows, compiles candidate source behind an AST pre-filter with a small builtins table, and either evaluates controls on inputs or searches for a control that fits every example.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the POSIX `resource` module to set rlimits before running code built with `compile`/`exec` in a restricted namespace. The docstring is explicit that this is a pre-filter plus resource bound, not an operating-system sandbox.

nodes.name: hole.py
nodes.summary: Defines sketch holes: `??` is an integer in a range, `??b` a boolean and `??{"a","b"}` one of a set of strings. Provides HoleKind, the Hole dataclass and extract_holes, which replaces each hole token with a numbered placeholder variable.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: Implements the CEGIS loop (fit the examples, check on the domain, add the counterexample) and CegisResult, whose status names only what was shown: no counterexample in the domain, unsat, timeout, inconclusive, or counterexample budget exhausted. An optional verifier's counterexample is confirmed by running the candidate before it is used, and the envelope never rises above qualified-draft.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Runs candidate code out of process. SubprocessRunner starts the `_child` module through g6.core.component_process with a wall-clock allowance, a kill of the whole process tree, an empty working directory and an environment with no secrets, then parses its JSON reply; the file also defines the Runner protocol, SearchResult and the RunnerError and RunnerTimeout errors.

nodes.name: sketch.py
nodes.summary: Defines Sketch, a Python function with holes, built from source text. It validates the source, checks a control against each hole, fills the holes to produce concrete source and builds the wire form a runner's child process needs, without ever executing code itself.

nodes.name: verify.py
nodes.summary: Defines what a candidate is checked on and against: an explicit InputDomain (the full product or a seeded sample), TableOracle, answered (which leaves out inputs the oracle cannot answer) and check_candidate, whose Check is inconclusive when nothing was compared. Also defines the Verifier protocol and its Counterexample, NoCounterexample and Inconclusive outcomes.

nodes.name: z3_verifier.py
nodes.summary: Z3Verifier asks Z3, through g6.formal, whether any input of the whole domain makes a candidate break an SMT-LIB spec. It parses (never runs) the candidate's return expression into an SMT-LIB term, encodes the domain as constraints, and counts only sat and unsat as decisions; any other answer is Inconclusive.
nodes.languageNotes: Recursively walks Python `ast` nodes to translate a closed expression grammar (constants, names, arithmetic, comparisons, boolean operators, conditional expressions) into SMT-LIB text, raising Untranslatable for anything outside it.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The `g6` command-line entry point: an argparse front end with init, home, components, find, describe, invoke, state (ls, snapshot, rollback, export), doctor and bundle subcommands. It dispatches to the component registry, discovery, storage, snapshots and the bundle server.

nodes.name: doctor.py
nodes.summary: `g6 doctor`: a read-only installation check that writes nothing and makes no network calls. Each check (Python version, package, state folder, SQLite, optional extras, the configured model provider and its credentials, and whether every registered component imports) is ok, warn or fail with a plain-language fix.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the coding-agent gate: deterministic checks a coding agent runs before it acts (preflight) and before it reports work as done (verify_answer). It re-exports the gate functions, Evidence, VerifierResult, the shortcut detectors and the registry block.

nodes.name: coding_agent_gate_block.py
nodes.summary: CodingAgentGateBlock is the registry and MCP door to preflight and verify_answer, with no model call. Its Pydantic input models refuse unknown fields, accept only typed JSON arrays, and mark all incoming evidence and verifier results as caller-declared.

nodes.name: detectors.py
nodes.summary: Word and diff detectors for the gate: risk terms with negation handling, readiness overclaims, plain admissions that work is unverified, a text tripwire for shortcut phrasing, and scan_diff, a structural scan of unified diffs for added skip markers, `|| true`, `--no-verify`, removed or tautological assertions and removed tests.

nodes.name: evidence.py
nodes.summary: Typed evidence with provenance. An Evidence item counts only when it has the structure its kind needs (placeholders such as "none" or "tests pass" with no exit code are rejected with a reason), and VerifierResult reads only exact pass/fail words and exit codes, treating any non-zero exit as a failure.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: The gate's two floors: preflight (before acting) and verify_answer (before reporting done). Every rule emits a coded Finding, the verdict is the strictest severity, a pass needs at least one counted evidence item, and GateDecision maps down only to qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, never verified.

nodes.name: review.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in model review of a gate decision. tighten asks an LLM caller to review the decision and may only make it stricter; a weaker, unknown or unparseable reply, or a failed call, leaves the deterministic decision as it was.

nodes.name: __init__.py
