nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.context, which assembles a small, budget-bounded, provenance-labelled context packet for one agent call from a task, keyword matches in chosen directories and workspace notes. It re-exports the packet model, retriever, workspace, budget, scoring and redaction APIs.

nodes.name: assemble.py
nodes.summary: Packet assembly. build_packet retrieves repository handles, optionally re-ranks them with a caller-supplied re-ranker, cuts them to a share of the token budget and adds governance, task, component, note, verification-policy and output-contract items; assemble_packet records conflicts before merging, prunes without touching the task and rescores. It also builds bounded subagent packets and folds subagent reports into one untrusted item.

nodes.name: budget.py
nodes.summary: The token-budget floor. select_within_budget is the single truncation point for repository handles, and prune_packet drops items from the end of each section in a fixed order until the packet fits, never dropping the task or the output contract.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: score_packet recomputes a context packet's envelope from its content alone (recounted tokens, recorded conflicts, duplicate keys, stale items, missing sections) and never reads the packet's own labels. The best state is qualified-draft; a packet with no task, or no room for the task and output contract, is blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: packet.py
nodes.summary: The context packet model: Pydantic ContextItem, RepositoryHandle, ContextPacket, ContextScorecard and SubagentResult carrying provenance, authority, trust and freshness. Text is masked at creation, only trusted instruction items from governance, user intent or the task contract may be read as instructions, and the file also provides token estimates, an authority-ordered merge and conflict detection.

nodes.name: redact.py
nodes.summary: scrub masks secrets in text before it enters a packet, a file or a model call, replacing recognised token shapes (cloud key ids, common service tokens, JWTs, bearer tokens, PEM private keys, passwords in URLs) and values assigned to secret-like names with [REDACTED]. It is pattern-based, errs toward masking and is idempotent.

nodes.name: retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Keyword retrieval over configured root directories. Retriever walks the roots, skips ignored names and symlinks that leave them, and returns file-path and matching-line handles with masked snippets; load_handle reads one handle's file masked and capped, and refuses as blocked-escalated any handle that is malformed, outside the roots or not reproduced by the live filesystem.

nodes.name: workspace.py
nodes.summary: Workspace keeps the context package's on-disk state under one resolved root (memory notes, exemplars, compactions, retrieval logs, scorecards) with safe writers. File names come only from validated run ids and phases, every target must resolve inside the root, JSON goes through json.dumps and every string written is masked.

nodes.name: _limit
nodes.summary: Lowers the child process's own address-space, CPU-seconds and file-size limits through the POSIX resource module where it exists, before any candidate runs.

nodes.name: _compiled
nodes.summary: Fills a sketch's holes with a control, passes the source through the AST pre-filter, executes it in a restricted namespace and returns the named function, raising ValueError when it is refused or missing.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Equality of JSON values that keeps booleans distinct from integers and compares lists and dicts recursively.

nodes.name: _evaluate
nodes.summary: Handles the evaluate request: for each control it compiles the candidate and records each input's outcome as an ok value or an error message.

nodes.name: _fits
nodes.summary: Whether the candidate built from a control returns the expected value on every example.

nodes.name: _error
nodes.summary: Scores a control for the hill-climb: squared error where the candidate and expected values are both numbers, a very large penalty for any other mismatch, and infinity when the candidate does not compile.

nodes.name: _search
nodes.summary: Handles the search request: tries every control when the space is at most max_exhaustive (so a miss means the examples are unsatisfiable in the sketch), otherwise runs a seeded hill-climb with 20 restarts whose failure proves nothing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Reads one JSON request from stdin, applies resource limits, dispatches to evaluate or search, and writes one JSON reply to stdout.

nodes.name: HoleKind
nodes.summary: String enum of the three hole kinds: integer, boolean and string choice.

nodes.name: Hole
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one hole with its id, kind, integer range or string choices; lists every value it may take, checks whether a value is acceptable and serialises itself for the wire.

nodes.name: extract_holes
nodes.summary: Scans source left to right, replaces each hole token with a numbered placeholder variable and returns the rewritten source with the parsed holes, rejecting malformed tokens or an empty integer range.

nodes.name: CegisResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a CEGIS run (status, control, program, iterations, counterexamples, boundary, trace, reason) that maps its status to a completion state and builds the library envelope with a G6_E_* warning card.

nodes.name: cegis
nodes.summary: Runs the synthesis loop: collects the oracle's answers on the domain, searches for a control that fits the examples, checks the candidate on every answered input, optionally asks a verifier for a counterexample and confirms it by running the candidate, and adds counterexamples until a budget or timeout ends the run.

nodes.name: RunnerError
nodes.summary: Raised when the child process could not give an answer because it was refused, crashed or replied with something unreadable.

nodes.name: RunnerTimeout
nodes.summary: Raised when the child's wall-clock allowance ran out and it and every process it started were killed.

nodes.name: SearchResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding the control found (or None), the search method, whether the search was exhaustive and how many controls were tried.

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Protocol for anything that can evaluate controls on inputs and search for a control that fits a set of examples.

nodes.name: SubprocessRunner
nodes.summary: Runner that makes each evaluate or search call one contained child process, bounded by a wall-clock timeout and a memory cap, and validates the shape of every reply before returning it.

nodes.name: Sketch
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a function with holes: from_src validates the function name and source and extracts the holes, check fills defaults and refuses invalid values, instantiate produces concrete source, and as_wire packages what the runner's child needs.

nodes.name: TableOracle
nodes.summary: An oracle that is a table of input/output examples; looking up an input it does not list raises KeyError, so that input counts as unanswered.

nodes.name: InputDomain
nodes.summary: The inputs a candidate is checked on: the product of each argument's values, or a seeded sample of max_inputs of them when the product is larger, with describe naming which so a result states its own boundary.

nodes.name: answered
nodes.summary: Returns the inputs the oracle answers with a JSON value, paired with the answer; inputs it raises on or answers with non-JSON are left out for the caller to count as skipped.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one check of a candidate on the domain: its status, how many inputs were compared and skipped, and any counterexample with expected and actual values.

nodes.name: check_candidate
nodes.summary: Runs the candidate on every answered input through a Runner; the first disagreement or candidate error is a counterexample, and a check that compared nothing is inconclusive.

nodes.name: Counterexample
nodes.summary: Verifier outcome naming an input of the domain on which the candidate breaks the spec, with evidence.

nodes.name: NoCounterexample
nodes.summary: Verifier outcome saying no input of its encoded domain breaks the spec; a decision on the caller's encoding, so at most qualified-draft.

nodes.name: Inconclusive
nodes.summary: Verifier outcome with no decision and a stable reason such as z3_unknown or z3_timeout; it is degraded and never read as "no counterexample".

nodes.name: Verifier
nodes.summary: Protocol for an optional second check: find_counterexample returns a Counterexample, NoCounterexample or Inconclusive for a candidate on a domain.

nodes.name: Untranslatable
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when the candidate or the domain is outside what the translator reads exactly.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Recursively translates a Python expression node into an SMT-LIB term with its sort (Int or Bool), covering constants, names, unary and binary arithmetic, boolean operators, chained comparisons and conditional expressions.

nodes.name: candidate_term
nodes.summary: Parses candidate source (never running it), requires one plain function whose plain-name arguments match the domain and whose body is a single return statement, and translates that return expression into an SMT-LIB term and sort.

nodes.name: domain_constraints
nodes.summary: Encodes an InputDomain as SMT-LIB sorts and constraints: a contiguous integer range becomes bounds, other integers a listed disjunction up to a cap, and booleans a Bool; any other value type is Untranslatable.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Turns the solver's answer into a verifier outcome: unsat is NoCounterexample, sat with a model inside the domain is a Counterexample, and an error code, missing decision or model outside the domain is Inconclusive.

nodes.name: Z3Verifier
nodes.summary: Verifier that checks a candidate against an SMT-LIB spec naming `result` on every input of the domain through g6.formal, with a per-check timeout. It refuses a spec that does not name `result` and returns Inconclusive when translation fails or the solver does not decide.

nodes.name: _bundle
nodes.summary: Lists the ready-made bundles, or serves the chosen one locally and opens it in the browser, reporting an unknown bundle id with exit code 2.

nodes.name: _state
nodes.summary: Handles the state subcommands: list snapshots, save one, roll back to one (snapshotting the current state first), or export the state folder to a zip with credentials left out.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Builds the argparse parser for every g6 subcommand and dispatches each to its handler, the doctor checks, the registry, discovery or storage, returning a process exit code.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one doctor check: its name, ok/warn/fail status, detail and a plain-language fix.

nodes.name: _home
nodes.summary: Checks that the G6 state folder exists or can be created and is writable, suggesting G6_HOME when it is not.

nodes.name: _model
nodes.summary: Checks the configured G6_LLM_PROVIDER: none and a local Ollama pass without contact, a named cloud provider needs its credentials variable set (and the SDK for one of them), and an unknown provider fails.

nodes.name: _components
nodes.summary: Imports every registered component and reports how many import, naming each broken one with its error, or fails when no components are found.

nodes.name: run_checks
nodes.summary: Runs every doctor check against the given or current environment and returns the list of Check records.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON-ready summary of the checks with an overall status that is the worst single status.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Formats the checks as readable text lines with their fixes and the overall status.

nodes.name: EvidenceIn
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for one evidence item (kind, ref, output, exit code, reviewer) that refuses unknown fields and allows only caller-declared provenance.

nodes.name: VerifierIn
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for a verifier result (status, exit code, source) that refuses unknown fields and allows only caller-declared provenance.

nodes.name: CodingAgentGateInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the block: the op (preflight or verify_answer), task, answer, proposed action, task contract, constraints, claims, evidence, verifier, declared risk level, author and request and run ids.

nodes.name: CodingAgentGateBlock
nodes.summary: Registry block whose infer answers ops and help, requires a task, converts validated input into Evidence and VerifierResult objects, runs preflight or verify_answer, and returns the decision with its envelope; advisory unless the caller obeys it.

nodes.name: negated
nodes.summary: Whether a negating word appears among the five words before a position, within the same clause.

nodes.name: risk_hits
nodes.summary: Finds risk terms named as whole words anywhere in the task and declared material, and in the agent's own answer only where no negation governs the mention.

nodes.name: shortcut_hits
nodes.summary: Text tripwire returning shortcut labels named in the text that no negation (or repair verb) governs; a hit blocks, but an empty list proves nothing.

nodes.name: scan_diff
nodes.summary: Structural scan of a unified diff: skip markers, `|| true` and no-verify flags on added lines, plus assertions or tests removed or commented out.

nodes.name: overclaims
nodes.summary: Returns readiness or verification claims in the text that no negation governs, so "not verified" does not count as a claim.

nodes.name: acknowledges_unverified
nodes.summary: Whether the text says plainly that the result is unverified.

nodes.name: is_placeholder
nodes.summary: True when text says nothing: empty, a sentinel such as "none" or "not run", or a bare "tests pass".

nodes.name: Evidence
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one evidence item (file, test, log, review and so on) with provenance; problem returns why the item does not count for its kind, and to_dict serialises it.

nodes.name: VerifierResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a verifier outcome whose effective status is a failure on any non-zero exit code; parse reads only exact pass/fail words and exit codes and keeps anything else as not_run.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one coded rule finding with its severity and message.

nodes.name: stricter_of
nodes.summary: Returns the stricter of a trusted verdict and a proposed one; the proposal wins only when it is a known, strictly stricter word in the same vocabulary.

nodes.name: strictest
nodes.summary: The verdict a list of findings forces: the strictest severity, or the vocabulary's lowest word when there are no findings.

nodes.name: surface_state
nodes.summary: Maps a verdict to a completion state, down only: qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, never verified.

nodes.name: tier_of
nodes.summary: Computes the risk level and the risk terms behind it; a declared level may raise the computed one but never lower it, an unrecognised word reads high, and no risk term gives medium.

nodes.name: GateDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen result of preflight or verify_answer: verdict, risk level, findings, counted and rejected evidence and verifier details, with helpers for review needs, evidence basis and the library envelope.

nodes.name: _sort
nodes.summary: Splits evidence into counted items and rejected items paired with the reason each fails its kind's structure check, raising TypeError for anything that is not Evidence.

nodes.name: preflight
nodes.summary: Checks a coding task before the agent acts: scans the proposed action and any diff evidence for shortcuts, reads risk terms to set the risk level, requires a named review for high-risk work, and requires counted evidence, since a plan never counts as evidence.

nodes.name: verify_answer
nodes.summary: Checks a drafted answer before it is reported done. It flags an empty answer, shortcuts in the text or diff, a missing task contract, failing tests or verifier, no counted evidence, claims without an inspected file, readiness claims without a passing run (or on caller-declared runs without saying unverified), and high-risk work with no named review.

nodes.name: tighten
nodes.summary: Asks an LLM caller to review a gate decision and returns it unchanged or stricter, never weaker, adding at most one finding and marking a failed call as degraded.

nodes.name: assemble_packet
nodes.summary: Builds a scored packet from any list of items: records conflicts before the authority merge, places items by section, prunes to the budget and recomputes the envelope.

nodes.name: _rerank
nodes.summary: Sends the masked query and candidates to the optional caller-supplied re-ranker and reorders by the valid indices it returns, appending the rest; it keeps keyword order, with the reason recorded, when the call fails or names no valid index.

nodes.name: build_packet
nodes.summary: Assembles a scored packet for a task within a token budget: governance, task, component metadata, matching workspace notes, a verification-policy line, the output contract and the repository handles that fit their share of the budget.

nodes.name: subagent_packet
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded child packet for a subagent with governance, the task, up to five component and verification items, the output contract and its own task, but no repository text, at most ten handles and 2,000 tokens.

nodes.name: synthesize_subagent_results
nodes.summary: Folds subagent reports into one untrusted model_output memory item.

nodes.name: select_within_budget
nodes.summary: Takes handles in order while their running token total stays within the budget, stopping at the first that would exceed it.

nodes.name: prune_packet
nodes.summary: Drops the last items of each section in prune order until the packet fits its budget, keeps repository handles in step with dropped repository items, and never removes the task or output contract.

nodes.name: _metadata_evidence
nodes.summary: Builds G6_E_* warning evidence from a packet's assembly metadata: a truncated repository walk, unreadable files, missing roots, and whether the re-ranker was used or fell back to keyword order.

nodes.name: score_packet
nodes.summary: Recomputes a packet's scorecard from its items, handles and recorded merge losers: token use, staleness, conflicts, empty retrieval and missing sections, with the completion state and warning card that follow.

nodes.name: _card
nodes.summary: Builds the G6_E_* warning card for a completion state from the collected evidence.

nodes.name: rescore_packet
nodes.summary: Returns the packet with used_tokens and its envelope fields replaced by those score_packet recomputes.

nodes.name: utc_now_iso
nodes.summary: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO 8601 string.

nodes.name: AuthorityLevel
nodes.summary: Integer enum ordering how much weight a context item carries, from model-generated (lowest) through exemplar, operational, component, task contract and user intent up to governance.

nodes.name: validate_name
nodes.summary: Returns a value only if it is safe as a single file-name component, otherwise raises ValueError.

nodes.name: ContextItem
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for one datum with provenance, authority, trust and freshness. It masks its text at creation, keeps retrieved excerpts, notes and model output untrusted and at most operational authority, and lets only trusted instruction items from governance, user intent or the task contract act as instructions.

nodes.name: RepositoryHandle
nodes.summary: Pydantic model pointing at a repository file or one matching line, with a relative path, masked snippet, content identity and summary; the file is loaded on demand.

nodes.name: ContextPacket
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a sectioned context bundle for one agent call, carrying validated run id and phase, repository handles, conflicts, token budget and the cross-surface envelope fields computed by score_packet.

nodes.name: ContextScorecard
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of what score_packet recomputed from a packet: counts, budget ratio, stale and conflict counts, empty retrieval, missing sections and the envelope fields.

nodes.name: SubagentResult
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for what a subagent reported (agent id, task, summary, evidence, unresolved items), with no self-assigned label.

nodes.name: estimate_tokens
nodes.summary: Rough token estimate for a text from its length.

nodes.name: item_tokens
nodes.summary: An item's token cost: its declared estimate, but never less than its text, so a low declared estimate is not trusted.

nodes.name: packet_tokens
nodes.summary: Total recounted token cost of every item in a packet.

nodes.name: merge_context_items
nodes.summary: Keeps one item per key: the highest authority wins, and on a tie the later item wins.

nodes.name: find_conflicts
nodes.summary: Lists every key that carries more than one distinct value and how the merge resolves it, flagging ties at the top authority; run before the merge discards the losers.

nodes.name: scrub
nodes.summary: Returns text with every recognised secret replaced by [REDACTED], applying the token-shape patterns and the secret-name assignment pattern.

nodes.name: Retrieval
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the keyword candidates for one query and what limited them: files scanned, truncation at max_files, capping, unreadable files and missing roots.

nodes.name: query_terms
nodes.summary: Splits a query into its lower-cased words of three or more characters, treating slashes as separators.

nodes.name: Retriever
nodes.summary: Keyword retriever over a set of root directories: walks files with ignore rules and symlink containment, masks snippets with the built-in scrub plus an optional extra masker, returns path and line-match handles, and can recheck whether a handle is a real candidate on the live filesystem.

nodes.name: LoadedText
nodes.summary: Frozen result of load_handle: masked file text labelled as untrusted data, with truncation and masking flags and the envelope fields.

nodes.name: load_handle
nodes.summary: Reads the file behind a handle, masked and cut to at most 20,000 characters, or refuses it as blocked-escalated when the handle is malformed, resolves outside the roots, is not reproduced for the query, or cannot be read.

nodes.name: budget_ratio
nodes.summary: Recounted tokens over the packet's token budget, or 0.0 when there is no budget.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.summary: Manages one resolved state root: writes retrieval logs, scorecards, compaction summaries and memory notes under validated names inside the root, and reads back masked memory and exemplar notes that match a query with their freshness.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root of the shared kernel: defines the three reliability labels (verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated) and resolves core names such as AIBlock, BlockContract, EvidenceBundle and the executor protocols lazily on first access, so importing g6.core has no side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level __getattr__ (PEP 562) to import the owning submodule on first attribute access and cache the value in globals().

nodes.name: adaptation_gate.py
nodes.summary: Validates an adaptation proposal against pre-registered positive and negative control cases and decides whether it may be promoted; the gate blocks on unknown verdicts, rejects on failures, refuses automated reviewers and changes to protected evaluator paths, and grants at most isolated shadow use.

nodes.name: is_automated
nodes.summary: Returns True when a reviewer name starts with the automated prefix (auto:), so the promotion gate can refuse machine reviewers.

nodes.name: protected_hits
nodes.summary: Lists the touched paths that reach what judges a proposal (gates, judges, verifiers, ledgers, approvals, tests and test configuration), which a proposal may not change.

nodes.name: AdaptationProposal
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a proposed change to a component: source cases, intended change, predicted benefit, falsifiers, test plan, candidate and baseline hashes, cost cap and rollback; validates every field on construction and exposes a content digest.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: A pre-registered control case: a negative case the candidate guard must flag or a positive case it must let through, with its author recorded.

nodes.name: LocalValidation
nodes.summary: Result of running a candidate guard over the controls, bound to the proposal content digest so a proposal edited after validation no longer matches.

nodes.name: validate_locally
nodes.summary: Runs the candidate guard on every control, requires at least one negative and one positive control not authored by the proposer, and returns a LocalValidation with per-control outcomes and reasons.

nodes.name: PromotionDecision
nodes.summary: Immutable record of the gate disposition for one proposal, with policy version, reviewer, reasons, evidence hashes and verdicts, plus a digest.

nodes.name: decide_promotion
nodes.summary: The promotion gate: combines the local validation, regression, budget and security verdicts, reviewer identity and owner confirmation into a PromotionDecision that blocks, rejects, or allows isolated shadow use only.

nodes.name: ai_block.py
nodes.summary: Defines AIBlock, the generic composable unit every component is or wraps, with infer, verify, bias and contract hooks, and PipelineBlock, which chains two blocks and carries per-stage evidence, warning cards and the worst completion state forward.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic[Input, Output, State] typing plus an overloaded >> operator (__rshift__) give a typed pipeline-composition syntax.

nodes.name: AIBlock
nodes.summary: Base class for a unit of AI computation: infer turns input into a Result, verify runs a registered per-harness verifier and returns an EvidenceBundle, and contract returns the declared BlockContract or a permissive default; blocks chain with then or >>.

nodes.name: PipelineBlock
nodes.summary: Two AIBlocks chained in sequence; runs the left block then the right, stops at the first failure, and annotates the result with per-stage evidence, warning cards and the worst completion state.

nodes.name: _stage_evidence
nodes.summary: Collects the evidence items a stage result carries and tags each with the stage name.

nodes.name: _annotate_result
nodes.summary: Attaches merged evidence, the warning card, the completion state and the failed stage onto a pipeline Result.

nodes.name: approval_authority.py
nodes.summary: Server-side authority that issues, checks, consumes and revokes approval records, so human approval is recorded by a trusted party instead of being asserted by the caller; every check fails closed and is bound to an exact agent and operation scope.

nodes.name: ApprovalError
nodes.summary: Raised when an approval cannot be issued (missing reviewer, scope, decision or policy version); never raised when a check merely fails.

nodes.name: disclosure_digest
nodes.summary: Computes a stable SHA-256 digest of a disclosure notice, or an empty string when there is none, so audit views can bind to what the reviewer was shown.

nodes.name: ApprovalRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one approval decision: reviewer, scope, decision, expiry, run binding, single-use flag, consumed and revoked times, issuer kind, policy version and disclosure; reports liveness and a redacted audit view without the bearer id.

nodes.name: ApprovalAuthority
nodes.summary: Trusted, control-plane-side issuer and checker of approvals on a pluggable store: issue mints a random bearer id, check verifies a live approval for an exact scope and can consume it atomically, and revoke and purge manage the lifecycle.

nodes.name: get_approval_authority
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide ApprovalAuthority, building it lazily on the store chosen by configured_store.

nodes.name: reset_approval_authority
nodes.summary: Drops the process-wide authority so the next call rebuilds it, for tests and reconfiguration.

nodes.name: require_approval_record
nodes.summary: Reads the environment to decide whether a caller-asserted approval boolean is refused (default: refused).

nodes.name: require_review_approval_record
nodes.summary: Reads the environment to decide whether a caller-supplied review-approval dictionary is refused (default: refused).

nodes.name: normalize_agent_name
nodes.summary: Collapses agent names with and without the job_ prefix into one canonical name for scope matching.

nodes.name: approval_scope_for_operation
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical scope string for an agent and operation approval.

nodes.name: check_operation_approval
nodes.summary: Convenience check that verifies, and optionally consumes, an approval for one agent and operation, requiring a human issuer when asked; fails closed on any error.

nodes.name: approval_store.py
nodes.summary: Backing stores for the approval authority: an in-memory store and a durable SQLite store that records approvals as an append-only, hash-chained event log, so consent survives restarts, is visible across processes and can be checked for tampering.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SQLite WAL mode and immediate write transactions to serialise read-compute-write across processes, and replays each approval's events to rebuild its current state.

nodes.name: entry_hash
nodes.summary: Domain-separated SHA-256 chain hash over the previous hash, approval id, event name and payload JSON.

nodes.name: _enable_wal
nodes.summary: Switches a SQLite connection to WAL journaling, retrying while a peer holds the lock; best effort and never raises.

nodes.name: ApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Protocol listing what the approval authority needs from a store: put, get, atomic try_consume, mark consumed or revoked, purge and clear, plus a durability flag.

nodes.name: InMemoryApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Process-local dictionary store that keeps the original behaviour behind the store interface, with the same atomic consume contract under a lock.

nodes.name: SqliteApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Durable, cross-process, append-only store that writes approval events to a hash-chained SQLite log, replays them to rebuild records, consumes single-use approvals atomically, and verifies the whole chain against a stored anchor.

nodes.name: configured_store
nodes.summary: Chooses the store for the process-wide authority: SQLite at the path named by an environment variable, otherwise in memory.

nodes.name: block_contract.py
nodes.summary: Defines BlockContract, a block's self-declared promises (purpose, inputs, outputs, failure modes, cost, verification method, stop conditions, review rules, extension points), with reliability cards, registries for named preconditions, stop conditions and detectors, and dict serialisation for cross-process transport.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses validated in __post_init__; after deserialisation an unknown named precondition fails closed while unknown stop conditions and detectors never fire.

nodes.name: FailureType
nodes.summary: String enum classifying the kind of failure a declared failure mode represents.

nodes.name: FailureMode
nodes.summary: A known way a block can go wrong: name, detector, severity, description and failure type.

nodes.name: ComponentExample
nodes.summary: A titled input and output example a component publishes about itself.

nodes.name: ComponentTemplate
nodes.summary: A named, prebuilt payload template a component offers.

nodes.name: SourceToolRequirement
nodes.summary: Declares a source or tool a component needs.

nodes.name: ComponentReliabilityCard
nodes.summary: Versioned, operator-facing card of a component's declarations (purpose, inputs, outputs, failure modes, cost, verification, review level, examples, templates); validate lists missing fields and, in production, also requires typed failure modes, a concrete verification method, examples and templates.

nodes.name: CostEstimate
nodes.summary: Self-declared cost envelope (p50 and p95 tokens, p95 wall time and p95 spend) that the truthfulness checks hold actual usage against.

nodes.name: BlockContract
nodes.summary: Frozen declaration of what a block promises and how to check it; validates its fields and failure-mode codes on construction, resolves the human-review predicate for a risk level, and builds the block's reliability card.

nodes.name: _contract_enforce_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves whether contract violations raise or warn, from an override variable or the production run mode.

nodes.name: _handle_contract_violation
nodes.summary: Raises or logs a contract violation with a stable error code, according to the enforce mode.

nodes.name: permissive_default
nodes.summary: Builds the no-op default contract for an unmigrated block by name.

nodes.name: register_precondition
nodes.summary: Decorator that registers a precondition callable by name so contracts can refer to it.

nodes.name: register_stop_condition
nodes.summary: Decorator that registers a stop-condition callable by name.

nodes.name: register_detector
nodes.summary: Decorator that registers a failure-mode detector callable by name.

nodes.name: _unresolved_precondition_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in precondition for an unknown name that fails closed.

nodes.name: _unresolved_stop_condition_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in stop condition for an unknown name that never fires.

nodes.name: _unresolved_detector_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in detector for an unknown name that never fires and records the gap.

nodes.name: contract_to_dict
nodes.summary: Serialises a BlockContract into a plain dict, replacing callables with their registered names, for cross-process transport.

nodes.name: contract_from_dict
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a BlockContract from a contract_to_dict payload, resolving named callables through the registries and rebuilding nested types such as ExtensionPoints and StateSurface.

nodes.name: component_process.py
nodes.summary: Runs owned child processes inside a trusted call window that carries a deadline and an operator stop, killing the whole process tree on timeout or stop and capturing bounded output.

nodes.name: ContainmentFailure
nodes.summary: Error raised when process cleanup cannot be confirmed, so even a declared read is not retried.

nodes.name: ExecutionInterrupted
nodes.summary: Timeout error raised when a trusted allowance ends; records whether an operator stop caused it.

nodes.name: CallWindow
nodes.summary: Deadline, stop-request callback, execution accounting and any containment failure for one call window.

nodes.name: window
nodes.summary: Context manager that opens a trusted call window with a deadline and an optional stop check; when nested it keeps the tighter deadline, combines the stop checks and rolls child process accounting up into the outer window.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checks the current call window, re-raising a recorded containment failure or raising ExecutionInterrupted when the operator stop fires or the allowance has expired, and returns the remaining seconds.

nodes.name: run_process
nodes.summary: Starts a child in an owned process tree within the current window, waits for it to exit or for the window to end, and kills the tree on interruption.

nodes.name: run_contained
nodes.summary: Runs a child with given input bytes and bounded capture of its output streams, including output tails when interrupted.

nodes.name: contract_decorator.py
nodes.summary: Provides the @block_contract class decorator, which attaches a declarative contract payload to a component class at import time without side effects, and a resolver that turns that payload into a BlockContract.

nodes.name: block_contract
nodes.summary: Class decorator factory that takes every BlockContract field (purpose, inputs, failure modes, cost, verification method, review rules, examples, templates and more) and stores them on the class for lazy resolution.

nodes.name: get_block_contract_attr
nodes.summary: Resolves a class's decorator payload into a concrete BlockContract, filling the name from the class, or returns None when the class is undecorated.

nodes.name: decision_record.py
nodes.summary: Defines the decision lifecycle for action logic: an enum of states from draft through verified to closed, revised or rolled back, an allowed-transition table, prohibited shortcuts, transition helpers and a serialisable DecisionRecord.

nodes.name: DecisionState
nodes.summary: Enum of decision lifecycle states: DRAFT, OBJECTIVE_DEFINED, OBSERVED, MODELLED, FORECASTED, COORDINATED, AUTHORISED, EXECUTED, VERIFYING, VERIFIED, then CLOSED, REVISED or ROLLED_BACK.

nodes.name: can_transition
nodes.summary: Returns whether a move between two decision states is allowed and not on the prohibited list; unknown states return False.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Moves a decision to a new state, raising on a prohibited or unknown transition.

nodes.name: DecisionRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one decision: id, current state, objective contract reference and state history, serialisable to a dict.

nodes.name: discovery.py
nodes.summary: Progressive discovery for agents (find, describe, ops) built only on what registered components declare about themselves, ranking matches by a transparent token-overlap score; it never composes, validates or labels anything.

nodes.name: ops
nodes.summary: Returns the ops a component lists for itself through its own ops operation, or an empty list.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Ranks registered components by token overlap with a query and returns scored matches, or an empty list when nothing matches.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Returns what a component is, how mature it is and the ops it exposes.

nodes.name: env.py
nodes.summary: Shared run-mode helpers that resolve the effective mode from an explicit argument or the G6_ENV variable and decide whether it counts as production, for fail-closed checks.

nodes.name: resolve_run_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves the run mode from an explicit value, then G6_ENV, then empty, normalised for comparison.

nodes.name: is_production_env
nodes.summary: Returns True when the resolved run mode is production or prod.

nodes.name: evidence.py
nodes.summary: Evidence types returned by harness verification: claims, test results, source references, assumptions, detailed evidence records and the portable EvidenceBundle, each serialisable to a dict.

nodes.name: Claim
nodes.summary: Frozen claim with type, evidence and counterevidence references, risk level, evidence grade, epistemic status, falsification conditions, confidence (checked to lie in 0 to 1) and validity times.

nodes.name: TestResult
nodes.summary: Name, pass flag, command and output reference of one test run.

nodes.name: SourceRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a source by URI, with title, type and excerpt.

nodes.name: Assumption
nodes.summary: A stated assumption with its risk and how it would be validated.

nodes.name: EvidenceRecord
nodes.summary: Detailed record of one piece of evidence: source, whether it supports or opposes, independence group, authority, method quality, recency, integrity hash and declared verification method.

nodes.name: EvidenceBundle
nodes.summary: Portable evidence returned by per-harness verification: claims, tests run, sources, assumptions, open questions, confidence, verifier id, time and evidence records.

nodes.name: evidence_grade.py
nodes.summary: Canonical evidence grade (kernel, instrument, model) with crosswalks to ledger oracle kinds, risk-policy E-levels, verification method names and completion labels; only kernel-grade evidence warrants verified, the others cap at qualified-draft.

nodes.name: grade_rank
nodes.summary: Ordinal for comparing grades: model 0, instrument 1, kernel 2.

nodes.name: warrants_verified
nodes.summary: Returns True only for kernel-grade evidence.

nodes.name: grade_from_oracle_kind
nodes.summary: Maps a ledger oracle kind to a grade, defaulting to model when unknown.

nodes.name: grade_from_e_level
nodes.summary: Maps a risk-policy E-level (E0 to E3) to a grade, defaulting to model when unknown.

nodes.name: e_level_from_grade
nodes.summary: Maps a grade back to the E-level that gate decisions expect.

nodes.name: grade_from_verification_method
nodes.summary: Grades a verification method by its registered ceiling; a kernel-ceiling method reaches kernel only when the check was independent and names a resolvable artifact, otherwise it is demoted.

nodes.name: max_completion_label
nodes.summary: Returns the strongest completion label a grade permits: verified for kernel, qualified-draft otherwise.

nodes.name: normalize_completion_label
nodes.summary: Converts underscore completion-state names to the hyphenated envelope form (verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated).

nodes.name: executor_contracts.py
nodes.summary: Versioned, immutable Pydantic wire records for model inference and coding-agent runs (requests, receipts, usage, capabilities, permissions, tasks, status, cancellations, artifact manifests) and the ModelProvider and CodingAgent protocols; they bind observations to requests but grant no authority.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic BaseModel records configured frozen, strict and extra-forbid, with field and model validators enforcing an exact contract version, timezone-aware timestamps, ordered lifecycles and content hashes.

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: Frozen, strict Pydantic base for every wire record: enforces contract version 1, timezone-aware datetimes and JSON encodability, and exposes a SHA-256 of its canonical JSON.

nodes.name: Money
nodes.summary: Wire amount in minor units with a three-letter currency code; never a budget authority.

nodes.name: ExecutorUsage
nodes.summary: Token and cost usage an executor reports, with scopes saying whether totals are complete or a lower bound, checked for consistency.

nodes.name: ModelIdentity
nodes.summary: Provider, model and optional revision naming a model.

nodes.name: ModelCapabilities
nodes.summary: Declared capabilities of a model adapter: models, features, context and output limits, local or remote execution, egress and whether it reports usage and cost.

nodes.name: InferenceRequest
nodes.summary: One inference dispatch with ids, model identity, input and settings JSON, required capabilities, token limits, cost ceiling, a single attempt, timeout and deadline.

nodes.name: _lifecycle
nodes.summary: Validates an execution record's state against its dispatch status and checks that its timestamps are present when required and in order.

nodes.name: InferenceReceipt
nodes.summary: Receipt for one inference with requested and observed model, dispatch, state, output, timestamps and usage; validates its lifecycle and checks that it binds to a given request.

nodes.name: ExecutionLimits
nodes.summary: Caps on model calls, tool calls, output tokens and bytes, runtime and cost for an agent run.

nodes.name: AgentPermissions
nodes.summary: Files an agent run may read and write, tools, network and effects; the write set must sit inside the read set.

nodes.name: AgentCapabilities
nodes.summary: Declared capabilities of a coding-agent backend: models, tools, effects, isolation, status, artifacts, cancellation, resume and limits.

nodes.name: AgentRequirements
nodes.summary: Mandatory declarations a task needs from an executor, separate from the permissions it may use.

nodes.name: AgentTask
nodes.summary: A coding-agent task with owner, mission, run and task ids, attempt, executor identity, workspace and baseline hashes, instructions, model, permissions, requirements, limits and deadline.

nodes.name: AgentRunHandle
nodes.summary: Correlation handle for a started agent run, built from a task with the task hash and checked against it.

nodes.name: AgentStatus
nodes.summary: Observed or reported status of an agent run with state, dispatch, timestamps, effects, progress, usage and receipts; lifecycle validated.

nodes.name: CancellationReceipt
nodes.summary: Receipt for a cancel request; acknowledgement or a stopped process requires an observation time and receipt reference.

nodes.name: FileArtifact
nodes.summary: One produced file with a validated relative path, content hash, size and content reference, buildable from text.

nodes.name: ArtifactManifest
nodes.summary: Manifest of a run's produced files with unique paths; matches checks the handle, baseline, write scope and actual byte hashes against a task.

nodes.name: agent_incompatibilities
nodes.summary: Compares a task's requirements with an agent's declared capabilities and lists each mismatch; a match grants neither permission nor qualification.

nodes.name: ModelProvider
nodes.summary: Protocol for a model backend: report capabilities and complete an InferenceRequest into an InferenceReceipt.

nodes.name: CodingAgent
nodes.summary: Protocol for a coding-agent backend: capabilities, execute, status, cancel and artifacts.

nodes.name: extension_points.py
nodes.summary: Declares a harness's extension surface (training-signal inputs, validation gate, allowed mutation surfaces) and provides the single opt-in check that both the MCP and REST surfaces call before shipping extension code to a target harness.

nodes.name: ExtensionPoints
nodes.summary: Frozen declaration of what a harness exposes for extension, validated on construction, including that its named validation gate is registered.

nodes.name: harness_opted_in
nodes.summary: Returns True only when the registry resolves the named component and its contract declares extension points; a resolution error, missing class or missing contract counts as not opted in.

nodes.name: extension_targets_opted_in
nodes.summary: Returns True only when every harness an extension targets has opted in.

nodes.name: failure_modes.py
nodes.summary: Global registry of failure-mode records keyed by stable string codes and seeded with defaults (for example hallucinated success, context loss, dependency breakage) that block contracts consult to validate declared failure modes.

nodes.name: FailureModeRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one failure mode: code, description, signals, detection, prevention, recovery, severity, human-review flag, source and aliases.

nodes.name: FailureModeRegistry
nodes.summary: Class-level registry that seeds default failure modes and supports register, get, list and membership checks by code.

nodes.name: ledger.py
nodes.summary: Append-only, hash-chained ledger of strict JSON entries, in memory or one line per entry in a file; verify and audit recompute every hash, a validate hook adds domain rules, an expected head detects tail truncation, and a write refuses when another writer extended the file.

nodes.name: LedgerError
nodes.summary: Raised for a record the ledger refuses to write.

nodes.name: LedgerCorrupt
nodes.summary: Raised for a ledger whose chain or references do not check out; it accepts nothing further.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serialises a value as sorted, compact, strict JSON, refusing NaN, infinities and values JSON cannot hold.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form of a value.

nodes.name: _verify
nodes.summary: Recomputes body, previous and entry hashes over a list of entries, checks kinds, ids and references with the optional validate hook, and returns the problems found.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Reads a ledger file line by line, parsing strict JSON without duplicate keys and collecting parse problems.

nodes.name: _file_head
nodes.summary: Returns the entry hash of a ledger file's last entry, an empty string for an empty file, or None when the file is missing.

nodes.name: ChainLedger
nodes.summary: The ledger itself: opens a file or memory chain, checks it against an expected head, appends entries after confirming the file was not extended by another writer, and exposes get, entries, head, verify and a read-only audit.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: A single explicit seam for model calls: the LLMCaller protocol and callers for Ollama, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Anthropic, plus fake, timing, empty-retry and no-model callers; the provider is chosen explicitly from G6_LLM_PROVIDER and never silently falls back to a paid one.

nodes.name: LLMError
nodes.summary: Raised when a model call fails or no model is configured, so the caller degrades honestly.

nodes.name: LLMCaller
nodes.summary: Protocol for a model caller: one system and user prompt in, one completion out.

nodes.name: authorized_completion_tokens
nodes.summary: Total completion tokens one logical call may spend across EmptyRetry attempts with their escalating budgets.

nodes.name: EmptyRetry
nodes.summary: Wraps a caller and retries an empty completion with a doubling token budget, raising after the last attempt instead of returning empty text.

nodes.name: FakeLLM
nodes.summary: Deterministic caller for tests and offline demos that records every call and still notes it as a model call.

nodes.name: TimingLLMCaller
nodes.summary: Wraps a caller and reports each call's latency, including failed calls, without letting a broken observer break the call.

nodes.name: NoModel
nodes.summary: Default caller when no model is configured; using it raises a named G6_E_NO_MODEL error.

nodes.name: _post_json
nodes.summary: Posts a JSON body to a URL with the standard library and parses the reply, turning HTTP and network errors into LLMError.

nodes.name: _Decoding
nodes.summary: Optional fixed temperature and seed settings for replayable comparisons, with an option to step the seed on each call.

nodes.name: OllamaCaller
nodes.summary: Calls a local model through the Ollama chat endpoint with optional decoding settings, noting each model call.

nodes.name: OpenAICompatibleCaller
nodes.summary: Calls any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio) with an optional provider key.

nodes.name: AnthropicCaller
nodes.summary: Calls Claude through the official anthropic SDK, creating the client lazily and noting each model call.

nodes.name: provider_from_env
nodes.summary: Builds the caller named by G6_LLM_PROVIDER (ollama, anthropic, openai, openrouter or none), defaulting to none and never guessing a paid provider.

nodes.name: extract_json
nodes.summary: Parses the first JSON object or array in a model reply, tolerating code fences and surrounding prose.

nodes.name: maturity.py
nodes.summary: Class decorators and readers that mark components with a maturity level and reason (levels such as production, beta, simulation_only and stubbed), declared capabilities and an observable flag.

nodes.name: component_maturity
nodes.summary: Decorator that marks a component class with a validated maturity level and optional reason.

nodes.name: get_maturity
nodes.summary: Returns a class's declared maturity level, or None when unmarked.

nodes.name: maturity_reason
nodes.summary: Returns the reason recorded with a class's maturity level.

nodes.name: component_capabilities
nodes.summary: Decorator that declares the capabilities a component provides.

nodes.name: get_capabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the capabilities declared on a component class.

nodes.name: observable
nodes.summary: Decorator that marks a component as emitting lifecycle events for monitoring.

nodes.name: is_observable
nodes.summary: Returns whether a class is marked observable.

nodes.name: model_calls.py
nodes.summary: Counts how many times this process, and one request scope, asked a language model; built-in callers note each call so an operation can report whether a model contributed, with cost attributed from the scoped count only.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a context variable for the per-request scope, so calls on threads that were not handed the context are counted process-wide but not in the scope.

nodes.name: note_model_call
nodes.summary: Records that a language model is being asked (or answered from a cache), in the process count and the open scope.

nodes.name: note_child_model_calls
nodes.summary: Imports a trusted child process's separate scoped and process totals without attributing its unscoped work to the request.

nodes.name: model_calls
nodes.summary: Returns the model calls noted in this process plus those imported from supervised children.

nodes.name: counting
nodes.summary: Context manager that counts the model calls noted in the current context while open and yields a reader for that count.

nodes.name: objective_contract.py
nodes.summary: Frozen ObjectiveContract describing an explicit objective (desired outcome, protected constraints, priorities, success and failure indicators, time horizons, stop conditions, authority) with an adequacy check and dict form.

nodes.name: ObjectiveContract
nodes.summary: Explicit objective required before acting; it counts as adequate only when it names a desired outcome, success indicators and stop conditions.

nodes.name: process_tree.py
nodes.summary: Owns a child process and every process it starts so kill ends all of them: on Windows a Job Object with kill-on-close and an optional memory cap, on POSIX a new session whose process group is killed. It is cleanup, not a sandbox.
nodes.languageNotes: Calls Win32 Job Object APIs through ctypes with no extra dependency; the child starts suspended and is resumed only after it has been placed in the job.

nodes.name: ProcessTreeError
nodes.summary: Raised when the process tree cannot be created, adopted or confirmed gone.

nodes.name: _Tree
nodes.summary: A started child and all its descendants; on kill it closes the Windows job or kills the POSIX process group, optionally confirming cleanup strictly.

nodes.name: _WinJob
nodes.summary: Windows Job Object wrapper with kill-on-close and an optional per-process memory limit; adopts a suspended process, resumes it, and on strict close waits until no members remain.

nodes.name: promotion_custody.py
nodes.summary: Client side of out-of-process evaluator custody: when a key file is configured, witness verification, replay-then-sign and receipt sealing are answered by spawning a separate evaluator service child that alone holds the key, failing closed on any gap.

nodes.name: custody_configured
nodes.summary: Returns True when an out-of-process evaluator custody service is configured through a key file path.

nodes.name: _service_env
nodes.summary: Builds a scrubbed environment for the evaluator child with only interpreter essentials, the import path and custody settings; the in-process evaluator key is never passed on.

nodes.name: _call_service
nodes.summary: Spawns the evaluator service child for one operation, passing the request through a temporary JSON file, and parses its last output line, returning a failed reply on any spawn, exit, timeout or parse problem.

nodes.name: verify_via_custody
nodes.summary: Checks a witness signature out of process; False on any gap.

nodes.name: stamp_replayed_via_custody
nodes.summary: Asks the child to replay the oracle and sign the witness only if it reproduces, mirroring the in-process contract.

nodes.name: sign_receipt_via_custody
nodes.summary: Seals an execution-receipt core out of process, returning an empty string on any gap.

nodes.name: verify_receipt_via_custody
nodes.summary: Checks a receipt seal out of process; False on any gap.

nodes.name: promotion_evaluator.py
nodes.summary: Evaluator authority for the kernel promotion law: HMAC-signs and verifies promotion witnesses, execution receipts and authored-oracle attestations with a key the generator does not hold, and mints a signed witness only after an independent oracle replay reproduces the result.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses domain-separated HMAC payloads and constant-time comparison; the custody client is imported lazily to avoid an import cycle.

nodes.name: evaluator_configured
nodes.summary: Returns True when an evaluator signing authority is available, either an in-process key or the out-of-process custody service.

nodes.name: evaluator_key_id
nodes.summary: Returns a non-secret fingerprint naming the current evaluator authority, or an empty string when none is set.

nodes.name: _signing_payload
nodes.summary: Builds the bytes a witness signature covers, binding the sealed content digest to the witnessed execution id.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: HMAC-signs a sealed witness core; raises when no authority is configured.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Returns True only when a witness carries a signature valid under the configured key, routing to custody when configured; fails closed.

nodes.name: stamp
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of a witness signed by the evaluator authority; the only in-process mint path for a signed witness.

nodes.name: _receipt_signing_payload
nodes.summary: Builds canonical, domain-separated bytes for an execution-receipt core.

nodes.name: sign_receipt
nodes.summary: HMAC-seals an execution-receipt core; raises when no authority is configured.

nodes.name: verify_receipt
nodes.summary: Returns True only when a signature seals exactly the given receipt core; fails closed.

nodes.name: sign_authored_oracle
nodes.summary: Attests that a test source is an oracle authored by G6; raises without a key.

nodes.name: verify_authored_oracle
nodes.summary: Returns True only when an attestation covers exactly the given test source; fails closed.

nodes.name: ReplayOutcome
nodes.summary: Result of the evaluator independently re-running an oracle: whether it reproduced the same verdict and the execution identity it observed.

nodes.name: register_oracle
nodes.summary: Registers an independent replay function for an oracle name.

nodes.name: oracle_registered
nodes.summary: Returns True when an independent replay is registered for an oracle name.

nodes.name: replay_reproduces
nodes.summary: Independently re-runs a witness's oracle and returns a ReplayOutcome, failing closed on a missing replay, a mismatch or any error.

nodes.name: stamp_replayed
nodes.summary: Replays the oracle independently and stamps the witness only when the result reproduces, routing to custody when configured.

nodes.name: protocols.py
nodes.summary: Defines the runtime-checkable structural typing protocols (ingest, emit, save/load, infer, learn, bias) that G6 block components implement, plus the SourceOps protocol and a frozen Pydantic descriptor for backend-native source operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol with @runtime_checkable, so isinstance checks work structurally without inheritance.

nodes.name: Ingestible
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that accept raw input through ingest() and return a Result.

nodes.name: Emittable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that produce output from internal state through emit() and return a Result.

nodes.name: Storable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that persist and restore their state with save(path) and load(path).

nodes.name: Inferrable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that run forward inference through infer(data); the component registry invokes blocks through this method.

nodes.name: Learnable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that update their parameters from labelled data through learn(data, labels).

nodes.name: InductiveBias
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that declare their structural assumptions about the hypothesis space through a bias property.

nodes.name: ConfigurableBias
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that accept runtime bias parameter updates from the evolution loop through configure_bias().

nodes.name: SourceOpsDescriptor
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model declaring a backend's supported source operations, capabilities, constraints, mutation surfaces and rollback support, with an allows(op) membership check and a JSON-safe public dump.

nodes.name: SourceOps
nodes.summary: Protocol for the backend-native source operation surface: capabilities, constraints, health, read, mutation intent and apply, rollback support and degradation report, each returning a Result.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Discovers G6 components lazily from g6 sub-packages flagged with __g6_component__ and from third-party entry points in the g6.components group, and invokes a component operation through its block's validated typed input, refusing bad requests with stable G6_E_* codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pkgutil.iter_modules and importlib.metadata.entry_points, so discovery works from an installed wheel as well as a source checkout; nothing is imported until it is asked for.

nodes.name: ComponentRef
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming a discovered component, its import module, and whether it is built in or an extension.

nodes.name: ComponentRegistry
nodes.summary: Lazily discovers built-in and extension components, imports a component module or block class on demand, describes its maturity and sensitive operations, and invokes an operation fail-closed: unknown components, missing blocks, sensitive operations on untrusted surfaces and invalid input are refused.

nodes.name: build_typed_input
nodes.summary: Validates a raw parameter dict against the Pydantic model annotated on a block's infer() parameter, mapping op to operation when needed, and returns the validated input or a coded error naming the first failing field.

nodes.name: get_registry
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide ComponentRegistry, creating it on first use.

nodes.name: reliability_envelope.py
nodes.summary: Defines the cross-surface ReliabilityEnvelope that carries the three reliability states (verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated) and the kernel promotion law, which lowers a proposed verified to qualified-draft unless an evaluator-stamped, digest-sealed promotion witness is attached; the law is staged by environment flags in off, shadow or enforce mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic model validators run the down-only reconciliation at construction time, so every door that builds an envelope applies the same law; the witness rides on extra='allow' so an envelope without one serializes unchanged.

nodes.name: promotion_law_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves G6_KERNEL_PROMOTION_LAW to off, shadow or enforce; any unrecognised non-empty value falls to enforce rather than off.

nodes.name: promotion_enforce_scope
nodes.summary: Parses G6_PROMOTION_ENFORCE_SURFACES into the set of surface component names that enforce mode is limited to, or None for an unset or wildcard value.

nodes.name: effective_promotion_law_mode
nodes.summary: Returns the promotion-law mode in effect for one surface component, narrowing enforce to shadow for components outside the configured enforce scope.

nodes.name: _witness_content_digest
nodes.summary: Computes a SHA-256 digest over the canonical JSON of a witness's core fields, leaving out execution provenance, the digest itself and the evaluator signature, so a rewritten verdict cannot keep its seal.

nodes.name: register_subject_binder
nodes.summary: Registers a component's subject binder: a callable that recomputes the execution identity a promoted result implies, so a witness earned for one output cannot promote another.

nodes.name: subject_binder_registered
nodes.summary: Reports whether a subject binder is registered for a component.

nodes.name: ensure_subject_binder
nodes.summary: Imports a known component's promotion module and calls its idempotent register() so the subject binder is present wherever the law runs; a failed import leaves the binding unknown and never raises.

nodes.name: require_subject_binding
nodes.summary: Reads G6_PROMOTION_REQUIRE_SUBJECT_BINDING to decide whether a missing subject binding counts as a fault (strict mode).

nodes.name: subject_execution_id
nodes.summary: Computes the execution identity a promoted result implies by running the component's registered subject binder, returning an empty string when it cannot be derived.

nodes.name: promotion_witness_faults
nodes.summary: Lists every promotion-law violation in a witness: missing or malformed witness, missing evaluator role or execution identity, task or run mismatch, broken content digest, subject-binding mismatch, and a failed evaluator verification; an empty list means the witness is valid.

nodes.name: build_promotion_witness
nodes.summary: Builds an evaluator-stamped promotion witness for an oracle execution, with task and run identity, verdict, timestamp and a sealing content digest.

nodes.name: _evidence_line
nodes.summary: Formats one evidence item (a string or a dict) as a short readable line, used when deriving the evidence_collected field.

nodes.name: _task_contract_floor_reasons
nodes.summary: Reads the task mode and success criteria carried on an envelope and returns the fit-for-purpose reasons that cap a proposed verified, using the shared task-contract verifier.

nodes.name: warning_card
nodes.summary: Builds a WarningCard from a code, message and suggested action and returns it as a plain dict.

nodes.name: envelope_fields
nodes.summary: Builds a ReliabilityEnvelope from keyword fields, attaching the promotion witness only when one is supplied, and returns the dumped dict that surfaces merge into their responses.

nodes.name: WarningCard
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a warning card with a stable code, message, suggested action, severity, why, risks, a verified flag and a next step; why and next_step copy the message and suggested action when unset.

nodes.name: EvidenceEntry
nodes.summary: Minimal Pydantic model for one evidence item with a source and a summary, allowing extra fields.

nodes.name: ReliabilityEnvelope
nodes.summary: Pydantic envelope carrying completion_state, reliability_label, warning card, evidence and request, task and run ids; its validators settle on the weakest honest state, apply the promotion law and task-contract floor to any proposed verified, and fill the required limitation or escalation fields for the other two states.

nodes.name: result.py
nodes.summary: Provides a lightweight railway-style Result type that wraps either a value or an error string, with ok and fail factories and map, flat_map and or_else combinators used at block boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic[Output] with a TypeVar gives typed Result[Output] values without any third-party dependency.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.summary: Enum of the two Result states, OK and FAIL.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Generic container holding a value or an error; offers ok and fail constructors, status checks, value, unwrap and error accessors that raise on misuse, and map, flat_map and or_else combinators that turn exceptions into failures.

nodes.name: risk_policy.py
nodes.summary: Applies the epistemic risk policy gate matrix: maps a claim's risk level (R0 to R3) and evidence grade (E0 to E3) to a disposition such as ALLOW, ASK, ESCALATE or BLOCK, loading the policy from a YAML spec with a built-in fallback and failing closed on unknown inputs.

nodes.name: load_epistemic_policy
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the epistemic policy YAML from the docs specs, falling back to a built-in default when the file is missing, unreadable or malformed.

nodes.name: minimum_grade_for
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum evidence grade configured for a risk level, defaulting to the strictest grade E3.

nodes.name: grade_meets
nodes.summary: Checks whether an actual evidence grade meets a required grade; an unknown grade never meets.

nodes.name: _min_e_level
nodes.summary: Returns the stricter of two evidence levels, treating an unknown level as strictest so it carries through.

nodes.name: _shadow_log_w4_floor
nodes.summary: Writes a log record when the certificate-grade floor would have tightened a decision while its flag is off, without changing behaviour.

nodes.name: gate_decision
nodes.summary: Decides the disposition for a claim from its risk level, evidence grade, conflict, human approval and rollback flags, optionally flooring the evidence level at a certificate grade when G6_RISK_POLICY_GRADE_FLOOR is on; R3 needs both human approval and rollback.

nodes.name: risk_signals.py
nodes.summary: Standard-library classifier that assigns a task's risk level R0 to R3 from signal words in its text, checking the highest level first, and lists every matched level and word pair for derived standards to cite.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Returns the first risk level whose signal words appear in the lowercased text, with its reason, or the R1 default when nothing matches.

nodes.name: signals
nodes.summary: Returns every matched (risk level, word) pair in the text, highest level first; empty when nothing matches.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Runs a Python script out of process in a fresh temporary directory with a wall-clock limit, memory, CPU and file-size caps, a scrubbed environment and a loopback-only network guard, and returns the files it leaves behind; it is a resource bound, not an operating-system sandbox.
nodes.languageNotes: A boot snippet run under python -I sets POSIX rlimits and wraps socket methods before runpy executes the script.

nodes.name: ScriptRun
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing how a script run ended (ok, error, timeout or refused) with return code, captured output, returned files, duration and limits.

nodes.name: interpreter
nodes.summary: Chooses the Python interpreter for the child process from an environment override, the current executable, or python3 or python on PATH.

nodes.name: run_script
nodes.summary: Writes the input files and the script into a temporary directory, runs it contained with time, memory, CPU and file-size limits, and returns a ScriptRun with decoded output and size-capped output files.

nodes.name: snapshots.py
nodes.summary: Snapshots and rolls back the G6 home state directory as zip files, copying SQLite databases through the backup API for consistency, taking a snapshot before each rollback so it can be undone, and exporting copies that leave out stored provider credentials.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one snapshot zip: name, path, size and file count.

nodes.name: _write
nodes.summary: Writes the state directory into a zip, copying each SQLite database with the backup API and skipping secret files unless told to include them.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a labelled, timestamped snapshot zip of the G6 home directory in its snapshots folder and returns its details.

nodes.name: list_snapshots
nodes.summary: Lists the snapshot zips stored under the G6 home directory.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Restores the G6 home directory from a named snapshot after first taking a safety snapshot of the current state, extracting only safe archive members.

nodes.name: export
nodes.summary: Writes a snapshot of the current state to a target path for sharing, always leaving out secret files and refusing to overwrite an existing file.

nodes.name: source_check.py
nodes.summary: AST pre-filter for small generated functions that refuses imports, interpreter-reaching builtins, global and nonlocal, underscore attributes and format-based attribute access, plus the safe builtins list; shared by the CEGIS and distillation runners.

nodes.name: validate_source
nodes.summary: Parses the source and walks its AST, returning the first reason it is refused (empty source, syntax error, imports, forbidden names or attributes, global or nonlocal) or an empty string when it passes.

nodes.name: state_surface.py
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass declaring how a harness persists state and how that state can be queried (scorecard, ledger or snapshot export), validating both values and requiring a retention setting.

nodes.name: StateSurface
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of persistence scope, query route and retention, with post-init checks that reject unknown values and an empty retention.

nodes.name: stop.py
nodes.summary: Process-wide emergency stop consulted before new work starts: engaged in process, by the G6_STOP environment variable, or by a STOP file in the G6 home directory, with an unreadable stop file counting as engaged.

nodes.name: stop_file
nodes.summary: Returns the path of the STOP file in the G6 home directory.

nodes.name: engage
nodes.summary: Engages the in-process stop under a lock, keeping the first reason given.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Clears the in-process stop; the environment variable and the stop file are left to whoever set them.

nodes.name: engaged
nodes.summary: Returns why the stop is engaged, checking the in-process flag, the G6_STOP variable and the STOP file in turn, or None when it is not engaged.

nodes.name: stopped
nodes.summary: Boolean form of engaged(), shaped for stop_requested callbacks.

nodes.name: storage.py
nodes.summary: Single root for durable G6 state under G6_HOME (default ~/.g6): resolves the root, builds paths that cannot escape it, and opens SQLite databases with WAL journaling and foreign keys on.

nodes.name: g6_home
nodes.summary: Returns the state root from G6_HOME, or the default ~/.g6.

nodes.name: state_path
nodes.summary: Builds a resolved path under the state root and raises when the parts would escape it.

nodes.name: open_db
nodes.summary: Opens a SQLite connection, placing bare names under the state root and creating parent folders, with rows readable by column name, WAL journaling and foreign keys on.

nodes.name: task_contract_verifier.py
nodes.summary: Shared predicates for task-contract fit-for-purpose gating: decides whether a criterion's verifier can actually run (a registered method, a registered promotion oracle or a named human review), resolves the staged enforce flags, and lists the reasons a proposed verified must be capped at qualified-draft.

nodes.name: verifier_available
nodes.summary: Returns whether a verifier name can actually run: a registered verification method, a registered promotion-law oracle, or a non-empty human: review name; a self-assessing model does not count.

nodes.name: _live_verification_names
nodes.summary: Returns the names in the live verification-method registry, loading the built-in methods first and falling back to an empty set on failure.

nodes.name: _promotion_oracle_registered
nodes.summary: Asks the promotion evaluator whether a name is a registered promotion-law oracle, returning False whenever that cannot be confirmed.

nodes.name: method_contract_enabled
nodes.summary: Reads G6_METHOD_CONTRACT and returns True only for 1, true or yes; it controls whether declared method contracts reach the fit-for-purpose checks.

nodes.name: task_contract_enforce_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves G6_TASK_CONTRACT_ENFORCE to off, shadow or enforce, falling to enforce for unknown values because the cap can only lower a state.

nodes.name: task_contract_enforce_scope
nodes.summary: Parses G6_TASK_CONTRACT_ENFORCE_SURFACES into the set of surface components the floor enforces on, or None for an unset or wildcard value.

nodes.name: effective_task_contract_enforce_mode
nodes.summary: Returns the floor mode for one component, narrowing enforce to shadow for components outside a configured scope and for seams with no surface identity.

nodes.name: task_contract_floor_reasons
nodes.summary: Lists the reasons a proposed verified must be capped: an exploratory task mode, or a critical success criterion with no available verifier; it never raises on malformed input.

nodes.name: validation_gates.py
nodes.summary: Registry of named validation gates in which enforcement is measured rather than asserted: each callable is probed with a request that authorises nothing when registered, and only one that refuses is recorded as enforced; four registered names are fail-open placeholders and only human_approval checks the approval authority.

nodes.name: _unimplemented_gate
nodes.summary: Placeholder that returns True for any input; registered so declared names pass spelling checks, but it validates nothing.

nodes.name: _human_approval_gate
nodes.summary: Checks an approval id against the server-side approval authority for a scope and run, returning False when the scope is empty, the authority is unavailable, or the approval is absent, expired, revoked, consumed or for another scope.

nodes.name: _can_deliver
nodes.summary: Checks by signature binding whether a null request of a given shape can be passed to a gate, so a binding failure is not mistaken for a refusal.

nodes.name: _null_request_verdict
nodes.summary: Probes a gate with each shape of a request that authorises nothing and reports authorised, refused (raising counts as refusing) or unmeasured.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a gate under a name and re-measures it, adding the name to the enforced set only when the gate refused the null request, and warning when it could not be probed.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns the gate callable registered under a name and raises for unknown names; a returned callable is not evidence of enforcement.

nodes.name: is_registered
nodes.summary: Spelling check that reports whether a gate name is registered, saying nothing about enforcement.

nodes.name: is_enforced
nodes.summary: Reports whether a gate name maps to a callable that was measured refusing the null request.

nodes.name: list_names
nodes.summary: Lists every registered gate name, enforcing and placeholder alike.

nodes.name: list_enforced
nodes.summary: Lists only the gate names backed by a measured, refusing implementation.

nodes.name: vault.py
nodes.summary: Evaluator-only read boundary that seals folders or files holding held-out answers, hidden tests and oracle code, records their digest, refuses reads by other roles by file identity and resolved location, and writes incidents to a ledger; because it is an in-process software check, results resting on it are reported as unblinded.

nodes.name: AccessDenied
nodes.summary: PermissionError raised when a role that may not read sealed files tries to.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Frozen record of sealed roots, a read-only manifest of file digests and file identities; seal() builds it and records it in a ledger, covers() tests membership by identity or location, and verify_unchanged() reports and records changes since sealing.

nodes.name: guarded_read
nodes.summary: Reads a file for a role: the evaluator reads freely, other roles are refused for sealed paths, and the file identity is re-checked on the opened handle before the bytes are returned.

nodes.name: blinding_status
nodes.summary: Reports that results resting on this vault are unblinded, because enforcement is an in-process software check rather than an operating-system separation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Per-harness registry of named verification methods that return evidence bundles, with register, get, is_empty and list_names helpers.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a verification method under a non-empty name and returns it.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns the verification method registered under a name, raising KeyError for unknown names.

nodes.name: is_empty
nodes.summary: Reports whether no verification methods are registered.

nodes.name: list_names
nodes.summary: Returns the sorted names of the registered verification methods.

nodes.name: methods.py
nodes.summary: Built-in verification methods that turn a block's output into evidence bundles (acceptance criteria, evidence coverage, reliability pipeline self-check, formal methods and CSF checks) and register them under their names at import time.

nodes.name: acceptance_criteria_check
nodes.summary: Returns an evidence bundle recording whether the block produced any output, with confidence 0.5 or 0.
