nodes.name: evidence_coverage_check
nodes.summary: Returns an evidence bundle recording whether the output carries evidence or sources.

nodes.name: reliability_pipeline_self_check
nodes.summary: Reads the output's verification report and completion state and returns an evidence bundle that passes only when no checks failed, nothing is unverified and the result is not blocked.

nodes.name: formal_methods_verification
nodes.summary: Returns an evidence bundle recording whether formal-methods output is present and structured.

nodes.name: csf_verification
nodes.summary: Returns an evidence bundle recording that CSF output does not raise an unsafe or blocked flag.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.csf, which computes safety bounds and checks on a caller-supplied agent model (reachability bound, finite-trace LTL, failure composition, rollback feasibility and git checkpoints); it re-exports the public API and marks the package as a beta component with no block.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level markers (__g6_component__, __g6_maturity__, __g6_requires__) are how the component registry discovers and describes this package.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composes two failure-probability bounds into a bound on either part failing, using the Frechet (Boole) sum by default and the independence formula only when the caller asserts independence.

nodes.name: compose_bound
nodes.summary: Returns min(1, eps1 + eps2), or eps1 + eps2 - eps1*eps2 when independence is asserted, after checking both epsilons lie in [0, 1].

nodes.name: smt.py
nodes.summary: Optional Z3-based check of whether a finite-trace LTL property holds on every positive-probability path of a BoundedAgent model: it encodes the property and model as SMT terms, asks Z3 for a violating path, re-checks any counterexample with the LTL evaluator, and labels results qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, never verified.
nodes.languageNotes: Z3 is reached only through g6.formal.check_sat, so the module imports cleanly without the solver and reports a stable error code instead.

nodes.name: SMTEncoding
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding the property, parsed formula, horizon, states, Z3 variable declarations, assertions and a goal that is satisfiable exactly when some path violates the property.

nodes.name: _formula
nodes.summary: Parses a property string or accepts an LTL formula, refusing parse errors and atoms that name no agent state with stable error codes.

nodes.name: agent_to_smt
nodes.summary: Encodes an agent's states, initial state and every positive-probability transition, together with each subformula of the property over steps 0..N, into SMT assertions and a violation goal.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Builds the SMT term for one LTL subformula at one time step, following the finite-trace semantics past the last step.

nodes.name: SMTCheck
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a bounded LTL check (holds, counterexample path and probability, error code and reason, model and solver evidence); it maps to qualified-draft only when the property holds and converts to a G6_E_* warning-card envelope.

nodes.name: _path_probability
nodes.summary: Returns a path's probability under the agent's transition kernel, or None when it is not a path of the model.

nodes.name: check_z3
nodes.summary: Runs the SMT check through g6.formal.check_sat and returns holds, a re-checked counterexample with its probability, or a refusal such as an encoding mismatch or a missing solver.

nodes.name: ltl.py
nodes.summary: Finite-trace LTL support: formula dataclasses, a recursive-descent parser, a bottom-up evaluator whose cost is formula size times trace length, and a printer, with limits on formula length and nesting depth.
nodes.languageNotes: Evaluation fills a (subformula, position) table bottom-up instead of recursing, which keeps cost linear in formula size times trace length.

nodes.name: LTLAtom
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for an atomic proposition named by an identifier.

nodes.name: LTLNot
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the negation of a subformula.

nodes.name: LTLAnd
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the conjunction of two subformulas.

nodes.name: LTLOr
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the disjunction of two subformulas.

nodes.name: LTLNext
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the next-step operator X.

nodes.name: LTLAlways
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the always operator G.

nodes.name: LTLEventually
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the eventually operator F.

nodes.name: LTLUntil
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the until operator U over two subformulas.

nodes.name: LTLRelease
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the release operator R over two subformulas.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Splits an LTL formula string into identifiers, operators and parentheses, enforcing the maximum formula length.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser over tokens with precedence levels for or, and, until and release, and the unary operators, enforcing the nesting depth limit.

nodes.name: parse_ltl
nodes.summary: Parses an LTL string into a formula tree, raising ValueError on malformed input or leftover tokens.

nodes.name: _nodes
nodes.summary: Lists a formula's distinct subformulas in bottom-up order, children before parents.

nodes.name: _past_end
nodes.summary: Gives each subformula's truth value past the last trace position (G and R true; atoms, F, X and U false).

nodes.name: _table
nodes.summary: Fills a truth table of every subformula at every trace position bottom-up, checking that trace values are booleans.

nodes.name: evaluate_ltl
nodes.summary: Evaluates a formula on a finite trace at a given position using the bottom-up truth table.

nodes.name: ltl_to_str
nodes.summary: Prints a formula tree back into the module's LTL syntax.

nodes.name: rollback.py
nodes.summary: Rollback feasibility and git checkpoints: classifies a plan's operations against one shared vocabulary, where an unknown operation is never assumed reversible, and provides a GitCheckpoint that commits tracked files and hard-resets only when explicitly allowed and only at a repository's top level.

nodes.name: classify_operation
nodes.summary: Returns reversible, irreversible or unknown for an operation name from the shared OPERATIONS vocabulary.

nodes.name: RollbackFeasibility
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a static rollback check listing irreversible and unknown operations, reversible steps and a snapshot schedule; it maps to qualified-draft when feasible and blocked-escalated otherwise, with a G6_E_* warning card.

nodes.name: rollback_feasibility
nodes.summary: Validates a plan's operations and horizon, classifies each operation and returns a RollbackFeasibility that is feasible only when every operation is reversible.

nodes.name: GitCheckpoint
nodes.summary: Snapshots tracked changes as a commit and, only when built with allow_reset=True, runs git reset --hard to a commit, confining every git command to the repository top-level root and dropping variables that point git elsewhere.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Defines the finite Markov chain model that g6.csf computes on (BoundedAgent, ResourceTriple, TransitionOutcome) with one shared validator that refuses any model whose transitions are not a complete probability distribution over declared states (G6_E_CSF_MODEL_INVALID). Also holds the epsilon and id input checks and the labelled helper that wraps csf results in the reliability envelope.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses use InitVar and object.__setattr__ in __post_init__ to validate and normalise fields once, at construction.

nodes.name: verifier.py
nodes.summary: Computes reachability_bound, a union-bound (Boole's inequality) upper bound on the probability that a BoundedAgent reaches an unsafe state within N steps, by propagating the state distribution forward from step 0. Returns a SafetyReport labelled qualified-draft when the bound is within epsilon and blocked-escalated when it is not, never verified.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.debate that re-exports the debate loop, its data types and the two agreement readings. Its docstring documents the round and agent limits, that agreement between samples of one model is never verification, and what was left out of the older archive.

nodes.name: agreement.py
nodes.summary: Measures how far a debate's agents agree: overlap_agreement is a lexical key-word overlap floor, and judge_agreement adds one model call that judges agreement by meaning beside that floor. Both results reach qualified-draft at best, and blocked-escalated when fewer than two agents gave a usable turn.

nodes.name: debate.py
nodes.summary: The debate loop: role-named agents answer a question in turn through one injected LLM caller, with hard limits on rounds and agents checked before any call. A failed turn is kept as a degraded Exchange with path-redacted error text, never replaced by canned output.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.distillation that re-exports the held-out admission check (Candidate, HoldoutCase, evaluate) and the bounded out-of-process runner for small distilled functions.

nodes.name: admission.py
nodes.summary: Decides whether a distilled candidate function can be trusted on held-out cases it never saw: evaluate runs it out of process, refuses holdout cases that overlap its training cases, and requires a negative control that fails (plus an optional positive control that passes). An optional baseline adds a paired win/loss comparison with a one-sided exact sign test.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Runs a small generated solve(x) function out of process with wall-clock and memory limits through g6.core.sandbox, after the shared AST pre-filter and a size check on the source. Inputs and outputs travel as JSON, and each input yields one Run outcome.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for epistemic integrity that re-exports the deterministic claim adjudicator and its AIBlock wrapper, and names EpistemicIntegrityBlock as the component's block.

nodes.name: adjudicator.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, LLM-free claim adjudication floor: splits a message into atomic claims, classifies each, maps action criticality to risk levels R0-R3, collapses correlated evidence into lineages, grades evidence E0-E3, detects contested claims, caps confidence by grade and applies the fail-closed risk-by-evidence gate. Per-claim dispositions combine into the most restrictive overall disposition.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component metadata for epistemic integrity: owner, spec document path, related components, a high risk level, no allowed autonomy and stateless rollback. Its status notes record that only the evidence-grading stage functions are used downstream, so the adjudicate dispositions do not bind answers.

nodes.name: epistemic_integrity_block.py
nodes.summary: Thin AIBlock wrapper over the deterministic adjudicator: takes a pydantic input (op, message, action criticality, evidence, approval and rollback flags), converts evidence dicts into EvidenceRecord values and returns the adjudication payload with llm_used set to false. Declares its block contract, known failure modes and beta maturity.

nodes.name: honesty.py
nodes.summary: Registers the adjudication_at_tests detector, a self-consistency check that flags any adjudicated claim carrying evidence grade E0 together with an unlabelled ALLOW disposition. It catches a policy file edit that would silently loosen runtime enforcement.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.evidence that re-exports the certificate issuer, its value types (Check, Receipt, Control, Artifact, MissionFacts) and the offline verify function.

nodes.name: certificate.py
nodes.summary: The certificate issuer, the one place a mission's completion state is decided: issue gives each predicate a Belnap support/refute value from receipts taken on the exact artifact bytes, applying the A4 grounding rule (independent or formal check, not self-authored, frozen before the artifact, a G6-generated negative control killed). It returns verified, qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with every gap named, and verify re-checks a certificate's internal consistency offline.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses validate themselves in __post_init__ and raise CertificateRefused, so an inconsistent check, receipt or control cannot be constructed.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.formal that re-exports the Z3 checks, the pure-Python DPLL path, the typed solve facade, recheck and the result schemas. Its docstring states that the best label is qualified-draft and lists what was not carried over from the archive.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: The one place a g6.formal result is labelled: apply_envelope marks any result with an error code as blocked-escalated and a recorded solver decision as qualified-draft, attaching a warning card, evidence (queries, solver, version), request_id and run_id. Also defines the allowed backends, the stable G6_E_FORMAL_* codes with suggested actions, and the Refusal exception.

nodes.name: facade.py
nodes.summary: Provides solve, which validates one LogicalQuery and sends it to Z3 or the propositional DPLL while refusing any field that names another engine, and solver_support, which probes whether Z3 works here and reports the DPLL as pure Python.

nodes.name: proof_artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Provides recheck, which rebuilds a ProofArtifact's statement and queries from its sorts, assumptions and goal, confirms they match what was recorded, and runs every query again on the installed solver to confirm the same answers.

nodes.name: propositional.py
nodes.summary: A pure-Python DPLL SAT solver for Boolean formulas: tokenises and parses infix or function-style formulas, converts them to CNF by distribution under a clause bound (FormulaTooLarge), and decides them with unit propagation and pure-literal elimination. check_propositional returns the decision as a labelled FormalResult whose evidence says it is pure Python.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written recursive-descent parser (_Parser) with one method per precedence level, IFF loosest and NOT tightest, producing tuple trees.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for g6.formal: SolverCheck, ProofArtifact, the labelled FormalResult and ValidityResult, and the LogicalQuery input. The completion state type admits only qualified-draft and blocked-escalated, and extra fields are forbidden so no other engine or caller confidence can ride along.
nodes.languageNotes: A Literal type makes verified an impossible completion_state value, and extra="forbid" rejects unknown fields at validation time.

nodes.name: z3_bridge.py
nodes.summary: Runs Z3 checks on SMT-LIB terms over caller-declared Int, Real or Bool symbols: satisfiability, validity (with vacuous-premise and assumed-conclusion detection), entailment and counterexample search. Z3 is imported only when a check runs, every term and query is checked against a closed grammar before Z3 reads it, and unknown or a timeout is never read as a decision.
nodes.languageNotes: Z3 is an optional dependency loaded on demand; each check builds a fresh solver so no state is shared between calls.

nodes.name: CSFError
nodes.summary: Base exception for g6.csf carrying a stable G6_E_CSF_* code and a plain-language reason.

nodes.name: CSFInputError
nodes.summary: Raised for inputs g6.csf will not compute on, such as an invalid model, epsilon, horizon, id or operation list; it is both a CSFError and a ValueError.

nodes.name: check_epsilon
nodes.summary: Checks that epsilon is a finite real number in range and returns it as a float, raising CSFInputError otherwise.

nodes.name: check_id
nodes.summary: Checks that a request or run id is a string, raising CSFInputError otherwise.

nodes.name: _check_states
nodes.summary: Validates the declared states: a non-empty sequence of unique string names within the MAX_STATES limit.

nodes.name: TransitionOutcome
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one outgoing transition: the next state and its probability.

nodes.name: validate_transitions
nodes.summary: The single validator for transition rows: each row needs exactly from, to and probability, declared state names and a finite probability, with no duplicate edge, and every state's outgoing probabilities must sum to 1 within tolerance. Returns the kernel of successors keyed by source state.

nodes.name: ResourceTriple
nodes.summary: Frozen declared bounds of a model: the horizon N (between 1 and MAX_HORIZON) used by every check, plus steps per action T and memory units M, which are recorded in evidence only.

nodes.name: BoundedAgent
nodes.summary: Frozen finite Markov model of an agent: states, validated transitions kept as a kernel, the initial state, declared unsafe states and resource bounds, all checked in __post_init__. describe returns the model as plain data for evidence.

nodes.name: labelled
nodes.summary: Wraps a csf result dataclass in the library reliability envelope with a warning card, evidence and ids, accepting only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated as the state.

nodes.name: StepHazard
nodes.summary: Frozen per-step record: the probability mass in unsafe states at one step and the running bound up to and including it.

nodes.name: SafetyReport
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a reachability bound: epsilon, the union bound vub, whether it meets epsilon and the per-step terms. Its completion_state is qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, and to_envelope returns it with a G6_E_CSF warning card and the model and assumptions as evidence.

nodes.name: _unsafe_mass_by_step
nodes.summary: Propagates the state distribution forward from the initial state over the horizon and returns the probability mass in unsafe states at each step, step 0 included.

nodes.name: reachability_bound
nodes.summary: Public entry point: checks the agent, epsilon and ids, sums the per-step unsafe mass into a union bound capped at 1, and returns a SafetyReport.

nodes.name: _final_positions
nodes.summary: Collects each agent's last usable turn from a transcript, skipping mock, canned and failed turns, so each agent votes once.

nodes.name: OverlapResult
nodes.summary: Frozen lexical agreement result: level, overlap fraction, dominant position, dissent, voters and ignored turns. completion_state is qualified-draft with at least two voters and blocked-escalated otherwise, and to_envelope wraps it in the reliability envelope.

nodes.name: overlap_agreement
nodes.summary: Computes the lexical agreement floor: for each agent's final position, counts how many others share enough key words, picks the dominant agent and maps the overlap fraction to a none, weak, moderate or strong level.

nodes.name: JudgeResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of the model judge beside the lexical floor: the judged level, dominant position, dissent and rationale, whether it diverged from the floor, and any error. The state is computed by code, never taken from the model.

nodes.name: _read_reply
nodes.summary: Parses and checks the judge's JSON reply, requiring a known agreement level, a dominant position and a rationale, and normalising the dissent list.

nodes.name: judge_agreement
nodes.summary: Computes the lexical floor, then makes one LLM call asking the model to judge agreement by meaning, returning a JudgeResult that keeps the floor and records an error instead of failing when the call or its parse breaks.

nodes.name: error_text
nodes.summary: Formats an exception as one short line with local filesystem paths redacted, since errors reach the envelope's warning card.

nodes.name: AgentRole
nodes.summary: String enum of debate roles: proposer, critic, devil_advocate, synthesiser and verifier, used only as words in each agent's prompt.

nodes.name: DebateAgent
nodes.summary: Frozen pairing of an agent name with its AgentRole; the role has no persona, model or tools of its own.

nodes.name: Exchange
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one debate turn: agent, role, round, response, evidence kind, degraded flag and error. usable is true only for a non-empty, non-degraded model reply.

nodes.name: Transcript
nodes.summary: Frozen question, context and ordered exchanges of a debate; degraded reports whether anything but clean model output is present, and history_text renders the prompt history from usable turns.

nodes.name: is_mock
nodes.summary: Reports whether a transcript is anything other than clean model output: it has no turn, or some turn is mock, canned or failed.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Checks debate inputs before any model call: a non-empty question, a caller, rounds within MAX_ROUNDS, agent count within MAX_AGENTS, and unique non-empty agent names, raising ValueError with G6_E_DEBATE codes.

nodes.name: run_debate
nodes.summary: Runs rounds times agents turns in order, one llm.complete call each, with a prompt holding the role, question, context and earlier usable turns. A turn that raises or returns no text is recorded as degraded with redacted error text.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: Frozen distilled function: source defining solve(x), the episodes it came from and the training case ids it was made from; digest is the SHA-256 of the source.

nodes.name: HoldoutCase
nodes.summary: Frozen evaluator-owned case: id, the input the candidate receives and the expected value it never sees.

nodes.name: HoldoutReport
nodes.summary: Frozen admission report with a passed, failed, inconclusive or refused verdict, case outcomes, control results and an optional baseline comparison; completion_state is qualified-draft only for passed, and to_dict serialises it.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: JSON equality used to score outputs: bools by identity, numbers equal within 1e-9 relative or absolute, and lists and dicts compared recursively.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs a candidate on held-out cases with the required controls: refuses empty or duplicate holdouts, leaked training cases and refused sources, runs candidate and controls out of process, adds a paired sign test against an optional baseline, and returns a HoldoutReport verdict.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Frozen outcome for one input: status ok, error, timeout or refused, with the value or a reason; ok is true for status ok.

nodes.name: check_source
nodes.summary: Returns why a source may not run: over the character limit or refused by the shared AST pre-filter; empty when it may run.

nodes.name: run_batch
nodes.summary: Runs solve(x) for every input in one bounded child through g6.core.sandbox.run_script, mapping refused sources, non-JSON inputs, timeouts, child errors and mismatched outcomes to Run values.

nodes.name: run_sandboxed
nodes.summary: Runs solve on a single value in a bounded child by delegating to run_batch.

nodes.name: AdjudicatedClaim
nodes.summary: Frozen pairing of an adjudicated Claim with the EI and AT markers it triggered; to_dict flattens both.

nodes.name: AdjudicationResult
nodes.summary: Frozen message-level result: the adjudicated claims plus the overall most restrictive disposition and overall epistemic status.

nodes.name: atomise
nodes.summary: Splits a message into atomic claims on sentence ends, semicolons and the conjunctions and/but.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Types a claim as CAUSAL, NORMATIVE_OR_OPINION, RECOMMENDATION, PREDICTIVE or EMPIRICAL from marker phrases.

nodes.name: assign_risk
nodes.summary: Maps a declared action criticality to a risk level R0-R3, treating an unrecognised value conservatively as R2.

nodes.name: collapse_independence
nodes.summary: Groups evidence records by independence group so correlated sources count as one lineage, with ungrouped records collapsed into a single lineage.

nodes.name: grade_evidence
nodes.summary: Grades evidence E0-E3 from deduplicated lineages: E0 for model assertion only, E1 for one lineage, E2 for a primary source or two independent lineages, E3 for two independent lineages that are primary or high authority.

nodes.name: certificate_grade
nodes.summary: Returns the best declared certificate grade (model, instrument or kernel) across supporting non-model records, or None when no record declares a verification method.

nodes.name: detect_contested
nodes.summary: Reports a claim as contested when independent non-model lineages both support and oppose it.

nodes.name: confidence_ceiling
nodes.summary: Caps confidence by evidence grade, lowering it further to 0.5 when the claim is contested.

nodes.name: most_restrictive
nodes.summary: Returns the most restrictive disposition in a list, ranked from ALLOW up to BLOCK.

nodes.name: adjudicate_claim
nodes.summary: Adjudicates one atomic claim: classifies it, assigns risk, collapses and grades evidence, detects contest, caps confidence and applies the fail-closed risk-by-evidence gate, then tightens the disposition for vague wording without scope, missing numeric context, unsupported causal language and abstention cases.

nodes.name: adjudicate
nodes.summary: Adjudicates a whole message: atomises it, adjudicates each claim against the shared evidence, and combines them into the most restrictive disposition and a priority-ordered overall status.

nodes.name: EpistemicIntegrityInput
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic input for the block: op (adjudicate, ops or help), message, action criticality, evidence dicts, and human-approval and rollback flags.

nodes.name: _to_records
nodes.summary: Converts caller evidence dicts into EvidenceRecord values, keeping only known fields and defaulting the source identifier.

nodes.name: EpistemicIntegrityBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing adjudicate, ops and help: adjudicate requires a message, runs the deterministic adjudicator and returns its payload tagged with the component name and llm_used false.

nodes.name: detect_unsupported_claim_allowed
nodes.summary: Registered detector that returns true when any claim in the output has evidence grade E0 and an unlabelled ALLOW disposition.

nodes.name: CertificateRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when the issuer's inputs contradict one another or the mission, listing every problem found.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: Frozen negative control: a seeded defect for one predicate run against one version of a check's code, with who generated it, its ledger position and whether it was killed.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen check description: predicates covered, author, evidence kind, code hash, freeze position, controls, optional formal certificate digest and positive-control position, all validated on construction.

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one check run on specific artifact bytes, with its pass, fail or unknown result and ledger position.

nodes.name: Artifact
nodes.summary: Frozen artifact identity: SHA-256 digest, producer and ledger position.

nodes.name: PredicateStatement
nodes.summary: Belnap statement for one predicate: support and refute flags, the receipts behind each, and caveats; verified only with support, no refutation and no caveat.

nodes.name: grounding
nodes.summary: Lists why a check does not meet the A4 grounding rule for a predicate on an artifact: wrong evidence kind, formal check without a certificate, self-authored, frozen after the artifact, or no sound G6-generated killed negative control.

nodes.name: catalogue_sha
nodes.summary: Hashes the operation catalogue (op, effect and authority rows) a mission was judged against, for recording on the certificate.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.summary: Frozen certificate: mission, standard, catalogue and artifact hashes, state, predicate statements, gaps, receipts, formal support, re-run list, violations, decisions, cost bound and solvability. as_dict serialises it with its digest.

nodes.name: digest_of
nodes.summary: Computes a certificate's unkeyed SHA-256 digest over its canonical JSON, excluding the digest field.

nodes.name: MissionFacts
nodes.summary: Frozen mission facts the issuer needs: mission and standard hashes, predicates, gates, soundness violations, cost bound and catalogue hash.

nodes.name: _refusals
nodes.summary: Collects every contradiction in the issuer's inputs: standard hash or predicate mismatch, missing artifact hash or producer, duplicate check or receipt ids, unknown predicates, receipts for unfrozen checks and decisions on unknown gates.

nodes.name: issue
nodes.summary: Issues the certificate: refuses contradictory inputs, builds each predicate's support and refute values from receipts on the exact artifact bytes using the A4 grounding and control-backing rules, and sets the state to verified, qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with every gap named.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Re-checks a certificate body offline: its digest and artifact bytes, that its state follows from its own statements, that every support is backed by a pass receipt, that formal entries come only from verified formal support, and, when given, the mission, standard and predicates.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception for a check that cannot produce a usable decision, carrying a stable G6_E_FORMAL_* code and the reason.

nodes.name: apply_envelope
nodes.summary: Labels a FormalResult or ValidityResult from what it records: refuses unknown backends, marks vacuous or circular validity, rejects results with no decision or a decision made by another engine, then sets state, warning card, evidence and ids and re-validates through the schema.

nodes.name: _card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card: a blocked card with a suggested action for an error code, or an amber solver-decision card naming the engine that decided and saying it is not verified.

nodes.name: _evidence
nodes.summary: Builds the evidence entry for a result: backend, engine, whether pure Python or an external solver ran, elapsed time, the artifact's recorded queries and any vacuity, circularity or error details.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Validates a LogicalQuery (or a mapping of its fields) and routes it to check_propositional or Z3 check_sat.

nodes.name: _refused
nodes.summary: Turns a query validation failure into a labelled blocked-escalated FormalResult, using G6_E_FORMAL_BACKEND_REFUSED when a field named another engine.

nodes.name: solver_support
nodes.summary: Probes Z3 with a trivial query and reports each backend, what it is, whether it is pure Python and whether it is available here.

nodes.name: recheck
nodes.summary: Rebuilds an artifact's statement and queries, checks they match the recorded ones (and that an unsat validity query carries its premise-consistency check), then re-runs each query and returns (True, how) only when the solver answers the same way, never raising on a tampered artifact.

nodes.name: FormulaTooLarge
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a formula or its CNF passes the size bounds of the pure-Python path.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenises a Boolean formula into identifiers, operator words and symbols, enforcing the character limit.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser over the token list with one method per precedence level: IFF, right-associative IMPLIES, OR, AND, NOT, and primary atoms, constants, function forms and parentheses.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a formula string into a tuple tree through _tokens and _Parser, raising FormulaTooLarge or ValueError for input it cannot accept.

nodes.name: to_text
nodes.summary: Renders a formula tree back to canonical text, used for recorded queries and artifact checks.

nodes.name: _or
nodes.summary: Combines two clause sets under OR by distribution while building CNF, raising FormulaTooLarge past MAX_CLAUSES.

nodes.name: _cnf
nodes.summary: Converts a formula tree to CNF clauses by recursive distribution, tracking polarity to push negation inward.

nodes.name: _dpll
nodes.summary: Recursive DPLL over clause sets with unit propagation and pure-literal elimination, returning a satisfying assignment or None.

nodes.name: _solve
nodes.summary: Converts a tree to CNF, runs DPLL and completes the assignment over all atoms and declared variables.

nodes.name: dpll_solve
nodes.summary: Bare decision procedure with no label: returns a satisfying assignment for a formula over its atoms and declared variables, or None.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Answers sat or unsat for one canonical query, used by recheck.

nodes.name: artifact_queries
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a propositional ProofArtifact's statement and query from its assumptions, refusing artifacts whose fields are not canonical.

nodes.name: check_propositional
nodes.summary: Decides whether a formula plus assertions is satisfiable with the pure-Python DPLL, parsing each input separately, recording a ProofArtifact and returning a labelled FormalResult; refusals become blocked-escalated results.

nodes.name: SolverCheck
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one query exactly as the solver read it and its sat, unsat or unknown answer.

nodes.name: ProofArtifact
nodes.summary: Frozen record of what was asked, of which solver and version, through which queries, with which answers; its statement, sorts, assumptions and goal determine the queries so recheck can rebuild them.

nodes.name: FormalResult
nodes.summary: Labelled satisfiability result: satisfiable is None when the solver did not decide, and model holds a satisfying assignment when it is true.

nodes.name: ValidityResult
nodes.summary: Labelled validity result for premises entailing a conclusion, with valid, vacuous, conclusion_assumed and counterexample fields.

nodes.name: LogicalQuery
nodes.summary: Typed input for solve: formula, solver (z3 or propositional), variables, assertions, a bounded timeout and ids, with unknown fields forbidden.

nodes.name: load_z3
nodes.summary: Imports the optional z3 module on demand, raising a Refusal with G6_E_FORMAL_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE when it is not installed.

nodes.name: z3_version
nodes.summary: Returns the installed Z3 version string, loading Z3 first.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Tokenises SMT-LIB text into a nested tree within character and depth limits, rejecting any character outside the closed allowed set.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Reads one caller term, accepting an optional (assert t) wrapper, and refuses anything that is not a single term or that uses an SMT-LIB command word.

nodes.name: _sorts
nodes.summary: Validates the caller's symbol declarations, mapping each name to Int, Real or Bool and refusing unknown sorts or invalid names.

nodes.name: _check_query
nodes.summary: Checks that a full query uses only declare-const, assert and one final check-sat before Z3 reads it.

nodes.name: run_query
nodes.summary: Runs one checked SMT-LIB query on a fresh Z3 solver with a timeout and returns its answer and model values, turning unknown, timeout and solver errors into Refusals.

nodes.name: artifact_queries
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a Z3 ProofArtifact's statement and expected queries from its sorts, assumptions and goal, for recheck.

nodes.name: check_sat
nodes.summary: Decides whether a formula plus assertions is satisfiable with Z3, recording the exact query in a ProofArtifact and returning a labelled FormalResult with a model when satisfiable.

nodes.name: _validity
nodes.summary: Shared validity procedure: decides UNSAT of premises and not-conclusion, then checks that the premises are satisfiable to flag a vacuous result and flags a conclusion already among the premises, returning a labelled ValidityResult with any counterexample.

nodes.name: check_validity
nodes.summary: Public check that a list of premises entails a conclusion, delegating to the shared validity procedure.

nodes.name: check_entailment
nodes.summary: Checks whether formula a entails formula b by running the validity procedure with a as the single premise.

nodes.name: find_counterexample
nodes.summary: Searches for an assignment that satisfies the constraints but breaks the claim, using the shared validity procedure.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the goal engine: re-exports the goal spec models, the plan-tree builder, the control evaluator, pause release and the predicate registry. Its docstring states that nothing here runs a goal; plans and control reports are qualified-draft at best.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel that sets __all__ plus __g6_component__ and __g6_maturity__ markers read by the component registry.

nodes.name: codes.py
nodes.summary: Defines the stable G6_E_GOAL_* error codes and two helpers that build the warning card and evidence entries every goal engine result carries. It limits the completion state to qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card dict for a goal engine result from WarningCard, with severity blocked for blocked-escalated and amber otherwise, and stamps the completion state on it.

nodes.name: evidence
nodes.summary: Builds one evidence entry holding a code, what it means and which function recorded it, plus any extra fields.

nodes.name: controls.py
nodes.summary: Evaluates every guardrail, checkpoint, resource bound and active breakpoint in force at one plan node against an executor Observation, returning a frozen ControlReport with may_proceed, pause requests and the reliability envelope. A pause is released only with an approval an ApprovalAuthority recorded for that exact scope.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen Pydantic models (ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")) make each report immutable and reject unknown fields.

nodes.name: ControlResult
nodes.summary: Frozen model for one guardrail or checkpoint read against an observation: kind, name, declaring node, predicate, verdict, reason and code.

nodes.name: PauseRequest
nodes.summary: Frozen model for an active breakpoint at a node; its scope names the spec digest, the node, the declaring node and the breakpoint, so an approval releases this pause and no other.

nodes.name: ControlReport
nodes.summary: Frozen report of all control results and pauses at one node, with blocked and may_proceed flags and the completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id and run_id envelope fields.

nodes.name: _scope_chain
nodes.summary: Resolves a dotted node id such as root.0.1 to the chain of spec nodes from the root down, or None when the id is not in the spec.

nodes.name: _results
nodes.summary: Collects control results for every node in a scope chain: the node resource bounds reported as a guardrail, then its guardrails and checkpoints.

nodes.name: evaluate_controls
nodes.summary: Main entry: checks the spec and observation types, resolves the node scope chain, gathers control results and pause requests, and returns a ControlReport that blocks on any failed or unknown guardrail or pending pause.

nodes.name: release_pause
nodes.summary: Releases a PauseRequest only when the given ApprovalAuthority holds a matching approval for the pause scope, returning the ApprovalRecord or None.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: Builds a PlanTree from the subtasks a GoalSpec declares, with dotted index ids, and lists every subtask it leaves out (blank goal, a control that cannot be built, or deeper than max_depth) with a stable code instead of dropping it silently.

nodes.name: PlanNode
nodes.summary: Frozen model of a kept plan node: dotted id, parent id, depth, goal and child ids.

nodes.name: DroppedNode
nodes.summary: Frozen model of a subtask left out of the plan, with its code, reason and the size of the subtree dropped with it.

nodes.name: PlanTree
nodes.summary: Frozen plan result holding kept, rejected and truncated nodes, the measured depth, the depth cap, the spec digest and the reliability envelope fields.

nodes.name: _problem
nodes.summary: Returns the rejection code and reason for a node whose goal is blank or whose guardrail or checkpoint predicates cannot be resolved, or None when the node can be planned.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.summary: Depth-first walk over the declared subtasks that assigns dotted ids, keeps plannable nodes and moves rejected or over-deep subtrees into the rejected and truncated lists.

nodes.name: _summary
nodes.summary: Writes the plain-language message for a plan, naming how many nodes and subtrees were rejected or truncated.

nodes.name: build_plan_tree
nodes.summary: Main entry: checks the spec and max_depth, walks the declared subtasks and returns a PlanTree that is qualified-draft at best and blocked-escalated when the input is refused or the root cannot be planned.

nodes.name: predicates.py
nodes.summary: Registry of named predicates that read an executor Observation and return pass, fail or unknown, with built-ins for resource limits, metric thresholds and fixed per-action hazard estimates. Provides register_predicate, resolve and a run wrapper that treats an odd return value or an exception as unknown.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses MappingProxyType for read-only hazard tables and params, and inspect.signature to check that a registered factory takes one argument.

nodes.name: ControlError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying a stable code and a plain reason for a control that cannot be built.

nodes.name: usage_within
nodes.summary: Factory for a predicate that fails when any reported usage figure is over its limit and returns unknown when a limited figure is not reported.

nodes.name: _metric
nodes.summary: Shared builder for the metric_above and metric_below predicates: checks the metric and threshold params and returns unknown when the observation does not report the metric.

nodes.name: _csf_hazard
nodes.summary: Builds the csf_hazard predicate, which compares the observed action fixed hazard estimate with max_prob and fails any action that has no estimate.

nodes.name: register_predicate
nodes.summary: Registers a named predicate factory after checking the name format, that the factory is callable with one parameter, and that a built-in is replaced only with override=True.

nodes.name: list_predicates
nodes.summary: Returns the sorted names of all registered predicates.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Looks up a predicate factory by name and builds the predicate from read-only params, raising ControlError with an unknown-predicate or invalid-control code when that fails.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs a predicate on an observation and normalises its answer to a verdict and reason; exceptions and unexpected return values become unknown, never pass.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for the goal a caller declares (GoalSpec with resource bounds, guardrails, checkpoints, breakpoints and nested subtasks) and the Observation an executor reports. Unknown keys are rejected, numbers must be strict and finite, and each spec has a SHA-256 digest.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Annotated types with AfterValidator and Field(strict=True, allow_inf_nan=False) so NaN limits cannot slip past comparisons.

nodes.name: ResourceBoundsSpec
nodes.summary: Strict model of declared resource limits (execution seconds, disk bytes, token rates per minute to month) with a limits() helper mapping each set limit to its usage key.

nodes.name: GuardrailSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a blocking guardrail control naming a registered predicate, its params and message; rejects the reserved resource_bounds name.

nodes.name: CheckpointSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a non-blocking checkpoint control naming a predicate, its params and a description.

nodes.name: BreakpointSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a breakpoint that, while active, asks for a recorded approval before the node work starts.

nodes.name: GoalSpec
nodes.summary: Recursive goal model with context, constraints, resource bounds, controls, nested subtasks and success criteria; checks that control names are unique and provides a SHA-256 digest of the spec.

nodes.name: Observation
nodes.summary: Model of what an executor reports at a node: node id, action, usage figures and metrics.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for grounding: re-exports claim checking, corroboration by source lineage, staleness checks, the BM25 retriever, the grounding block and the instruction tripwire. Its docstring explains the checks are lexical, not entailment, so no result reads verified.

nodes.name: claims.py
nodes.summary: Checks whether a claim is backed by one source sentence: it retrieves passages, picks the sentence with the best content-term coverage, and flags negation flips and conflicting numbers. An optional judge can only make a result stricter; support reads qualified-draft and anything else blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: ClaimCheck
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one claim check: status, completion state, coverage, best source and sentence, conflicts, missing terms and evidence, with a to_dict helper.

nodes.name: split_claims
nodes.summary: Splits text into one claim per sentence or bullet, dropping headings and fragments under three words.

nodes.name: _best_sentence
nodes.summary: Finds the source sentence with the highest share of the claim content terms across the retrieved passages, noting an exact quote when there is one.

nodes.name: check_claim
nodes.summary: Retrieves passages for a claim, picks the best sentence, flags negation and number conflicts, applies the optional judge, and returns a ClaimCheck labelled quoted, supported, partial, conflict or not_found.

nodes.name: check_claims
nodes.summary: Runs check_claim on every claim split from a text.

nodes.name: grounding_block.py
nodes.summary: AIBlock wrapper that exposes check_claim and check_claims as block operations over source text the caller supplies, with a size limit on sources and no network access.

nodes.name: GroundingInput
nodes.summary: Input model for the grounding block: the operation, a claim or text, the sources mapping and top_k.

nodes.name: GroundingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock whose infer method lists ops, checks the sources, builds a TextRetriever and returns check_claim or check_claims results with an overall completion state.

nodes.name: lineage.py
nodes.summary: Groups the passages that support or contradict a claim by source lineage (web host or corpus label) and reports SUPPORTED, ASSERTED, CONTESTED or UNVERIFIABLE; only SUPPORTED, which needs two lineages and no contradiction, reads qualified-draft.

nodes.name: CorroborationReport
nodes.summary: Frozen corroboration result: status, completion state, supporting and opposing lineages, passages considered and evidence, with a to_dict helper.

nodes.name: _lineage
nodes.summary: Derives a passage lineage key from its source label: the web host without www for a URL, otherwise the corpus label.

nodes.name: corroboration
nodes.summary: Retrieves passages for a claim, takes each passage stance from the lexical claim check, groups supporters and opponents by lineage and returns a CorroborationReport.

nodes.name: retrieval.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Retriever protocol, the Passage record, light tokenising and stemming helpers, and TextRetriever, a dependency-free in-memory BM25 search over text the caller supplies or a folder of files.
nodes.languageNotes: Retriever is a runtime_checkable typing.Protocol, so any object with a matching search method can stand in for TextRetriever.

nodes.name: tokens
nodes.summary: Lower-cases text and extracts word and number tokens.

nodes.name: stem
nodes.summary: Light suffix stripper for -ing, -ed, -es and -s so plural and past forms match.

nodes.name: content_terms
nodes.summary: Returns stemmed tokens with stopwords and negators removed.

nodes.name: Passage
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a retrieved text chunk with its source label, score, score scale, provenance and declared publication date.

nodes.name: Retriever
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol for any corpus that returns the top passages for a query.

nodes.name: TextRetriever
nodes.summary: In-memory BM25 retriever over caller text, built from a dict of texts or a folder of markdown and text files, and searched by content terms.

nodes.name: staleness.py
nodes.summary: Ages each passage from the publication date its source declares and classifies it fresh, stale, expired or unknown against thresholds the caller chooses; an undated or unreadable date is unknown, never assumed fresh.

nodes.name: SourceAge
nodes.summary: Frozen age record for one passage: status, declared date, age in days, freshness score and reason.

nodes.name: StalenessReport
nodes.summary: Frozen staleness report with the thresholds and per-source ages, plus counts, all_fresh and to_dict helpers.

nodes.name: _parse_date
nodes.summary: Parses a date, datetime or ISO 8601 text (year, year-month or full date) into a date, counting a partial date from its first day; returns None otherwise.

nodes.name: check_staleness
nodes.summary: Ages each passage against today using its declared publication date and classifies it fresh, stale, expired or unknown with a falling freshness score.

nodes.name: tripwire.py
nodes.summary: A small tripwire that flags source text with phrasings that read like instructions to an AI model (ignore your instructions, take a new role, hidden prompt), after Unicode normalisation and removal of invisible characters.

nodes.name: instruction_signals
nodes.summary: Returns the names of the instruction-like phrasings found in the normalised text, or an empty list.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for advisory guards: re-exports the subversion and prompt-extraction phrase scanners and the source-code safety-smell scanner. Its docstring stresses that a flag only suggests blocking and NO_MATCH is not a clearance.

nodes.name: patterns.py
nodes.summary: Advisory substring scanners: PatternGuard checks text, user input and tool actions for phrasings that try to override instructions or switch off controls, and detect_extraction_attempt checks for requests to reveal a system prompt. Each returns a GuardVerdict of BLOCK or NO_MATCH with the matched phrases and excerpts, never a score.

nodes.name: GuardVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen verdict from an advisory scanner: BLOCK or NO_MATCH, reason, matched phrases, excerpts and surface, with a flagged property.

nodes.name: _scan
nodes.summary: Shared scanner that folds case, apostrophes and whitespace, finds listed phrases as substrings and returns a GuardVerdict with up to five context excerpts.

nodes.name: PatternGuard
nodes.summary: Advisory scanner for subversion phrasings in free text, user input and tool actions (name, reason, effect, arguments, touched files); records that a scan ran.

nodes.name: detect_extraction_attempt
nodes.summary: Scans input for listed system-prompt extraction phrasings and returns a GuardVerdict.

nodes.name: source_scan.py
nodes.summary: Scans Python source line by line, with string literals and comments blanked through the tokenizer, for five regex rules that flag code quietly defeating a safety chain, such as a discarded guard verdict, a kill switch reset or a ceiling set from planner output.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the standard tokenize module to blank STRING and COMMENT tokens before regex matching, so patterns quoted in docstrings are not reported.

nodes.name: StaticFinding
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one rule match: rule, reason, line number, line and path.

nodes.name: SourceScan
nodes.summary: Frozen scan result with the findings, lines scanned, whether strings were blanked, the path and a flagged property.

nodes.name: _code_lines
nodes.summary: Uses the tokenizer to blank string literals and comments, falling back to the raw lines when the text cannot be tokenised.

nodes.name: scan_source
nodes.summary: Matches each blanked code line against the RULES regexes, skipping comment lines, and returns a SourceScan.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The end-to-end harness spine: run() takes a Standard of acceptance checks and an executor, runs intake, freezes each check and tests it on known-bad and known-good outputs, calls the executor, adjudicates the output into an evidence certificate and stores failures for later runs. It returns the library envelope, and caller-written checks cap the result at qualified-draft.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports its pipeline and evidence dependencies inside _run, so importing g6.harness stays light and avoids import cycles.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen acceptance check: predicate text, callable, id, author, evidence kind, known-bad and known-good outputs; key gives its slug and code_sha hashes its source to freeze it.

nodes.name: Standard
nodes.summary: Frozen standard for a run: goal, checks, context sources, gates a person must decide, task family and an optional plan to critique.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Public entry that runs a Standard once with the given executor and decisions, opening and closing its own Memory when none is passed.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs the harness stages: stop check, intake, plan critique, check freezing with known-bad and known-good controls, the remembered-failure check, execution, adjudication through evidence issue and failure recording; every exit returns the reliability envelope with a stable code.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: SQLite memory of failed checks per task family in $G6_HOME/harness.db, storing the check key, output hash, run id and time so later harness runs can ask for missing checks and spot repeated failing outputs.

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.summary: Lazily opened SQLite connection to the failures table with record, failures (grouped per check), seen_failing and close methods.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Builds and checks SHA-256 file manifests: a matching tree is verified only when the caller pinned the manifest digest, qualified-draft when unpinned, and blocked-escalated on a missing manifest, a mismatch or a wrong pin. verify_installed checks the running g6 package.

nodes.name: build_manifest
nodes.summary: Maps each matching file under a root, skipping __pycache__, to its SHA-256 hash keyed by relative posix path.

nodes.name: manifest_text
nodes.summary: Renders a manifest as sorted lines of hash and path.

nodes.name: manifest_sha256
nodes.summary: Returns the digest of the manifest canonical text, the value a caller pins.

nodes.name: write_manifest
nodes.summary: Writes the manifest text to a file and returns its digest.

nodes.name: read_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads hash and path lines from a manifest file, returning an empty manifest when the file is absent.

nodes.name: IntegrityResult
nodes.summary: Frozen verification result with presence, match and pin flags, the missing, modified and unexpected files, the problems found and a reliability_label property.

nodes.name: verify_tree
nodes.summary: Compares the files under a root with a manifest and an optional pinned digest, listing missing, modified and unexpected files and the problems found.

nodes.name: verify_installed
nodes.summary: Runs verify_tree on the directory of the installed g6 package.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the intent engine: re-exports the IntentElicitor and the intent contract, goal input, assumption, question and session schemas.

nodes.name: elicitor.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic IntentElicitor that merges free-text answers into an IntentContract, maps risk and expertise answers onto allowed values without ever raising, records replaced requests and unparsed answers as explicit assumptions, and lists the checklist questions still open. Its confidence is a field-completeness heuristic only.

nodes.name: IntentElicitor
nodes.summary: Merges answers and a prior contract into an IntentContract, coerces free-text levels fail-open, adds explicit assumptions, scores field completeness and returns an IntentSession with the remaining questions.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for the persisted intent contract and the goal input it extends: resource bounds, guardrail, checkpoint and breakpoint specs, assumptions, questions and the elicitation session. Field names follow the archive so stored contracts still load.

nodes.name: ResourceBoundsSchema
nodes.summary: Model of declared resource limits as non-negative finite numbers; data only, not enforced here.

nodes.name: GuardrailSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a guardrail entry in a goal input: name, predicate, params and message.

nodes.name: CheckpointSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a checkpoint entry in a goal input: name, predicate, params and description.

nodes.name: BreakpointSpec
nodes.summary: Model of a breakpoint entry in a goal input: name, description and active flag.

nodes.name: GoalInput
nodes.summary: Frozen recursive goal input schema with context, constraints, resource bounds, controls, subtasks and success criteria.

nodes.name: Assumption
nodes.summary: Frozen assumption with a statement, a bounded confidence and a source of explicit, inferred or fallback.

nodes.name: IntentQuestion
nodes.summary: Frozen clarification question naming the field, the question and why it is asked.

nodes.name: IntentContract
nodes.summary: GoalInput extended with rationale, failure criteria, non-goals, assumptions, expertise and risk levels, cost and deadline, and a completeness-based confidence.

nodes.name: IntentSession
nodes.summary: Frozen elicitation session: id, initial request, questions, contract and how the session ended.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.invariants that re-exports the envelope consistency checker (check_envelope, assert_envelope, nonvacuous_pass, Violation) together with the reliability-label and G6_E_* code constants, and marks the package as a G6 component.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Checks that a result envelope says only what its own fields support: completion_state is one of the three reliability labels, a result that is not verified carries a warning card with a stable G6_E_* code, a verified one carries evidence, request_id and run_id are present, and degraded matches the state. It checks consistency, not whether the evidence is true.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.learning, which learns prompt hints (theories) from an agent's failures and credits each one only from paired runs with and without it. Re-exports the theory store, runner, promotion check, bundles, scoring, strategies and data types, and documents that nothing here activates a theory by itself or emits verified.

nodes.name: addendum.py
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt addendum: a deterministic hint block assembled from theories whose trigger matches the task metadata, capped by character and theory counts, and prefixed to each task prompt afresh on every call so blocks never nest.

nodes.name: bundle.py
nodes.summary: Exports chosen theories and artifacts with a person's review to a portable bundle directory sealed by a content digest, and imports bundles back strictly as zero-evidence candidate theories. Both directions scan the text with risk patterns and recompute a forbidden-term leakage check against the caller's own terms.

nodes.name: dataset_builder.py
nodes.summary: Builds learning datasets from JSONL files by recognising common input and expected-answer keys, and offers seeded split, sample, merge and filter helpers; split marks the second half as validation so a training run refuses to learn from it.

nodes.name: baselines.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in learning strategies kept out of the g6.learning exports: T0Strategy proposes nothing (a plain paired evaluation of the raw agent), TemplateStrategy proposes one template theory per cycle for the most frequent uncovered failure code, and render_skill renders a theory as a markdown guide. None of them has been shown to improve an agent.

nodes.name: failure_classifier.py
nodes.summary: Heuristic failure classification with no model calls: a FailureClassifier protocol and a DefaultClassifier that labels a failed task result with codes such as NO_OUTPUT, WRONG_FORMAT, TIMEOUT and TOOL_ERROR from its output and trace.
nodes.languageNotes: FailureClassifier is a typing.Protocol, so any object with a matching classify method satisfies it without inheriting from it.

nodes.name: observer.py
nodes.summary: Event dispatch for learning runs: an EventEmitter sends each event to every observer and records an observer that raises instead of hiding it, with ready-made observers for Python logging, JSONL files and callbacks.

nodes.name: ooda.py
nodes.summary: Defines ObservationResult, what a strategy sees each cycle: the current harness's results on the whole training set with accuracy and pass/fail counts; acting, measuring and stopping stay with the runner.

nodes.name: paired.py
nodes.summary: Paired-outcome statistics: the same instance run with and without a theory, a credit rule that counts only pairs whose runs disagree, an exact one-sided sign test, and ArmComparison for a baseline and an adapted arm on identical instances.
nodes.languageNotes: ArmComparison is a frozen dataclass whose statistics are computed properties, built through a from_results classmethod that refuses mismatched instance sets.

nodes.name: promotion.py
nodes.summary: Decides whether a candidate theory may be recommended for activation from held-out paired evidence alone: the evidence must be bound to the theory's id and digest, disjoint from training, large enough, and show a significant win by sign test. The best outcome is a qualified-draft recommendation that a person must still accept.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Runs a learning measurement: each cycle a strategy proposes theories, each is run with and without it on the same training instances and credited only from disagreeing pairs, then the frozen harness is measured read-only against the raw agent on a disjoint held-out set. A finished run is qualified-draft; a refusal or early stop (budget, failing agent) is blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Data types for g6.learning: task instances and datasets with unique ids and protected splits, agent traces and replies, scored results, failure analyses, theories with a candidate/active/retired lifecycle and posterior strength, prompt addenda, skill documents and review records.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses validate in __post_init__ and use object.__setattr__ to normalise fields on otherwise immutable instances.

nodes.name: scoring.py
nodes.summary: Instance-keyed scoring of an agent's answer and the agent call itself: deterministic exact, normalised or token-F1 scoring, optional rubric judging through an injected model, and failing closed (score 0) when there is no expected answer or no judge.

nodes.name: strategies.py
nodes.summary: The LearningStrategy protocol and T3Strategy, which proposes one of seven fixed theory templates for each failure code seen in the current results that no theory in the store's scope covers yet, plus the scope's existing candidates.

nodes.name: theory_store.py
nodes.summary: Scoped SQLite store of candidate, active and retired theories: theories enter only as zero-evidence candidates, credit comes only from append-only paired outcomes counted once per instance, weak theories retire, and activation needs a promotion decision a person accepted.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps a sqlite3 connection with a threading.Lock and context-manager methods (__enter__/__exit__), and limits every query to the store's scope.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The g6-mcp stdio MCP server: five discovery tools (g6_help, g6_find, g6_describe, g6_invoke, g6_components) and seven meta-harness tools whose approval and rollback ask the person through the client. Every g6_invoke reply wraps the component's answer in the library envelope and never reports verified without evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: Tools are registered with FastMCP decorators inside build_server; the approval and rollback tools are async and use MCP elicitation through the request context.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.metaharness, which tunes how G6 runs a recurring task: it proposes profile changes, tests each on held-out examples the user trusts, and activates nothing until a person approves. Re-exports the workflow and profile schema, adapt and MetaHarness, the evaluator, gate, proposers, recovery, stores, builder and bundle adapters.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: Turns a shipped G6 bundle into a meta-harness workflow whose executor is the bundle's own run with the profile's metered model caller, so a person can tune it on their own labelled examples; the standard check is that the bundle released a result.

nodes.name: api.py
nodes.summary: The MetaHarness handle and adapt(): confirm a workflow, measure a baseline, propose, select, evaluate, decide, activate, run live tasks, monitor drift, tune online, export or import profile packs, roll back and report. Every call returns the library envelope, checks the stop first (except rollback, inspect and report) and never returns verified.
nodes.languageNotes: Expected failures are returned as blocked-escalated envelope dicts rather than raised, so every public method has the same reply shape.

nodes.name: artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Content-addressed artifact store in the workspace for code blobs, admitted distillates with their admission reports, and LoRA adapter folders; each artifact is written once under its digest and its bytes are checked on every read.

nodes.name: builder.py
nodes.summary: Guided builder flow for a new meta-harness use case: asks the objective questions in order, records inferred objectives as unconfirmed, classifies capabilities by reversibility, lets a model draft development cases only, seals a held-out file in a vault, and returns a Workflow a person must still confirm.

nodes.name: coding.py
nodes.summary: Coding specialisation of the meta-harness: the executor is the user's coding agent working in a fresh repository copy, the standard check requires a changed working copy, and the oracle runs hidden tests (optionally requiring them to kill mutants) only inside evaluation; an optional check flags test shortcuts in the diff.

nodes.name: evaluate.py
nodes.summary: The meta-harness evaluator: a paired, compute-matched comparison of base and candidate profiles on one split, with a majority-vote compute control and an empty-answer negative control, each run adjudicated by the harness and the workflow oracle. Supports sequential looks with alpha-spending boundaries, a power estimate and an early stop on the stop switch or the model-call budget.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses statistics.NormalDist for Lan-DeMets alpha-spending boundaries and exact binomial sums (math.comb) for the power estimate.

nodes.name: Violation
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one broken envelope rule: the rule name, the field it concerns and what was found.

nodes.name: check_envelope
nodes.summary: Returns every rule a payload breaks: an unknown or mismatched reliability label, a missing or malformed warning-card code on a result that is not verified, empty evidence on a verified one, missing request_id or run_id, and an inconsistent degraded flag.

nodes.name: assert_envelope
nodes.summary: Raises AssertionError listing every violation check_envelope finds; meant for use in any component's tests.

nodes.name: nonvacuous_pass
nodes.summary: Returns True only when at least one blocking check ran and every blocking check passed, so a set of checks that checked nothing cannot count as a pass.

nodes.name: trigger_matches
nodes.summary: Decides whether a theory trigger applies to a task: "always" matches every task and "key:value" matches when the task metadata value equals it, ignoring case.

nodes.name: render_addendum
nodes.summary: Renders one hint block under a fixed header from the given theories whose trigger matches, stopping at the character or theory limit, and records which theory ids contributed.

nodes.name: build_addendum
nodes.summary: Builds the addendum for a task outside training from the store's active theories only, strongest first.

nodes.name: with_addendum
nodes.summary: Prefixes a task with the hint block and a blank line, rebuilt for every call so hint blocks never nest across cycles.

nodes.name: scan_text
nodes.summary: Returns the risk codes whose regular-expression pattern appears in a text; a tripwire rather than a full prompt-injection defence.

nodes.name: leakage_attestation
nodes.summary: Checks whether any forbidden term, such as a gold answer, appears as a whole word in theory or artifact text, reporting hashed terms and not_applicable when no terms are given.

nodes.name: export_bundle
nodes.summary: Writes a bundle directory of the selected non-retired theories, artifacts, the review and a digest-sealed manifest, refusing retired or unknown theories, risky text and leaked terms.

nodes.name: CandidateBundle
nodes.summary: Result of importing a bundle: candidate theories, artifacts, the review and attestation, or a refusal code and reason; exposes its reliability state and a cross-surface envelope.

nodes.name: import_bundle
nodes.summary: Reads a bundle as candidates only, refusing it as blocked-escalated when the manifest is missing or malformed, the files do not match the digest, the review is incomplete, text is risky or a forbidden term leaks.

nodes.name: DatasetBuilder
nodes.summary: Static helpers that load a Dataset from JSONL (one task per line, needing task text and an expected answer or rubric) and split, sample, merge or filter datasets with seeded randomness.

nodes.name: T0Strategy
nodes.summary: Baseline strategy that proposes no theories, so both arms of a run are the raw agent.

nodes.name: TemplateStrategy
nodes.summary: Classifies each result and proposes one template theory per cycle for the most frequent primary failure code that no theory in the store's scope covers yet.

nodes.name: render_skill
nodes.summary: Pure function that renders a theory and its failure analyses into a length-bounded markdown SkillDocument, or None when the theory has no text; writes nothing to a store.

nodes.name: FailureClassifier
nodes.summary: Protocol for a custom classifier that maps a TaskResult to a FailureAnalysis.

nodes.name: DefaultClassifier
nodes.summary: Applies ordered heuristics (duration over the limit, tool errors in the trace, empty output, partial match, format, high turn count, domain mismatch) to label a failed result and pick its primary code.

nodes.name: ObserverFailure
nodes.summary: Frozen record of an observer that raised: the event type, observer index, error type and message.

nodes.name: LearningEvent
nodes.summary: One learning-run event: its type, UTC timestamp, payload data and any observer errors it caused.

nodes.name: LearningObserver
nodes.summary: Protocol for an observer that receives each LearningEvent through on_event.

nodes.name: LogObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that writes each event as JSON through a named Python logger.

nodes.name: JsonlObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that appends each event as one JSON line to an explicit file path, creating the parent folder first.

nodes.name: CallbackObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that forwards each event to a caller-supplied function.

nodes.name: EventEmitter
nodes.summary: Sends an event to every registered observer, keeps going after an observer raises, and returns and accumulates the failures.

nodes.name: ObservationResult
nodes.summary: Frozen collection of one cycle's task results on every training instance, with accuracy, passed and failed counts.

nodes.name: PairedOutcome
nodes.summary: Frozen record of whether one instance passed with the theory and without it.

nodes.name: credit
nodes.summary: Names what one pair says about a theory: confirmed when only the run with it passed, disconfirmed when only the run without it passed, and no discriminating evidence when both runs agree.

nodes.name: sign_test
nodes.summary: One-sided exact sign test: the probability of at least the observed wins among wins plus losses fair coin flips, or 1.0 with no discordant pairs.

nodes.name: ArmComparison
nodes.summary: Compares a baseline arm and an adapted arm on exactly the same instances, refusing mismatched sets, and reports passes, wins, losses, ties, accuracies, lift and the one-sided p-value.

nodes.name: HeldOutEvidence
nodes.summary: Paired outcomes for one theory on held-out instances, with the training instance ids they must avoid, win and loss counts and a stable digest.

nodes.name: PromotionPolicy
nodes.summary: Thresholds for promotion: the minimum distinct pairs, the minimum discordant pairs and the sign-test alpha.

nodes.name: PromotionDecision
nodes.summary: A promote or refuse recommendation with its code, reasons, evidence digest, counts and p-value, exposing a reliability state and a cross-surface envelope with a warning card.

nodes.name: promote
nodes.summary: Builds a PromotionDecision from the evidence alone: refuses with the collected faults, otherwise recommends promotion with the sign-test result; it activates nothing.

nodes.name: _faults
nodes.summary: Lists every reason the evidence cannot promote the theory: id or digest mismatch, wrong phase, overlap with training or source instances, too few pairs or discordant pairs, and no significant win.

nodes.name: BudgetExceeded
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a run reaches its agent-call or cost limit.

nodes.name: _Budget
nodes.summary: Tracks agent calls and cost for a run, raising BudgetExceeded before a call past the call limit or after one that pushes cost over the limit.

nodes.name: CycleRecord
nodes.summary: Per-cycle record of the instance count, accuracy, failure-code breakdown, proposed and measured theories and the harness after the cycle.

nodes.name: LearningReport
nodes.summary: What a learning run measured: cycles, frozen harness, held-out comparison, per-theory held-out evidence, call and cost totals and observer failures; renders hint text, a dict and a cross-surface envelope that is never verified.

nodes.name: run_arm
nodes.summary: Runs every instance once with the hint block its theories give that instance, charging the budget around each agent call and scoring by instance.

nodes.name: compare_arms
nodes.summary: Runs the raw agent and the agent with the given theories on every instance of a dataset and returns their ArmComparison; this is how a frozen harness is evaluated on new tasks.

nodes.name: run_learning
nodes.summary: Main training loop: validates inputs, runs cycles of propose, admit and paired measurement, adds winning theories to the harness, records paired outcomes in the store, stops on budget or agent failure, then measures held-out evidence and emits events throughout.

nodes.name: _measure_holdout
nodes.summary: Measures the frozen harness against the raw agent on held-out instances and gathers each harness theory's own held-out paired evidence, writing nothing to the store.

nodes.name: _refusal
nodes.summary: Returns a refusal report when the agent or held-out set is missing, the training split is protected, training shares an instance with the held-out set, or rubric tasks have no judge.

nodes.name: _admit
nodes.summary: Adds a cycle's new proposals to the store as candidates and returns those not yet measured, up to the theory limit.

nodes.name: TaskInstance
nodes.summary: One task with its input, evaluator-only expected answer and metadata, exposing its rubric, score mode, whether it needs a judge and whether it can be scored at all.

nodes.name: Dataset
nodes.summary: Named list of task instances with a split label; rejects duplicate instance ids because every result is keyed by instance id.

nodes.name: AgentTrace
nodes.summary: What the agent reported about one call: tool calls, turns, cost, duration and any error.

nodes.name: AgentReply
nodes.summary: An agent's answer to one prompt together with its trace.

nodes.name: TaskResult
nodes.summary: Scored outcome for one instance: actual output, pass flag, score, signals and trace.

nodes.name: FailureAnalysis
nodes.summary: Failure codes, primary code, signals and context for one failed instance.

nodes.name: Theory
nodes.summary: A learned hint that adds an instruction to the prompt when its trigger matches, with status, scope, evidence counts and strength; provides a constructor for fresh candidates, a content digest and a posterior strength computation.

nodes.name: posterior_strength
nodes.summary: Posterior mean of a theory's strength with a prior worth two observations centred on the given prior (Laplace's rule at 0.5).

nodes.name: PromptAddendum
nodes.summary: Hint text prefixed to a task prompt plus the ids of the theories it came from, with a digest.

nodes.name: SkillDocument
nodes.summary: A markdown guide rendered from a theory, with the id of that theory.

nodes.name: ReviewRecord
nodes.summary: A person's review attached to an exported bundle; refuses blank fields but does not authenticate who wrote it.

nodes.name: score_output
nodes.summary: Deterministic score of an answer against the expected answer under a score mode, returning 0 when there is no expected answer.

nodes.name: score_instance
nodes.summary: Returns score, pass flag and signals for an output using only the instance's own expected answer, rubric, score mode and threshold, calling the judge for rubric modes and scoring 0 when none is available.

nodes.name: call_agent
nodes.summary: Calls an injected model caller or plain callable with a prompt and returns an AgentReply with timing; an agent that raises yields an empty reply with the error in its trace.

nodes.name: _judge
nodes.summary: Asks the judge model to grade an answer against a rubric or expected answer and parses a JSON score, recording judge errors in the signals.

nodes.name: _token_f1
nodes.summary: Token-level F1 overlap between the normalised answer and expected text.

nodes.name: LearningStrategy
nodes.summary: Protocol for a named strategy whose propose method returns the theories to measure this cycle from the current observations and store.

nodes.name: T3Strategy
nodes.summary: Classifies current failures and proposes template theories for failure codes no theory in the scope covers yet, together with existing candidates; what a run learns is which templates help on paired evidence.

nodes.name: TheoryStore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe SQLite store for one scope that adds candidate theories (refusing any existing id), lists them strongest first or by failure code, records paired outcomes and updates strength and retirement, activates a theory on an accepted promotion decision, and retires theories.

nodes.name: _row_to_theory
nodes.summary: Converts a SQLite row into a Theory, decoding its JSON-encoded fields.

nodes.name: invoke_reply
nodes.summary: Runs one component op from JSON parameters through the registry with sensitive ops blocked and returns the answer inside the library envelope: failures become blocked-escalated with a G6_E_* code, and a verified claim without evidence is held at qualified-draft.

nodes.name: build_server
nodes.summary: Creates the FastMCP server, registers the five discovery tools and the meta-harness tools, and exits with an install hint when the MCP extra is missing.

nodes.name: _metaharness_tools
nodes.summary: Registers the seven meta-harness MCP tools (inspect, propose, evaluate, decide, diagnose, approve, rollback) over a Surface, using MCP elicitation so approval and rollback come from the person, never from the proposing session.

nodes.name: main
