nodes.summary: Console entry point for g6-mcp that builds the server and runs it over stdio.

nodes.name: bundle_factory
nodes.summary: Builds an executor factory that runs a bundle with each case input in a named field plus fixed extra inputs, and returns the bundle result as JSON.

nodes.name: bundle_workflow
nodes.summary: Builds a Workflow from a catalogued bundle id, suite, models and oracle, with the released-result check as its standard.

nodes.name: judging_sha256
nodes.summary: Digest of the manifest of G6's judging code (evaluator, gate, store, schema, harness, ledger, stop, invariants), pinned at confirmation and compared before every decision.

nodes.name: MetaHarness
nodes.summary: Stateful handle for one workflow over a workspace with a profile store, run ledger and artifact store. Every method returns an envelope and refuses when the stop is engaged, the workflow is unconfirmed or the sealed held-out file changed, and confirmation, activation, audit-rate changes, online tuning and rollback need a person rather than the proposer.

nodes.name: adapt
nodes.summary: Creates a MetaHarness for a workflow in a workspace under the G6 home folder; its envelope is blocked-escalated, listing the problems, when the workflow is invalid.

nodes.name: ArtifactError
nodes.summary: Error for an artifact that is missing or whose bytes do not match its digest.

nodes.name: ArtifactStore
nodes.summary: Stores and reads code blobs, distillates with their admission reports and adapter folders by SHA-256 digest, never overwriting and verifying the bytes on read.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Dataclass that collects answers, objectives, capabilities and dev and held-out cases with provenance; it puts weights only on confirmed objectives, needs a person to confirm action effects, and accepts held-out cases only from a source other than the builder.

nodes.name: coding_oracle
nodes.summary: Builds an oracle that passes a case only when its hidden tests pass on the agent's working copy and, with mutation on, only when those tests also kill mutants of the changed code.

nodes.name: _mutants_killed
nodes.summary: Runs mutation checking on each changed non-test Python file and reports whether the case's tests kill every mutant; a surviving mutant, a stopped check or nothing tried counts as a fail.

nodes.name: coding_workflow
nodes.summary: Builds a coding Workflow with the working-copy check, the coding oracle, an optional no-shortcut check and a suite whose expected answers name hidden test ids.

nodes.name: agent_factory
nodes.summary: Wraps a coding agent callable into an executor factory that passes it the task and the profile's metered model caller.

nodes.name: RunRecord
nodes.summary: One case run under one arm: released flag, oracle verdict, model calls, wall time, state and output digest, with success, false-accept and measure accessors.

nodes.name: standard_for
nodes.summary: Builds the harness Standard for a case: the workflow task with the case input filled in, the workflow checks plus the profile's extra checks.

nodes.name: run_case
nodes.summary: Runs one case under one arm through harness.run with fresh in-memory memory, applies the oracle only when the harness released the output, and returns a RunRecord.

nodes.name: _Meter
nodes.summary: Model-call budget meter for an evaluation that charges calls and reports when the limit is spent.

nodes.name: _arm
nodes.summary: Runs one case for one arm, repeating the executor and majority-voting its outputs for the compute-matched control.

nodes.name: _paired
nodes.summary: Mean paired difference between two arms' per-case measures with its standard deviation and standard error.

nodes.name: sequential_boundaries
nodes.summary: Per-look one-sided significance levels for a sequential confirmation that spends alpha once in all, using O'Brien-Fleming-type Lan-DeMets spending.

nodes.name: power
nodes.summary: Probability that a true success-rate gain would be recommended on n cases at a given discordance rate under the sign-test rule and minimum discordant pairs.

nodes.name: EvaluationReport
nodes.summary: Full record of an evaluation: workflow, split, base and candidate digests, per-case records, estimates, controls, power, partial and stopped flags, budget use and provenance, with a dict form and digest.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs base, candidate and the controls on every case of a split within a model-call budget, applying sequential looks and futility stops, and returns an EvaluationReport marked partial when stopped early.

nodes.name: executor.py
nodes.summary: Connects a profile to an executor: builds a fresh per-run ProfileContext with budgeted, metered model callers, hint text, exemplars and distillates, and provides the default executor factories (one model call per task, a sandboxed code run, and a null negative control).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses closures: each factory returns an execute(contract) function bound to its ProfileContext, so per-run state stays out of module globals apart from a small example-bank cache keyed by object id.

nodes.name: ProfileContext
nodes.summary: Frozen per-run context given to an executor factory: the profile, one metered caller per step, hint text and ids, extra data, pipeline steps and distillates, plus a total model-call count.

nodes.name: context_for
nodes.summary: Builds a fresh ProfileContext for one run with a new budgeted meter per step capped by the profile and model limits, loads a LoRA adapter only when the profile names one, and renders the profile hint addendum and distillates.

nodes.name: with_exemplars
nodes.summary: Places the profile nearest labelled examples from the cached example bank in front of a task, or returns the task unchanged when the profile asks for none.

nodes.name: model_call_factory
nodes.summary: Default executor factory: one model call per task with the system prompt, profile prompt, hints and exemplars, retrying on empty replies; an admitted distillate can replace the call, and the profile pipeline steps then revise the answer.

nodes.name: code_factory
nodes.summary: Executor factory for workflows with a code root: copies the base files plus the profile code overlay into a fresh directory and runs main.solve(task) out of process in the sandbox, never writing the user folder.

nodes.name: null_factory
nodes.summary: Negative-control executor that answers nothing and calls no model, used to show whether a suite can tell an empty answer from the base profile.

nodes.name: exemplars.py
nodes.summary: Example bank that shows a profile its nearest labelled reference examples before each task, matched by rare shared words (IDF-weighted) on only the varying part of each input, scrubbed of secrets, and never showing a case its own input.

nodes.name: Bank
nodes.summary: Indexes labelled cases by word sets and inverse document frequency, strips template text and lines every input shares, returns the k nearest examples for a task and renders them within a character budget.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: The deterministic, fail-closed meta-gate that decides whether an evaluated proposal may be recommended: it checks the stop switch, the frozen workflow and judging code, profile validity, held-out reuse, suite discrimination, sign-test evidence, compute parity, cost objectives and false accepts, and at best returns a qualified-draft recommendation that a person must still approve.
nodes.languageNotes: Written as an ordered sequence of early returns through a local out() helper, so each failing rule yields its own stable verdict code while the trail of passed checks is recorded.

nodes.name: GateDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a gate verdict with its stable code, reasons, the digests of workflow, base, candidate, report and proposal, the passed checks and whether a person is required; maps recommend to qualified-draft and everything else to blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: _code_change
nodes.summary: Screens a proposal that changes the workflow code overlay: classifies the changed paths, builds a harness patch and evaluation summary, and runs the self-training patch promotion gate, blocking protected or high-risk changes and refusing ones with no gain.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Runs the full ordered rule list for one evaluation of one proposal and returns a GateDecision, failing closed at the first unmet rule (stop engaged, changed workflow or judging code, invalid profile, held-out reuse, weak suite, too few cases, no sign-test win, extra compute, cost or bound breaches, rising false accepts).

nodes.name: level2.py
nodes.summary: Level-2 strategy chooser: a deterministic UCB1 bandit over the user proposer strategies, credited only by proposals a person activated and that were not later demoted.

nodes.name: credit
nodes.summary: Counts, per strategy, the proposals it made and those a person activated in the profile store and that the monitor has not demoted since.

nodes.name: choose
nodes.summary: Picks the next strategy to try: any untried one first, otherwise the one with the highest UCB1 bound on its approval rate.

nodes.name: lora.py
nodes.summary: Trains and loads LoRA adapters for a declared local model: training runs out of process in the sandbox with time and memory bounds and no network, the base model file manifest is compared before and after so its weights never change, and the optional torch/transformers/peft stack is imported only when used.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy ML dependencies (torch, transformers, peft) are imported lazily inside functions, so the module loads without the optional lora extra installed.

nodes.name: LoraSpec
nodes.summary: Settings for one LoRA training run (base model folder, rank, alpha, dropout, steps, learning rate, max length, seed, target modules, time and memory bounds) with a problems() check.

nodes.name: TrainResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of a training attempt: success flag, adapter folder, report, error code, message and next action.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Lists the training packages (torch, transformers, peft) that are not installed.

nodes.name: sandbox_trainer
nodes.summary: Default trainer that runs the training script in a bounded child process, writes the produced adapter files to the output folder and returns the script JSON report.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: Trains an adapter on prompt/completion rows after checking dependencies and the spec, and refuses the result when the base model folder manifest changed or no adapter files were produced.

nodes.name: AdapterCaller
nodes.summary: Model caller that lazily loads a local base model with a LoRA adapter and generates greedy completions in-process.

nodes.name: adapter_loader
nodes.summary: Returns a loader that builds an AdapterCaller for a given base model and adapter folder, for use as a Model adapter_loader.

nodes.name: method.py
nodes.summary: Defines the meta-harness tuning Method as versioned data and the tune loop that applies it: proposers offer dev-only candidates each cycle, candidates race on the selection split, the champion is evaluated once on held-out cases, the gate decides, and only a person name activates the result.

nodes.name: Method
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of the tuning method (cycles, propose and select budgets, race block and keep sizes, which proposers to use, reflection calls, merge interval), versioned by digest; it has no field for what judges a change.

nodes.name: TuningRun
nodes.summary: Record of one tuning run: method, workflow and base digests, per-cycle results, champion, confirmation, decision, recovery, activation and outcome notes.

nodes.name: strategies_for
nodes.summary: Builds the proposer strategies a Method asks for (recovery, reflection, random edits) around one shared candidate pool, noting any it cannot build.

nodes.name: tune
nodes.summary: Runs one complete tuning run: cycles of proposing and racing, a single held-out evaluation of the champion, the gate decision, and activation only when the approve callback returns a person name; every outcome is recorded in the run ledger.

nodes.name: method_rca.py
nodes.summary: Level-2 root-cause analysis of the meta-harness own method: reads tuning-run records to name causes (underpowered, exhausted, repetitive, uncombined, misallocated), maps each cause to candidate Method edits, and compares two methods with a sign test plus a bootstrap interval.

nodes.name: MethodCause
nodes.summary: One named cause in the tuning method, with a summary and the counts behind it.

nodes.name: MethodDiagnosis
nodes.summary: The method causes found and the number of runs read.

nodes.name: diagnose_method
nodes.summary: Scans tuning-run records and flags causes: narrow confirmation refusals, cycles that found no better champion, repeated reflected profiles, no multi-field candidates, and selection cases spent on early-dropped candidates.

nodes.name: edits_for
nodes.summary: Maps a method cause to new Method variants to test (for example more cycles, larger budgets or other race settings); nothing is applied here.

nodes.name: compare_methods
nodes.summary: Accepts a candidate method over the current one only when it wins more paired runs than it loses, the one-sided sign test is at or below 0.05, and the bootstrap 95% interval of the mean difference (optionally cluster-resampled) lies above zero.

nodes.name: monitor.py
nodes.summary: Post-activation drift monitor that may only demote: audits a share of live runs against the previous approved version and demotes when the mean paired difference exceeds an anytime-valid Hoeffding threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: The threshold sqrt(2 ln(n(n+1)/alpha)/n) spends alpha/(n(n+1)) at each n, so a union bound keeps false demotions below alpha however often the test is consulted.

nodes.name: threshold
nodes.summary: Hoeffding-based demotion threshold for n audited pairs at level alpha; infinite when n is below one.

nodes.name: pairs_to_detect
nodes.summary: Smallest number of audited pairs at which a constant drift exceeds the threshold, searched from the minimum pair count up to a limit.

nodes.name: DriftVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a drift check: pair count, mean difference, threshold and whether to demote.

nodes.name: assess
nodes.summary: Computes the mean paired difference and threshold for audited runs and recommends demotion only with at least the minimum number of pairs and a mean above the threshold.

nodes.name: due
nodes.summary: Deterministically decides whether a live run number is audited: every ceil(1/rate)-th run.

nodes.name: packs.py
nodes.summary: Profile packs for sharing a tuned profile: builds a digest-sealed JSON pack with the profile, its hint theories and stated evidence, refuses to write or read packs that trip the secret scan, and turns imported hints back into candidate theories.

nodes.name: build_pack
nodes.summary: Assembles a pack body (format, workflow name and digest, profile, selected theory fields, stated evidence) and seals it with a content digest.

nodes.name: risks
nodes.summary: Returns the learning module risky-content codes for a text, plus secret_value when the context scrubber would redact something.

nodes.name: write_pack
nodes.summary: Serializes a pack to JSON and writes it only when no risk codes are found, returning the codes.

nodes.name: read_pack
nodes.summary: Reads a pack file and reports problems: unreadable or wrong format, content that does not match its digest, or text that trips the secret scan.

nodes.name: theories_of
nodes.summary: Rebuilds Theory objects from the pack hint entries that carry the required string fields, with defaults for trigger, rationale and prior strength.

nodes.name: pool.py
nodes.summary: Candidate pool and edit space for compounding proposals: the Pool keeps every dev-tried profile with per-case results and a Pareto set for parent selection, and the EditSpace generates one-field neighbours and merges of two profiles changes.

nodes.name: Pool
nodes.summary: Stores every profile tried on dev with its per-case results, computes the Pareto set of members whose solved cases are not a strict subset of another member, and draws a parent weighted by cases solved.

nodes.name: EditSpace
nodes.summary: Holds the declared values for each profile field; produces neighbours that change one field and merges two profiles diffs from a common base when they do not conflict.

nodes.name: propose.py
nodes.summary: Proposers that turn the active profile dev-split failures into candidate profiles: builds a scrubbed and guard-scanned ProposerView and a budgeted dev-only runner, and provides search, hint, recovery and model-driven strategies whose outputs are parsed and validated as profiles.
nodes.languageNotes: Strategy is a typing Protocol, so any object with a name and a propose(view, runner) method plugs in without inheriting a base class.

nodes.name: DevFailure
nodes.summary: One failed dev case as a proposer may see it: input, output, expected answer, failed checks, oracle result, failure codes, guard flags and workflow feedback.

nodes.name: ProposerView
nodes.summary: Everything a proposer may see: the workflow task, checks, steps and models, the base profile, dev case ids, scrubbed failures, dev success and notes, never the held-out split.

nodes.name: Strategy
nodes.summary: Protocol every proposer strategy follows: a name and a propose method over a view and a dev runner.

nodes.name: dev_run
nodes.summary: Runs one dev case under one profile through the harness with the profile executor context, returning success, the harness result and the model calls used.

nodes.name: DevBudget
nodes.summary: Counter of dev case runs against a limit.

nodes.name: build_view
nodes.summary: Runs the base profile on every affordable dev case, scrubs secrets and scans failure text for subversion attempts, and assembles the ProposerView.

nodes.name: dev_runner
nodes.summary: Returns a runner that executes a profile on named dev cases only, counting cases past the budget as failures and reporting how many were skipped.

nodes.name: SearchStrategy
nodes.summary: Deterministic successive halving over user-declared profile options, scored on dev only, with a fixed-seed sample when the space is too large.

nodes.name: HintStrategy
nodes.summary: Proposes one candidate profile per new hint that the learning module T3 strategy derives from classified dev failures, storing the hints as candidate theories.

nodes.name: RecoveryStrategy
nodes.summary: Turns the root causes recovery.diagnose finds in the dev view into single-change candidates such as exemplars, a second-look or test-repair step, or retries.

nodes.name: ModelStrategy
nodes.summary: Asks a user-declared model to read the view and return profile JSON, keeping only outputs that parse as valid profiles.

nodes.name: recovery.py
nodes.summary: Recovery and root-cause reporting for when tuning fails or finds no gain: explains a gate decision that is not recommend from its aggregates, diagnoses dev failures by answer kind and over-used labels, and lists remedies saying who acts and which G6 component they use, without changing anything.

nodes.name: Cause
nodes.summary: A named failure cause with a description, the case count and example ids.

nodes.name: Remedy
nodes.summary: A suggested action, who can take it (candidate or person), the cause it addresses, the G6 component it uses and how.

nodes.name: Recovery
nodes.summary: Summary, causes and ordered remedies, exposing the first remedy as the next action.

nodes.name: cases_needed
nodes.summary: Estimates how many held-out cases a gain of the observed size needs to pass the sign test with probability 0.8, using a normal approximation.

nodes.name: for_decision
nodes.summary: Explains why a gate decision is not recommend using only its aggregates (wins, losses, disagreements, threshold) and proposes next steps such as adding held-out cases.

nodes.name: for_proposal
nodes.summary: Explains why a proposer offered nothing new and points to running a diagnosis.

nodes.name: answer_kind
nodes.summary: Classifies a workflow expected answers from dev cases as code, number, label or text.

nodes.name: overused_label
nodes.summary: Finds a label given as the whole wrong answer at least three times and in at least 40% of wrong answers.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: Root-causes the active version dev failures by answer kind, wrong labels, failed checks and gate history, and returns remedies ordered so that person-only actions come first.

nodes.name: reflect.py
nodes.summary: Compounding proposers that edit a parent drawn from the Pareto pool: a reflective strategy where a model writes one JSON change from failing dev cases, a random-edit strategy as a comparison arm, periodic merges of Pareto members, and a wrapper that adds any strategy candidates to the shared pool.

nodes.name: seed_base
nodes.summary: Adds the head profile dev results from the view to the pool and returns the dev case ids, or None when the view did not cover every dev case.

nodes.name: run_on_dev
nodes.summary: Runs a profile on all dev cases through the runner and returns its results, or None when any case could not run.

nodes.name: _PoolStrategy
nodes.summary: Shared loop for pool-based proposers: draws a Pareto parent, applies a change or periodically merges two Pareto members, validates the profile, runs it on dev and adds it to the pool while counting duplicates.

nodes.name: ReflectiveStrategy
nodes.summary: Pool strategy whose change comes from a reflection model reading the parent failing dev cases and returning one JSON edit limited to declared fields and the prompt.

nodes.name: Pooled
nodes.summary: Wraps any strategy so its candidates, with their dev results, join the shared pool for later reflections and merges.

nodes.name: EditStrategy
nodes.summary: Pool strategy that applies a random declared-value neighbour instead of a reflected change, serving as the random-edit comparison arm.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Core data model of the meta-harness: the Workflow that judges (task, checks, oracle, suite, objectives, evidence policy, capabilities), the Profile that acts (routing, budgets, prompt, hints, steps, adapter, exemplars), and the Proposal that can carry only a profile, each fixed by digest.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes frozen dataclasses for judging records with Pydantic models (Profile, Budgets) that refuse unknown fields; digests include source hashes of callables, so changed check code means a changed workflow.

nodes.name: Objective
nodes.summary: One objective the gate checks: direction, tolerance or upper bound, unit and provenance, validated on creation.

nodes.name: default_objectives
nodes.summary: Default objectives: success up, with model calls and wall clock non-inferior within 5%.

nodes.name: EvidencePolicy
nodes.summary: The meta-gate thresholds: minimum cases and disagreements, alpha, evaluation reuse limit, call tolerance, model-call cap, demotion alpha, sequential looks and false-accept margin.

nodes.name: SuiteCase
nodes.summary: One case in a suite (id, input, expected answer, metadata) with a digest reference.

nodes.name: Suite
nodes.summary: The dev, selection and held-out case splits with provenance, a digest and a problems() check.

nodes.name: Capability
nodes.summary: One action the executor can take, with its effect class and loss scale; unknown effects count as irreversible and need a person confirmation.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: A user-declared model with a per-run call cap, a paid flag and an optional adapter loader for LoRA use.

nodes.name: PipelineStep
nodes.summary: An optional step a profile may add after the answer to revise the output, naming the library op and authority it uses; it never judges.

nodes.name: Workflow
nodes.summary: The frozen judging document: task template, checks, oracle, suite, models, objectives, policy, optional steps, capabilities, held-out vault, code root and examples, with problem checks, answer-leak detection and a source-aware digest.

nodes.name: Budgets
nodes.summary: Pydantic budget limits for model calls, wall clock and output characters.

nodes.name: Profile
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of the acting settings only (routing, budgets, prompt, hints, checks, pipeline, retries, layout, distillates, code overlay, adapter, exemplars); refuses unknown fields and validates against a workflow, including a navigator plan check for pipeline steps.

nodes.name: parse_profile
nodes.summary: Parses a profile from data, returning it, or None with the reason (unknown fields, wrong types).

nodes.name: profile_diff
nodes.summary: Returns the fields that differ between two profiles with their base and candidate values.

nodes.name: Proposal
nodes.summary: A candidate profile with its base digest, proposer, strategy, predicted direction per objective, source runs and diff, with digests for the candidate and the whole proposal.

nodes.name: select.py
nodes.summary: Racing on the selection split: successive halving of candidate profiles paired against the base in blocks, dropping the candidates with the fewest net wins so the held-out split is spent once, on the winner.

nodes.name: Race
nodes.summary: Result of a race: ranking, winner if any, cases and calls used, why it stopped, and per-block records.

nodes.name: race
nodes.summary: Runs candidates against the base block by block on the selection split, discards blocks the budget cut short, drops the weakest by net wins, and returns a winner only when it beat the base on net.

nodes.name: steps.py
nodes.summary: Built-in pipeline steps for recovery remedies: repair_with_tests runs the example tests shown in the task in the sandbox and lets the model fix failures for a few rounds, and second_look asks the model again to confirm an over-used label; every extra call is metered.

nodes.name: python_code
nodes.summary: Extracts the first fenced code block that defines a function, else the first fenced block, else the whole reply.

nodes.name: shown_tests
nodes.summary: Collects the import and assert lines shown in a task text, the only tests the repair step runs.

nodes.name: run_shown
nodes.summary: Checks that code parses, defines a function and passes the shown asserts out of process, returning an empty string or the failure.

nodes.name: repair_with_tests
nodes.summary: Builds a pipeline step that runs the shown tests on the answer code and asks the model to fix each failure, for at most a set number of rounds.

nodes.name: labels_named
nodes.summary: Lists which declared labels a text names, ignoring a label that appears only inside a longer named label.

nodes.name: second_look
nodes.summary: Builds a pipeline step that, when the answer is a given over-used label, asks the model once more and keeps a revision naming exactly one label.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: The profile store and run ledger: two append-only, hash-chained files whose validation hook enforces versioning rules such as an initial first version, activation only with a decision digest and a named non-automated person, and rollbacks or demotions only to approved versions.

nodes.name: _store_rules
nodes.summary: Validation hook for every store row: checks workflow confirmation rows, profile digests, gapless version numbers, version kinds, person acceptance for activations and rollbacks, and approved targets for rollback and demotion.

nodes.name: ProfileStore
nodes.summary: Hash-chained store of workflow confirmations, profiles by digest and numbered versions, exposing the head, approved versions, appends and chain verification.

nodes.name: RunLedger
nodes.summary: Hash-chained ledger with one row per run, evaluation and decision, plus vault and incident rows, with lookup, row listing and verification.

nodes.name: surface.py
nodes.summary: Exposes the meta-harness to the MCP server: loads workflows from a user-owned Python file named by an environment variable, converts every reply to the same JSON envelope as the Python API, and lets a person approve a change only from a session other than the one that proposed it.

nodes.name: _json
nodes.summary: Recursively converts a value to JSON-safe data via model_dump, to_dict or dataclass fields, falling back to repr for other objects.

nodes.name: as_json
nodes.summary: Converts a reply envelope to JSON, adding digest fields for proposals, reports and decisions.

nodes.name: Surface
nodes.summary: Per-process holder of meta-harnesses by workflow name that serves inspect, propose, evaluate, decide, diagnose, approve and rollback, tracking which session proposed what and refusing approvals without a typed person name.

nodes.name: approval_question
nodes.summary: Builds the question that asks a person to type their name to approve a recorded change.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.navigator: re-exports op cards, the authority rule and plan checking and running, so a caller can read one op card and check a plan of op calls before anything runs.

nodes.name: authority.py
nodes.summary: The authority rule for plan ops: reads each op authority class from a digest-bound census table, refuses ops below A1, and refuses acting ops (external, irreversible or with an undeclared effect) below A2.

nodes.name: shipped_authority
nodes.summary: Builds the library authority reading from the census, counting a row only for the exact contract digest it was read for.

nodes.name: measured
nodes.summary: Returns an op authority class from a reading, or None when it has none on the ladder.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Why an op is not cleared: its class, whether it was measured, the effect it was judged on, the class it needs and the error code.

nodes.name: judge
nodes.summary: Applies the authority rule to one op, returning None when cleared or a Finding when its class is too low for its effect.

nodes.name: catalog.py
nodes.summary: Builds one op card from its ParamContract and its component block: purpose, maturity, authority class, required and optional parameters, side effect, cost and an example, trimmed to a character limit.

nodes.name: contract_for
nodes.summary: Looks up an op ParamContract in the loaded contracts, or None.

nodes.name: listed_ops
nodes.summary: Returns the ops a component block lists for itself.

nodes.name: ops_of
nodes.summary: Returns every op a contract declares on a component or its block lists.

nodes.name: purpose
nodes.summary: Returns the component help line for an op, truncated, or an empty string.

nodes.name: card
nodes.summary: Builds one op card from its contract and component (purpose, maturity, authority, parameters, effect, cost, example), or None when neither names the op.

nodes.name: _fit
nodes.summary: Fits a card within the character limit by dropping the example first, then optional parameter types, then their names.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: Static check and checked run of a plan of op calls: check_plan judges every step against the registry, contracts, sensitive ops, argument types, the authority rule and a maximum side effect, reporting stable G6_E_* codes; run_plan executes steps only after the whole plan passes.
nodes.languageNotes: Reports and results carry the cross-surface envelope fields (completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id, run_id) and validate their state in __post_init__.

nodes.name: _plain
nodes.summary: Makes a JSON-safe copy of an answer so a result can cross a surface.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.summary: One plan problem: the step it belongs to, a stable code and the reason.

nodes.name: StepCheck
nodes.summary: How one step was judged: component, op, args, whether it exists, effect, authority class, contract digest and issues.

nodes.name: PlanReport
nodes.summary: check_plan envelope: per-step checks, issues, overall effect and state (qualified-draft only when valid, else blocked-escalated), with warning card and ids.

nodes.name: _check_step
nodes.summary: Judges one step: shape, registered and loadable component, declared and non-sensitive op, argument fit to the contract, the authority rule and the maximum effect.

nodes.name: check_plan
nodes.summary: Checks every step of a plan before anything runs, using the shipped or given contracts and authority reading, and returns a PlanReport with every issue.

nodes.name: StepRun
nodes.summary: One executed step: index, component, op, ok or failed status, and result or error.

nodes.name: PlanResult
nodes.summary: run_plan envelope: the check report, the steps run and the overall state, with warning card and ids.

nodes.name: _run_step
nodes.summary: Calls the executor for one checked step and records ok or failed, treating raised errors, Failure answers and declared blocks or errors as failures.

nodes.name: run_plan
nodes.summary: Runs a plan steps in order through an executor only after check_plan passes, stopping at the first failed step; with no executor nothing runs.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for the operator: a simulation-first outer loop for a venture that runs budgeted ticks and sends outward drafts to an approval queue a person decides. Re-exports the store, gates, router, queue and loop names; its docstring states the package sends, posts and pays nothing and never labels a result verified.

nodes.name: gates.py
nodes.summary: Pure stop checks for a venture's monthly budgets on two accounts (model and cash): validates amounts and caps and returns the reason new work or a spend must stop. A missing, negative or non-numeric budget is treated as a stop, and a cap of 0 permits no spending.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: Runs one operator tick: checks the global stop and the executor's actor, reserves the task's cost on the model budget, executes the task, judges the output with the task's own checks read back from the evidence record, and gates each outward draft before queuing it for a person. Returns the reliability envelope with completion, charge, queued and blocked drafts; the best label it gives is qualified-draft.
nodes.languageNotes: Executor is a typing.Protocol, so any object with an actor attribute and an execute(task) method can drive a tick; lazy imports keep action gating and the envelope helpers off the module import path.

nodes.name: queue.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed approval queue for outward drafts (email, post, spend and similar): drafts enter as proposed and change status only through append-only decision rows recorded by a reviewer other than the drafter. Supports approve, reject and mark-sent (which charges spend drafts to the cash budget), optional decoy drafts that test reviewer attention, and an adoption path for learned guards.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite triggers (BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with RAISE(ABORT)) enforce the queue rules inside the database, so a status change without a qualifying decision row fails even if Python code is bypassed.

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic checks on an outward draft with no model call: recipient against a contact list, attributed quotes against cited evidence, quoted prices against a floor, a secret-value scan and a spend amount check, plus caller checks and learned guards. Aggregates findings into blocked-escalated when a check fails and qualified-draft otherwise; guards that are not promoted run in shadow only.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: The operator's durable SQLite state: owner-scoped ventures, append-only evidence, and a monthly ledger of reservations, releases and charges. A reservation checks the caps and writes in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, and settling charges the full reservation or a higher reported cost.
nodes.languageNotes: append_only() generates SQL triggers that refuse UPDATE, DELETE and REPLACE on a table, making evidence, ledger and decision tables append-only at the database layer.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for multi-call reasoning helpers: re-exports budget ceilings and a metered model caller, a paired compute-matched comparison gate, weighted voting, single-call and self-consistency baselines, and JSON extraction from model output. Marks the component as beta with a Python API only.

nodes.name: budget.py
nodes.summary: Hard ceilings on a reasoning run (model calls, output characters and wall-clock time) enforced by a wrapper around a model caller. MeteredCaller counts every attempt, including failures and an inner caller's retries, and refuses or raises BudgetExhausted once a ceiling is reached.

nodes.name: compare.py
nodes.summary: A paired baseline gate that promotes a candidate reasoning method over a baseline only with enough scored cases, a one-sided exact sign test below alpha, a mean improvement above a margin, and no more model calls per case than the baseline. Crashing arms and unscorable cases are counted, never hidden.

nodes.name: steps.py
nodes.summary: Baseline reasoning steppers and model-output parsing: extracts the first balanced JSON object from a reply while keeping LaTeX backslashes, solves with one model call per problem (DirectStep), and runs an n-call self-consistency vote. Failed or unparseable calls become abstentions rather than answers.

nodes.name: vote.py
nodes.summary: Pure weighted voting over candidate answers: groups equivalent answers, lets verified candidates override unverified ones, ignores invalid weights, and counts empty answers as abstentions that weigh against a majority. Reports the winner, the totals and whether a strict majority exists.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for the intake slice of the reliability pipeline that loads its public names lazily on first attribute access. Exposes stage values, task intake, failure-mode skills, the premortem replay-check constructor, the rule-based feasibility assessor and optional experience recall.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level __getattr__ (PEP 562) with importlib, so importing the package loads none of its submodules until a name is first used.

nodes.name: failure_modes.py
nodes.summary: Curated failure-mode skill data: one event-replay skill with five interpretations of a duplicate or retry requirement, plus the single supported phrasing of the nonadjacent replay requirement. relevant() matches whole trigger words in an objective; the data grants no execution authority and records its performance as unmeasured.

nodes.name: feasibility.py
nodes.summary: Rule-based feasibility triage for an intent contract: structural checks give hard blocks for missing success criteria or missing named context, while word-boundary tripwire signals can only mark a goal risky, too large or underspecified. Unchecked time bounds and figures become labelled assumptions, and an injected assessor may tighten the verdict but never relax it.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen Pydantic models (ConfigDict(frozen=True)) hold the report, and lru_cache-compiled word-boundary regexes with a preceding-negation check do the matching on NFKC-normalised text.

nodes.name: intake.py
nodes.summary: Stage 0 task intake: extracts acceptance criteria from the request (dropping filler), elicits an intent contract, runs feasibility triage, and builds an IntakeContract with task mode, structured criteria and derived escalation triggers. Returns a StageResult that blocks, downgrades or advances, including a clarification gate that is on by default and controlled by G6_PIPELINE_CLARIFICATION.

nodes.name: metacognition.py
nodes.summary: Optional experience recall across runs over a caller-supplied ExperienceStore: distill_run stores a finished run's outcome only when the store knows the run, and reconsume returns past experiences for a signature, each cited by a known run. It reports no confidence, calls no model, never raises because of the store, and its result is disclosure only.
nodes.languageNotes: ExperienceStore is a runtime_checkable typing.Protocol, so any object with has_run, add and similar methods can serve as the store.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic plan critique: structure checks for a concrete goal, real acceptance criteria, tests and a rollback, a word-boundary tripwire for risky or hand-waving wording, and a merge that lets another report only tighten the verdict. A passing plan is still only a qualified-draft, and the report can render the cross-surface envelope with a warning card.

nodes.name: premortem.py
nodes.summary: Stage 1 premortem: the fixed failure-mode checklist and a narrow regex- and AST-bounded constructor that turns one supported event-replay requirement plus an executed test assertion into a generated metamorphic replay test. The generated check is labelled task-derived and not independent, with its limits listed for a person to read before confirming.
nodes.languageNotes: Inspects test sources statically with ast.parse and ast.literal_eval, refuses ambiguous or shadowed import bindings, and never executes the supplied code.

nodes.name: stages.py
nodes.summary: Stage primitives for the reliability state machine: the ordered Stage enum from intake through learning, the advance/downgrade/block StageState enum, and the frozen StageResult with a constructor for each outcome.

nodes.name: task_contract.py
nodes.summary: Task contract value types for fit-for-purpose checks: TaskMode (evidentiary or exploratory, failing safe to evidentiary), SuccessCriterion with criticality and verifier, criterion coercion, and demote-only helpers that list why a verified result must cap to qualified-draft or record reliance on a self-declared human verifier. Re-exports shared verifier primitives from core.

nodes.name: amount_of
nodes.summary: Returns a value as a finite, positive float, or None for booleans, non-numbers, non-finite values and amounts of zero or less.

nodes.name: cap_of
nodes.summary: Reads the finite, non-negative monthly cap for one account from a caps mapping, or None when it is missing or invalid.

nodes.name: stop_reason
nodes.summary: Returns why a venture may not start new work this month: it is not active, an account has no valid budget, or committed spend is over a cap; None when work may start.

nodes.name: spend_refusal
nodes.summary: Returns why an amount may not be committed against an account this month (any stop reason, or the amount would exceed the cap), or None when the spend may proceed.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one operator task: id, description, the most one run may cost (reserved first) and the checks used to judge its output.

nodes.name: ExecutionResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for what an executor returns: output text, outward draft proposals, a reported cost that can only raise the charge, and a claimed status that is recorded but never used to decide completion.

nodes.name: Executor
nodes.summary: Protocol for anything that runs a task: it names the actor that drafts proposals (who can never approve them) and provides execute(task).

nodes.name: SimulatedExecutor
nodes.summary: The only shipped executor: replays scripted ExecutionResults by task id or from a function of the task, recording each call, with no model, shell, file or network access.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: Wraps an outward draft as an external-action capsule and runs it through the action gating evaluator, returning the decision, reason codes and message; any evaluator error becomes a block.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Runs one budgeted task for a venture: honours the global stop, validates the actor and check ids, reserves and settles the model budget, records task receipts, derives completion from the record, and gates, checks and queues each outward draft. Returns the reliability envelope with completion, receipts, charge, queued action ids and blocked drafts.

nodes.name: QueueError
nodes.summary: Exception raised for a queue decision that cannot be made, carrying a sentence a person can act on.

nodes.name: ActionQueue
nodes.summary: Owner-scoped approval queue over SQLite: enqueues checked drafts as proposed, lists and fetches them, and records approve, reject and mark-sent decisions by a reviewer who is not the drafter or an automatic reviewer. Also plants optional decoys and reports decoy stats, and lets a person adopt and promote learned guards.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one check result on a draft: the check name, a status of pass, fail, not measured or not applicable, and a reason.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a learned check that runs in shadow until promoted; sha() hashes its name and source code so a person adopts exactly that check.

nodes.name: Context
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding what the draft checks need: known contacts, a price floor, secret values to scan for, caller checks and guards.

nodes.name: Routed
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a routed draft: state, code, message, findings and shadow guard results, with the names of failed checks and a dict form for the queue review.

nodes.name: _witness
nodes.summary: Fails a draft when an attributed quote in its body is not a substring of the evidence it cites; not applicable when the draft has no attributed quote.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Runs the built-in checks, the caller's checks and promoted guards on a draft (unpromoted guards in shadow), then returns blocked-escalated if any check failed and qualified-draft otherwise, with a code saying whether nothing ran or some checks could not run.

nodes.name: append_only
nodes.summary: Generates SQL trigger statements that refuse UPDATE, DELETE and a REPLACE over an existing seq on the named table.

nodes.name: BudgetRefused
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when a spend may not start: the venture is stopped, its budget is unknown, or the cap would be exceeded.

nodes.name: OperatorStore
nodes.summary: Opens the operator SQLite database (default operator.db under the G6 home directory), installs its schema and append-only triggers, and hands out per-owner scopes.

nodes.name: OwnerScope
nodes.summary: One owner's view of the operator store: resolves venture ids only within the owner, creates and lists ventures, sets status, appends and reads evidence, and reserves and settles monthly ledger amounts in transactions that check the caps.

nodes.name: BudgetExhausted
nodes.summary: LLMError subclass raised when a reasoning ceiling is reached, so the caller stops and reports its best answer so far or abstains.

nodes.name: Budget
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of hard ceilings (model calls, output characters, wall-clock seconds) that rejects non-positive values.

nodes.name: MeteredCaller
nodes.summary: Wraps a model caller and counts every call, failed calls, inner retries and output characters; it refuses calls once a ceiling is hit and raises when a call returns after the time limit.

nodes.name: Case
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one comparison case: a problem and a scoring function, written by the case author, that maps an answer to a score between 0 and 1.

nodes.name: Arm
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one method under comparison: a name and a run function returning an answer and the model calls it used.

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a comparison result: whether the candidate was promoted and why, case counts, wins, losses, ties, p-value, mean scores, calls per case, compute matching and failure counts.

nodes.name: sign_test_p
nodes.summary: Computes the one-sided exact binomial p-value for at least the given wins out of wins plus losses.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Runs baseline and candidate arms on the same cases and promotes the candidate only when enough cases scored, it wins more than it loses with a significant sign test, its mean gain exceeds the margin, and it stays within the baseline's model calls unless matching is turned off.

nodes.name: _escape_lone_backslashes
nodes.summary: Escapes lone backslashes in a JSON blob so LaTeX such as \frac stays verbatim while real JSON escapes and unicode escapes are kept.

nodes.name: first_json_object
nodes.summary: Scans text for the first balanced brace block that parses as a JSON object, tracking strings and escapes, and raises ValueError when none is found.

nodes.name: DirectStep
nodes.summary: One model call per problem, the baseline any multi-call method must beat: asks for a JSON reply and returns its answer, or an empty string as an abstention on failure.

nodes.name: self_consistency
nodes.summary: Collects n independent DirectStep answers and runs a plain weighted vote over them, the compute-matched baseline for n calls; failed calls count as abstentions.

nodes.name: normalise
nodes.summary: Lower-cases an answer, collapses whitespace and strips trailing punctuation for default answer equivalence.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one candidate answer with a weight and a flag set only when an independent check accepted it.

nodes.name: VoteResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a vote outcome: winner, its weight, total weight, whether a strict majority exists, whether verified candidates were present, answer groups and abstained weight.

nodes.name: weighted_vote
nodes.summary: Groups equivalent candidate answers by weight, counting only verified candidates when any exist, returns no winner on a tie, and reports a majority only when the winner holds more than half the weight including abstentions.

nodes.name: __getattr__
nodes.summary: Module-level attribute hook that imports the submodule owning a public name on first access, caches the value in the package globals, and raises AttributeError for unknown names.

nodes.name: states_replay_requirement
nodes.summary: Tells whether text, lower-cased and whitespace-collapsed, is the one supported phrasing of the nonadjacent event-replay requirement.

nodes.name: Interpretation
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one reading of an ambiguous requirement: key, label, requirement text, the replay relation that checks it, and any missing capability.

nodes.name: FailureModeSkill
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a curated failure-mode skill: id, family, trigger words, interpretations, consequence, known false positives, what it will check, the decision it needs, what it cannot verify, and observed performance.

nodes.name: relevant
nodes.summary: Returns the skills that are not retired and whose trigger terms appear as whole words in a lower-cased objective.

nodes.name: ReportAssumption
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for an assumption a feasibility verdict rests on, with its source (explicit, inferred, fallback or a request figure nothing checked) and an optional confidence.

nodes.name: FeasibilityReport
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for a feasibility report: classification, optional confidence, assumptions, blockers, missing information, risk level, next step, reduction-to-practice questions, signals and source.

nodes.name: FeasibilityClassificationDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the rule verdict on an intent contract, whose completion state is fixed to qualified-draft so no other state can be constructed.

nodes.name: recommended_next_step
nodes.summary: Maps a feasibility classification to its recommended next step, such as proceed to plan, clarify missing information or define success criteria.

nodes.name: classified_text
nodes.summary: Joins an intent contract's goal, context and constraints into the lower-cased text the rules match against.

nodes.name: _matches
nodes.summary: Finds which terms occur as words in normalised text, recording terms that only appear right after a negation as negated instead of counting them.

nodes.name: names_context
nodes.summary: Tells whether a request names context it depends on, such as an attached document or an unavailable file.

nodes.name: _unchecked
nodes.summary: Lists the time bounds, cost constraint and figures beside a time bound that a request states, so they can be reported as unchecked assumptions.

nodes.name: deterministic_classify
nodes.summary: Builds the rule verdict for an intent contract: missing named context or success criteria give hard blocks, high-stakes terms or two risk axes give risky, scope words give too large or underspecified, and unchecked figures raise the risk band, with every signal recorded.

nodes.name: report_from_decision
nodes.summary: Converts a classification decision into a FeasibilityReport, adding the contract's assumptions, unchecked figures, the next step and reduction-to-practice questions for risky or too-large goals.

nodes.name: deterministic_assess
nodes.summary: Produces the rule-based feasibility report for an intent contract by classifying it and building the report.

nodes.name: at_least
nodes.summary: Holds an assessor's report to the rule floor: never less strict, the floor wins ties between different classes, risk is raised to the floor's, and the result keeps both reports' assumptions and signals.

nodes.name: FeasibilityAssessor
nodes.summary: Rule-based feasibility assessor; an injected planner with an assess method may tighten the rule verdict through at_least but never relax it, and none is shipped.

nodes.name: IntakeContract
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the task contract produced at intake: task, acceptance criteria, resource bound, intent contract, task mode, structured criteria, evidence standard, forbidden claims and escalation triggers.

nodes.name: replay_question
nodes.summary: Recognises one underspecified event-handler phrasing (idempotent, safe for retries, ignore duplicates) and returns a clarification question about nonadjacent replay semantics, or None otherwise.

nodes.name: _extract_acceptance_criteria
nodes.summary: Reads acceptance criteria from a request attribute, its context dict or its constraints, accepting newline-separated strings or lists and dropping blanks.

nodes.name: derive_escalation_triggers
nodes.summary: Restates declared intake facts as stop or escalation conditions: exploratory mode, a flagged feasibility verdict, critical criteria without an available verifier, and the intent's non-goals and failure criteria; any internal fault yields one escalate trigger.

nodes.name: _clarification_default_on
nodes.summary: Reads G6_PIPELINE_CLARIFICATION and keeps the clarification gate on unless the value is 0, false, no or off.

nodes.name: run_intake
nodes.summary: Runs Stage 0 intake on a request: requires a task and real acceptance criteria, elicits intent, assesses feasibility (an injected assessor may only tighten it), derives the task contract, and returns a block for hard or unaccepted risky verdicts or unanswered clarification, a downgrade for flagged verdicts, or an advance.

nodes.name: Experience
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one stored run experience: run id, task signature, outcome, reward and trace.

nodes.name: ExperienceStore
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol for a caller-supplied experience store: has_run is the one provenance check, add stores an experience, and similar returns up to k experiences for a signature.

nodes.name: distill_run
nodes.summary: Stores a finished run's experience only when the run id and signature are present, the reward is a finite number and the store knows the run; returns a record with provenance, no confidence and the reason.

nodes.name: reconsume
nodes.summary: Recalls up to k stored experiences for a signature, keeping only same-signature ones cited by runs the store knows, and returns them as disclosure-only history with the count of uncited records dropped.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for a plan under critique: goal, steps, acceptance criteria, risks, tests and rollback.

nodes.name: CritiqueFinding
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for one critique finding: category, severity, what is wrong, a better plan, its source and notes from merged reports.

nodes.name: CritiqueReport
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for a critique verdict and findings; pass maps to qualified-draft and anything else to blocked-escalated, and to_envelope renders the cross-surface envelope with evidence and a warning card.

nodes.name: stricter_verdict
nodes.summary: Returns the strictest of the given verdicts on the order pass, revise, block, treating an unknown verdict as block.

nodes.name: severity_verdict
nodes.summary: Returns block when any finding is high or critical, revise when there are other findings, and pass when there are none.

nodes.name: critique_structure
nodes.summary: Checks that a plan has a goal of at least four words and real, non-placeholder acceptance criteria, tests and rollback, returning the findings and verdict.

nodes.name: lexical_tripwire
nodes.summary: Scans a plan's goal, steps and risks for whole-word risky or hand-waving terms per category and returns medium-severity findings that ask for revision.

nodes.name: merge_reports
nodes.summary: Merges another critique report into the floor so it can only tighten it: one finding per category with raised severity and notes, and the strictest verdict overall.

nodes.name: critique
nodes.summary: Produces the deterministic critique of a plan: the structure checks with the lexical tripwire findings merged in.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Returns a fresh JSON-ready copy of the constructor description: two fixed check templates selected by one requirement sentence or a confirmed replay relation, not a general mechanism.

nodes.name: construct_replay_check
nodes.summary: Compiles one supported identical-retry requirement into a generated replay test by statically reading an executed test's literal state and event assertion, then returns a check pack with hypotheses, hashes, a non-independent oracle and listed limits; returns None for any unsupported or ambiguous input.

nodes.name: premortem_failure_mode_questions
nodes.summary: Maps each premortem failure-mode code to its diagnostic question.

nodes.name: Stage
nodes.summary: String enum of the reliability pipeline stages in order: intake, premortem, risk classification, epistemic contract, plan and budget, advisory routing, execution, verification, handoff and learning.

nodes.name: StageState
nodes.summary: String enum of a stage outcome: advance, downgrade or block.

nodes.name: StageResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a stage outcome with reason, safe next action, evidence bundle and metadata, built through advance, downgrade and block classmethods.

nodes.name: TaskMode
nodes.summary: String enum of how a deliverable is judged: evidentiary (may reach verified) or exploratory (capped at qualified-draft).

nodes.name: coerce_task_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves any caller value to a TaskMode, returning exploratory only on an exact match and the evidentiary default otherwise, so a typo can only make a run stricter.

nodes.name: SuccessCriterion
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one task-level success criterion with text, a critical flag and a declared verifier, plus a check for whether that verifier is actually available.

nodes.name: _coerce_one
nodes.summary: Coerces one criterion given as a SuccessCriterion, a string or a mapping into a SuccessCriterion, or drops it when it has no text.

nodes.name: derive_criteria
nodes.summary: Builds the criterion tuple for a task contract, using structured criteria when given and otherwise lifting each acceptance string into a non-critical criterion with no verifier.

nodes.name: task_contract_cap_reasons
nodes.summary: Lists why a verified result must cap to qualified-draft: exploratory mode, or a critical criterion with no available verifier; a missing or malformed contract yields no reasons.

nodes.name: task_contract_human_verifier_audit
nodes.summary: Returns one audit entry per critical criterion cleared by a self-declared human verifier marker with a level, never raising and never demoting.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for g6.research, the off-by-default research code (CSIR, RVC, ECHA, AHI); its docstring points to docs/theory/ for the specifications these modules implement.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Public surface of AHI, governed harness adaptation: re-exports the failure, learned-component and funnel contracts plus local validation and the promotion gate. A real failure motivates one minimal change that can reach shadow use at most; the code is off unless G6_ECHA_RESEARCH=1.

nodes.name: contracts.py
nodes.summary: Typed AHI contracts from ECHA spec sections 4.4-4.5: FailureCase (a witnessed failure with a root cause from a fixed taxonomy), LearnedComponent (a versioned, hash-pinned change that must list its known limitations) and Funnel (present, reachable, activated, effective counts). Re-exports AdaptationProposal and Control from the product's g6.core.adaptation_gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses validate in __post_init__, so an object with a missing required field can never be built.

nodes.name: FailureCase
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one observed failure: the failing predicate, an independent witness, severity, a root cause drawn from ROOT_CAUSES, alternative explanations and a reproducible case; construction refuses any missing field.

nodes.name: LearnedComponent
nodes.summary: Frozen description of a learned harness component with version, sha256 implementation hash, activation trigger, change scope, test provenance and rollback target; it refuses to exist without known limitations.

nodes.name: Funnel
nodes.summary: Counts evidence through the stages present, reachable, activated and effective, refusing a later stage that exceeds an earlier one and requiring a counterfactual reference before anything counts as effective.

nodes.name: lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Research-flag wrappers over the product adaptation gate (g6.core.adaptation_gate): local validation of a proposed change against controls, and a promotion decision whose best outcome is shadow approval.

nodes.name: validate_locally
nodes.summary: Checks the research flag, then runs the candidate guard on every control through the product gate's validate_locally.

nodes.name: decide_promotion
nodes.summary: Checks the research flag, then defers to the product gate's decide_promotion: unknown inputs block, a failure rejects, and the most it grants is isolated shadow use.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Public surface of the ECHA evidence kernel: re-exports typed evidence, claim and episode records, the hash-chained ledger, the claim rule, the evaluator-only access boundary and claim tracing. Nothing in the product imports it, and it stays off unless G6_ECHA_RESEARCH=1.

nodes.name: access.py
nodes.summary: Adds the ECHA research flag to the product vault (g6.core.vault), the in-process check that seals hidden tests and fixtures and refuses reads by the wrong role. It is a software check, not an operating-system boundary, so results that rely on it stay recorded as unblinded.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Subclass of the core Vault whose seal and verify_unchanged first require the research flag before delegating to the parent class.

nodes.name: guarded_read
nodes.summary: Requires the research flag, then reads a sealed file through the core vault's role check, passing the ledger so a refusal is recorded.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: Maps plain-dict records G6 already writes (a workforce check attempt and a failure elicitation record) into the kernel's EvidenceRecord and known-unknowns, using a deliberately conservative oracle category mapping for a person to confirm.

nodes.name: evidence_from_mechanism_record
nodes.summary: Builds an EvidenceRecord from a workforce mechanism record: unexecuted checks read unknown, model or human reviews become heuristic review, and only a model-free independent check becomes an independent executable; it appends a note that the category is a mapping, not a ruling.

nodes.name: known_unknowns
nodes.summary: Turns a failure elicitation record's unchecked surfaces and evidence gaps into the episode's known_unknowns strings.

nodes.name: claims.py
nodes.summary: The ECHA claim rule: computes a claim's result (supported, unsupported or inconclusive) from the evidence in the ledger, never from a hand-written value. Only active checks with a failed negative control support anything; reviews are leads, records sharing a group count as one voice, and contaminated fixtures or mismatched standards are excluded with reasons.

nodes.name: _control_holds
nodes.summary: Decides whether a check's negative control is in the ledger, really is a control, failed on its injected defect, matches the same standard, predicate and oracle, and was not taken against a contaminated fixture.

nodes.name: evaluate_claim
nodes.summary: Loads a claim and its cited evidence, sorts evidence into active, structural and lead roles, then derives the result with reasons, limits, the independent group count and a summed oracle error bound when every active oracle is bounded.

nodes.name: competence.py
nodes.summary: Competence estimation and case retrieval over ECHA episodes: a Beta posterior over a task family's decisive, intact, independently checked episodes, autonomy advice against a frozen policy, a consistency pre-check on success claims, and owner-scoped top-k retrieval through a caller-supplied retriever. Advice is never a completion state.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the regularised incomplete beta function by continued fraction (Numerical Recipes 6.4) and finds the credible lower bound by bisection, so no SciPy dependency is needed.

nodes.name: CompetencePolicy
nodes.summary: Frozen policy for autonomy advice (success threshold, minimum episodes, margin, credibility level and admitted oracle versions) that refuses settings looser than the floor and exposes a content digest.

nodes.name: CompetenceEstimate
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a competence computation: successes, failures, exclusion counts by reason, the posterior lower bound and mean, and the digest of the policy used.

nodes.name: Advice
nodes.summary: Frozen grant-or-refuse advice with its reason, policy digest and the admissibility checks applied.

nodes.name: _betacf
nodes.summary: Continued-fraction evaluation for the regularised incomplete beta function, used by the Beta CDF.

nodes.name: _exclusion
nodes.summary: Returns why an episode is inadmissible for a task family (other family, broken record, oracle not independent or not admitted, outcome not decisive), or an empty string when it counts.

nodes.name: competence
nodes.summary: Counts admissible verified and blocked-escalated episodes for a task family and returns a Beta(1+successes, 1+failures) estimate with its lower credible bound.

nodes.name: autonomy_advice
nodes.summary: Advises granting or refusing autonomy: refuses when the estimate came from another policy, has too few admissible episodes, or its lower bound sits under threshold plus margin.

nodes.name: ConsistencyVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen verdict of the success-claim pre-check: a consistent flag and the problems found.

nodes.name: success_claim_consistent
nodes.summary: Checks that a verified episode is internally consistent: an intact record with a recorded step, an artifact, cited evidence and no incident. Necessary, never sufficient.

nodes.name: ScoredEpisode
nodes.summary: Frozen retrieval hit: episode id, score, score scale and the retriever backend name.

nodes.name: similar_episodes
nodes.summary: Retrieves the top-k episodes of one owner whose case text best matches a query, skipping other owners, unselected outcomes, inconsistent successes and empty texts, applying a score floor and naming the backend.

nodes.name: custody.py
nodes.summary: Bounded research handoff of evaluator receipts: strict JSON decoding of untrusted bytes with size limits and no duplicate keys or non-finite numbers, and an adapter that turns a receipt bound to a CheckBinding into a non-independent, unblinded EvidenceRecord. Matching digests are documented as never proving trusted transport custody.

nodes.name: CheckBinding
nodes.summary: Frozen binding of a request, task and predicate to sha256 digests of the artifact, standard, fixture and evaluator, validating every identifier and digest on construction.

nodes.name: _decode
nodes.summary: Requires the research flag and parses size-bounded UTF-8 JSON into an object, refusing duplicate keys, NaN or infinity and non-object payloads with one ValueError type.

nodes.name: decode_artifact
nodes.summary: Decodes an untrusted artifact handoff of up to 256 KiB; no field grants authority or evidence.

nodes.name: checked_evidence
nodes.summary: Decodes an evaluator receipt, checks that its fields match the expected binding and result set exactly, and returns a PARTIAL_FALSIFIER EvidenceRecord with an id derived from the binding digest and explicit limitations.

nodes.name: episodes.py
nodes.summary: An ECHA episode as an append-only, hash-chained record: a builder that enforces event kinds, short id-only details, a forecast before the single outcome and wire outcome states, plus a verifier that re-applies every builder rule to a stored episode so edits, removals or reordering show.
nodes.languageNotes: Each event's sha256 covers its sequence number, kind, detail and the previous hash, with the header digest as genesis: a lightweight hash chain.

nodes.name: _detail
nodes.summary: Validates an event detail mapping so it holds only short scalars or short lists of them (ids, codes, counts), never text or nested structures.

nodes.name: verify_episode_body
nodes.summary: Lists every problem with a stored episode: missing header keys, a genesis that does not match the header, broken event links or hashes, a wrong head, a missing or unforecast outcome, and builder rule violations.

nodes.name: _builder_rules
nodes.summary: Re-applies the builder's rules to a stored body: schema version, allowed outcome state, boolean oracle access, finite non-negative costs and latency, artifact hash format, one outcome, no forecast after it, and valid event kinds and details.

nodes.name: EpisodeRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen finished episode: header, genesis, chained events, head, artifact hash, outcome state, evidence references, known unknowns, cost and latency, with to_dict for ledger storage.

nodes.name: Episode
nodes.summary: Builder for one episode: validates the header on creation, appends hash-linked events under ordering rules, and freeze closes it with an outcome state and returns an EpisodeRecord.

nodes.name: example.py
nodes.summary: Runnable synthetic end-to-end evidence trace (python -m g6.research.echa.example OUT.jsonl, with the research flag on): writes a ledger with one supported claim backed by a probe with a negative control, one inconclusive claim resting on three same-family reviews, and a check that cannot fail recorded as a structural protection.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Writes the example standard, vault, evidence records, one episode and two claims into a ledger and returns the ids of the expected supported and inconclusive claims.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Command-line entry that requires the research flag, builds the example into a JSONL ledger, prints each claim's computed verdict and whether the supported claim's trace checks out.

nodes.name: flag.py
nodes.summary: The ECHA research flag: research_enabled reads G6_ECHA_RESEARCH and accepts only a plain yes, and require_research raises ResearchDisabled otherwise, so every kernel entry point refuses while the flag is off.

nodes.name: ResearchDisabled
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when the ECHA research flag is off, meaning nothing was created, written or read.

nodes.name: research_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns true only when G6_ECHA_RESEARCH (from the environment or a given mapping) is 1, true, yes or on; never raises.

nodes.name: require_research
nodes.summary: Raises ResearchDisabled with setup guidance unless the research flag is on; called at the start of every kernel entry point.

nodes.name: ledger.py
nodes.summary: The ECHA evidence ledger: wraps the product's hash-chained ChainLedger (g6.core.ledger) with semantic checks so evidence names a recorded standard, a sealed vault and a failed negative control, claims and episodes cite evidence that exists, and audits can be anchored to a head a reviewer kept. Stored in memory or as JSON lines.

nodes.name: _semantic
nodes.summary: Validates one ledger entry against the entries before it: standards parse, evidence names a known standard, sealed vault and a qualifying failed negative control, claims and episodes reference evidence present in the ledger, and vaults and incidents have required fields.

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.summary: Research-flagged facade over ChainLedger with typed add methods for standards, evidence, claims, episodes, vaults and incidents, lookup and verify methods, an offline audit, and contaminated_fixtures for fixtures with a recorded incident.

nodes.name: records.py
nodes.summary: The kernel's typed value objects StandardRef, EvidenceRecord and ClaimRecord, validated at construction and hashed as canonical JSON, plus the shared canonical, digest and text or hex validation helpers. A claim carries no result field because its result is computed from evidence.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serialises any object to canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: Returns the sha256 hex digest of an object's canonical JSON.

nodes.name: text_of
nodes.summary: Validates that a value is text and, when required, not blank, raising ValueError otherwise.

nodes.name: texts_of
nodes.summary: Validates a list or tuple of text items, optionally requiring at least one, and returns them as a tuple.

nodes.name: hex64_of
nodes.summary: Validates that a value is a lowercase 64-character sha256 hex digest.

nodes.name: StandardRef
nodes.summary: Frozen task standard: id, text, provenance, mandatory predicates and a sha256 that must equal the hash of the text; from_text computes the hash.

nodes.name: EvidenceRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one oracle on one predicate with scope, independence, fixture, negative control reference and an optional error bound; construction enforces the category, result and purpose vocabularies and the rules tying independence to a sealed fixture.

nodes.name: ClaimRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen statement of what a report claims was established (subject, predicate, scope, breadth, estimand, assumptions, limits, versions and cited evidence), validated on construction and without any result field.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Traces a claim back to everything it rests on: the standard and its hash check, each cited evidence record with its negative control and contamination status, the episodes that used the evidence, the computed verdict, and whether the ledger chain still verifies and is anchored.

nodes.name: trace_claim
nodes.summary: Builds the full trace dictionary for a claim, collecting problems for missing evidence or controls and hash mismatches alongside evaluate_claim's verdict and the ledger head.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Public surface of the mission bridge: re-exports the typed mission graph (MissionIR, Node, Standard), its pre-run validator (validate, Finding, OpFact) and the bridge's own flag helpers. Off unless G6_MISSION_BRIDGE=1.

nodes.name: bundle.py
nodes.summary: Builds a mission's claim and evidence bundle: maps each node Observation to an ECHA evidence category, writes them with the frozen standard into a fresh kernel ledger, evaluates each claim with the kernel's claim rule, and sets the mission state to verified, qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with every gap named. A formal observation counts only with a valid certificate from a named formal checker.
nodes.languageNotes: Input problems are collected and raised together in one BundleRefused exception rather than failing on the first.

nodes.name: BundleRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying every problem that stopped a bundle from being built.

nodes.name: Observation
nodes.summary: Frozen record of what one node produced (kind, result, scope, source operation, group, sealed fixture, negative control, certificate), refusing missing fields or values outside the allowed kinds, results and purposes.

nodes.name: ClaimSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen claim specification: predicate, statement, scope, cited observation ids, breadth, materiality and an optional gate a person must decide.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Frozen per-claim outcome: supported, unsupported or unknown, with reasons and the kernel's own result.

nodes.name: Bundle
nodes.summary: Frozen bundle result: mission state, outcomes, unknowns, rejected observations, the standard and the ledger, with a helper listing the evidence records written.

nodes.name: standard_ref
nodes.summary: Loads a fixture's frozen standard and returns it as the kernel's StandardRef.

nodes.name: _record
nodes.summary: Translates an Observation into an EvidenceRecord by kind: process to no evidence, model opinion to heuristic review, formal to FORMAL_CHECK only with a valid certificate, executable to independent or partial depending on a sealed fixture; returns why it was rejected when relevant.

nodes.name: _refusals
nodes.summary: Collects every input problem before a bundle is built: standard hash or predicate mismatch, observations naming unknown nodes, operations or predicates, unrecorded negative controls, duplicate or unbacked claims, and decisions for gates the graph lacks.

nodes.name: _outcome
nodes.summary: Converts the kernel verdict for one claim into an Outcome, downgrading a supported claim to unknown when its required human decision is missing.

nodes.name: build_bundle
nodes.summary: Refuses bad input, records vaults and observations into a new ledger with controls before checks, adds and evaluates each claim, and returns the assembled Bundle; ledger errors become BundleRefused.

nodes.name: _bundle
nodes.summary: Derives the mission state from material outcomes and lists unknowns, including predicates no claim covers.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: The mission-graph validator: a pure screen over a MissionIR and an operation catalogue that reports every problem with a stable code (type mismatches, missing prerequisites, duplicate providers, cycles, unknown or under-authorised operations, a lowered standard, unapproved egress, budget overruns, missing roles, self-verification). A clean result means the graph is well formed, not that its conclusions are true.

nodes.name: OpFact
nodes.summary: Frozen catalogue entry for one operation: its declared side effect and authority class (A0-A4), validated on construction.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Frozen validator finding: a stable code, the node it concerns and a detail message.

nodes.name: _graph
nodes.summary: Checks the graph's data flow: one provider per name, every requirement provided with a matching type, verify targets that exist, and no cycles via a topological sort.

nodes.name: _authority
nodes.summary: Checks each non-gate node against the catalogue for unknown or unmeasured operations, misdeclared effects, and authority below what the effect needs; returns each node's effective side effect.

nodes.name: _standard
nodes.summary: Flags nodes whose own standard cites a different hash or drops any of the mission's predicates.

nodes.name: _egress
nodes.summary: Flags nodes whose data leaves the machine without an approval of the right scope, requiring a sensitive-data approval for sensitive data.

nodes.name: _roles
