nodes.summary: Flags required roles no node fills and nodes that verify the output of their own component.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Requires the bridge flag and runs every check (graph, authority, standard, egress, budget, roles), returning all findings; an empty list passes this screen only.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package docstring for the CSIR kernel of the Runtime Validator Constructor, describing its four modules: the typing judgement with obligations A1-A6, standard refinement, certificates and evidence states, and the advisory solvability belief. Off unless G6_MISSION_BRIDGE=1.

nodes.name: certificate.py
nodes.summary: The research rig's adapter to the product certificate issuer (g6.evidence.certificate): judges a MissionIR with the CSIR judgement, binds it to a FrozenStandard, and passes the resulting MissionFacts to the product issue and verify functions. Re-exports the issuer's types for the rig and its tests.

nodes.name: facts_of
nodes.summary: Judges a mission against the catalogue and packs its hashes, predicates, gates, obligation violations, cost and catalogue digest into MissionFacts for the issuer.

nodes.name: issue
nodes.summary: Requires the bridge flag and issues a certificate for an artifact from the mission's facts, checks, receipts, decisions and an optional solvability statement.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Lists every inconsistency in a certificate body for the artifact bytes, optionally also against a mission and its frozen standard.

nodes.name: judgement.py
nodes.summary: The CSIR typing judgement over a MissionIR: runs the validator plus a parallel-writers check and files every finding under the soundness obligation A1-A6 it breaks, along with the mission's inputs, outputs, worst side effect and composed cost. A mission is sound only when no obligation is broken.
nodes.languageNotes: Encodes a typing judgement from the CSIR theory as a dataclass result; unknown costs compose to unknown rather than zero.

nodes.name: Resources
nodes.summary: Frozen resource vector holding cents, where None means unknown and compose returns unknown if any part is unknown.

nodes.name: Judgement
nodes.summary: Frozen judgement result: violations per obligation, consumed inputs, yielded outputs, the effect bound and resources, with sound and codes properties.

nodes.name: _ancestors
nodes.summary: Computes each node's ancestor set from provider and requirement links with memoised depth-first walks, skipping cycles left for the validator to report.

nodes.name: judge
nodes.summary: Requires the bridge flag, computes effective effects, groups validator and parallel-writer findings by obligation, and returns the Judgement with interface, effect bound and composed resources.

nodes.name: solvability.py
nodes.summary: An advisory solvability belief on three separate axes (existence, findability, optimality) that must state its basis and never gates an attempt or changes a completion state; it renders a plain sentence for a mission result.

nodes.name: Solvability
nodes.summary: Frozen belief record validated for allowed values, a stated basis for every belief that is not unknown, a named proof for optimality and no contradiction between findability and believed unsolvability; permits_attempt always returns true, and describe and as_dict render it.

nodes.name: standard.py
nodes.summary: Standard refinement for CSIR: a FrozenStandard changes only by a re-freeze that adds at least one predicate with a reason and names its parent's hash, and chain_problems checks a revision chain offline. There is no operation that removes a predicate.

nodes.name: NotARefinement
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a re-freeze would not refine the standard it starts from.

nodes.name: FrozenStandard
nodes.summary: Frozen versioned standard with sorted predicates, parent hash and reason; first creates version 1 and sha256 hashes its canonical body.

nodes.name: refines
nodes.summary: Returns whether a new standard keeps the same id and every predicate of the old one.

nodes.name: refreeze
nodes.summary: Creates the next revision by adding new predicates with a stated reason, refusing when nothing new is added or no reason is given.

nodes.name: chain_problems
nodes.summary: Lists every break in a revision chain: a wrong starting version, parent hash or version mismatches, another standard's id, or dropped predicates.

nodes.name: fixtures.py
nodes.summary: Loads the mission bridge's synthetic JSON fixtures (medico-legal, engineering and coding missions, their recordings, frozen standards and the replay catalogue) from the adjacent fixtures folder, returning a fresh dict on each call.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Returns a named mission document ready for MissionIR.from_dict.

nodes.name: recording
nodes.summary: Returns a mission's synthetic inputs, gate decisions and node outputs for replay.

nodes.name: standard_body
nodes.summary: Returns a mission's frozen standard body: id, provenance, predicates and exact text.

nodes.name: replay_record
nodes.summary: Returns the replay catalogue record with its provenance.

nodes.name: replay_catalogue
nodes.summary: Builds a mapping of operation name to OpFact from the replay catalogue record.

nodes.name: coding.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic mission graph for coding change verification (synthetic-coding-001): seven nodes from intake through baseline tests, a test-weakening integrity check and a merge-approval gate, with the coding standard hash and predicates. Read by the off-by-default mission-bridge research code as a MissionIR document.

nodes.name: coding.recording.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic placeholder recording for replaying the coding mission graph: input values, the approved merge gate and one recorded output per work node. No operation was run; the values are placeholders.

nodes.name: engineering.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic high-stakes engineering design-study mission graph (synthetic-engineering-001) with scope, standards search, calculations, formal check, geometry, supply and person-decided approval and engineer-review gates under a 500-cent budget.

nodes.name: engineering.recording.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic placeholder recording for replaying the engineering mission graph: four inputs including the design load, two gate decisions and placeholder outputs for each work node.

nodes.name: medico_legal.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic high-stakes medico-legal claims research mission graph (synthetic-medico-legal-001): scope, source search and retrieval check, legal analysis, debate challenge, image assessment and review, with search, image-permission and expert sign-off gates.

nodes.name: medico_legal.recording.json
nodes.summary: Synthetic placeholder recording for replaying the medico-legal mission graph: case data and jurisdiction inputs, three gate decisions and placeholder outputs per work node.

nodes.name: replay_catalogue.json
nodes.summary: Catalogue of the operations the mission fixtures name, giving each its declared effect and an authority class (A0-A4) taken from the shipped census or explicitly marked as assumed, tied to a census build, date and digest. No operation here was probed or run.

nodes.name: standards.json
nodes.summary: Frozen synthetic standards for the three mission domains (medico-legal, engineering, coding): each has a standard id, text, provenance note and the predicates a mission must satisfy.

nodes.name: flag.py
nodes.summary: Off-by-default switch for the mission-bridge research code: research_enabled reads the G6_MISSION_BRIDGE environment flag (only a plain yes turns it on) and require_research raises ResearchDisabled otherwise.

nodes.name: ir.py
nodes.summary: Defines MissionIR, the research mission graph as typed, hashed, immutable dataclasses (nodes, standards, approvals), and a strict reader that refuses unknown fields, wrong types or out-of-set values with every problem listed. Part of the off-by-default mission-bridge research code.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses plus a canonical JSON dump give each mission a stable sha256; the reader accumulates problems in a list instead of failing on the first one.

nodes.name: replay.py
nodes.summary: Replays a MissionIR graph in dependency order over recorded values without running any operation, marking each step replayed, decided, awaiting a person, blocked, unrecorded or mismatched, and listing names nothing provides.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses graphlib.TopologicalSorter for dependency order and turns a CycleError into a readable ValueError.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the safety engine: documents the runtime ceilings, policy check and test-weakening scan, and re-exports TestWeakeningReport, detect_test_weakening and read_snapshot.

nodes.name: ceilings.py
nodes.summary: Hard runtime ceiling check: exceeds_ceiling projects tool calls, shell commands, files, lines, retries, runtime, privilege and cost before an action runs and returns the first breach with a self-describing reason.

nodes.name: kill_switch.py
nodes.summary: Per-run, in-memory, one-way kill switch: once tripped it keeps its first reason, and reset requires a process-private token that planner data can never reference.

nodes.name: policy_engine.py
nodes.summary: Pre-action decision point: PolicyEngine.authorize_action checks kill switch and process stop, ceilings, guard block and escalate verdicts, validator quorum, tool allow-list and forbidden paths, returning ALLOW, BLOCK or ESCALATE.

nodes.name: quorum.py
nodes.summary: Validator-vote counting gate: de-duplicates votes by declared fault domain and requires a valid n = 3f + 1 quorum shape before counting accepts; it proves nothing about real independence.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Shared safety-engine dataclasses: the frozen trusted RuntimePolicy, the untrusted ActionRequest, guard verdicts, validator votes and the AuthorizationDecision, plus Literal decision and run-status vocabularies.

nodes.name: state.py
nodes.summary: Mutable RunState for one safety-governed run: cumulative counters, the run-scoped kill switch and the trusted policy, with projection helpers that let ceilings be checked before an action runs.

nodes.name: weakening.py
nodes.summary: Static before/after comparison that detects whether a change weakened the tests: removed or guarded checks, fewer tests, early returns, added skips or mocks, module-level patches, conftest and pytest or CI configuration changes. Nothing runs, and a clean result is at best qualified-draft.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks Python ASTs to count checks per test while discounting asserts inside catch-all handlers or suppress blocks; reads pytest settings with tomllib and configparser.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for governed self-modification: documents the promotion gate, change-scope check, improvement cycle and maturity scorecard, and re-exports their public names.

nodes.name: change_scope.py
nodes.summary: Pure path check for a proposed self-modification: classify_change_scope blocks deletions, paths outside the repository or the target component and test-configuration files, and asks for a person on protected paths.

nodes.name: diagnosis.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic first classification of why a component audit fell short, using fixed rules on maturity level, shape score and error text patterns; names the rule that fired instead of a confidence number.

nodes.name: improvement_loop.py
nodes.summary: One governed improvement cycle with injected callables: sense, propose, evaluate, gate through govern_patch_promotion, snapshot, apply, remeasure and roll back on regression, reading the process-wide stop before each phase. Its best result is qualified-draft.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a private exception (_Halt) to end the cycle early after the result is filled in, so the public entry never raises.

nodes.name: patch_promotion_gate.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, fail-closed, down-only promotion gate for proposed harness patches: assigns a risk band R0-R5 from surfaces and effect flags, hard-blocks permission expansion, safety weakening, irreversible or protected-path changes, and checks evaluation criteria and evaluator independence.

nodes.name: persistence.py
nodes.summary: ScorecardStore keeps the maturity scorecard as an append-only JSONL audit log and a JSON scorecard in an explicit directory; flags hold the maturity level until resolved with evidence and high promotions need a passing reviewed audit.

nodes.name: ResearchDisabled
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when the mission-bridge research flag is off, so nothing was built or judged.

nodes.name: research_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns True only when the G6_MISSION_BRIDGE flag holds a plain yes (1, true, yes, on); anything else, including a typo, is off. Never raises.

nodes.name: require_research
nodes.summary: Guard called by every mission-bridge entry point; raises ResearchDisabled unless the research flag is on.

nodes.name: IRRejected
nodes.summary: ValueError carrying every problem found in a mission document the bridge refuses to read.

nodes.name: Standard
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the mission-wide standard: its id, sha256 hash and predicates.

nodes.name: NodeStandard
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the standard a node works to; it may add predicates but may not drop one or change the hash.

nodes.name: Approval
nodes.summary: Frozen record of an approval naming a node and its scope (egress or sensitive egress).

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Frozen mission-graph node: role, source operation, declared effect, typed requires and provides, data class, egress, budget, verifies target, optional standard and a gate flag for a person decision.

nodes.name: MissionIR
nodes.summary: The whole mission graph as an immutable record, with as_dict for canonical output, a sha256 property over the canonical JSON and a from_dict constructor that checks the research flag and reads strictly.

nodes.name: _fields
nodes.summary: Checks a mapping against allowed and required key sets, recording unknown or missing fields as problems.

nodes.name: _node
nodes.summary: Reads one raw node into a Node, validating its id, operation pattern, effect, typed fields, data class, egress, budget, standard and gate rules.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Reads a whole mission document into MissionIR: top-level fields, standard, nodes with duplicate-id checks, approvals and required roles, collecting every problem.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one replayed node: its operation, declared effect, gate flag, status and the names it still needs.

nodes.name: Trace
nodes.summary: Frozen replay result: the ordered steps, the names nothing provides, and ran_operations, which is always 0.

nodes.name: _check_names
nodes.summary: Rejects inputs, decisions or recordings that name something outside the mission graph (non-inputs, non-gates or gate nodes with recordings).

nodes.name: replay
nodes.summary: Walks the mission graph in topological order over inputs, gate decisions and recorded outputs, returning a Trace of step statuses without calling any operation.

nodes.name: exceeds_ceiling
nodes.summary: Projects each runtime axis (tool calls, shell commands, files, lines, retries, wall clock, privilege, cost) for a proposed action against the trusted policy and returns whether a ceiling is breached and why.

nodes.name: trusted_reset_token
nodes.summary: Returns the process-private sentinel object that KillSwitch.reset requires; meant only for trusted runtime or test code.

nodes.name: KillSwitch
nodes.summary: Thread-safe, run-scoped halt flag: trip is one-way and keeps the first reason; reset refuses with PermissionError unless given the trusted token.

nodes.name: PolicyEngine
nodes.summary: Authorizes or refuses one action at a time: kill switch and process stop, ceilings, guard BLOCK (which trips the kill switch), guard ESCALATE, quorum, allow-list and forbidden paths, in that order.

nodes.name: bft_shape_ok
nodes.summary: True when the policy quorum parameters satisfy n = 3f + 1 and required accepts = 2f + 1.

nodes.name: count_independent_accepts
nodes.summary: Counts approving votes once per declared fault domain, so clones declaring the same domain count once.

nodes.name: quorum_satisfied
nodes.summary: Fails closed on a malformed quorum shape, otherwise checks the de-duplicated accept count against the required accepts.

nodes.name: RuntimePolicy
nodes.summary: Frozen trusted per-run policy: step, tool, shell, file, line, retry, runtime and cost ceilings, privilege level, allowed tools, forbidden paths and quorum settings; never built from planner output.

nodes.name: ActionRequest
nodes.summary: Untrusted proposed action: tool name, arguments, reason, expected effect, files touched, privilege, shell flag, estimated lines and cost ceiling.

nodes.name: GuardVerdict
nodes.summary: A pattern guard result: ALLOW, BLOCK or ESCALATE with reason, matched patterns, risk score, evidence and surface.

nodes.name: ValidatorVote
nodes.summary: One validator vote (APPROVE, REJECT or ABSTAIN) with its id, declared fault domain, reason and evidence.

nodes.name: AuthorizationDecision
nodes.summary: The policy engine answer: decision, reason, the permitted action when allowed, the checks run and the verdicts and votes it saw.

nodes.name: RunState
nodes.summary: Run counters, kill switch and trusted policy for one run, with *_after projections for the ceiling check and record_execution, record_retry and record_cost updaters.

nodes.name: TestWeakeningReport
nodes.summary: Frozen result of the test-weakening scan: weakened flag, reasons, checked and not-checked lists; completion_state is blocked-escalated or qualified-draft, and to_envelope builds the library envelope with a G6_E_* warning card.

nodes.name: detect_test_weakening
nodes.summary: Compares test, startup and pytest or CI configuration files before and after a change and returns a TestWeakeningReport with reasons, what was checked and what could not be seen.

nodes.name: read_snapshot
nodes.summary: Reads the comparable files under a directory into a path-to-text map, skipping version-control, cache and virtual-environment folders and raising on unreadable files.

nodes.name: _kind
nodes.summary: Classifies a path as test, startup, config, runner, data or other from its lower-cased segments.

nodes.name: _files
nodes.summary: Normalises one side of the comparison from a path-to-text mapping or a directory, rejecting invalid keys and values.

nodes.name: _pytest_settings
nodes.summary: Extracts the pytest settings from pyproject.toml, pytest.ini, .pytest.ini or setup.cfg text, raising ValueError when the file cannot be parsed.

nodes.name: _config_reasons
nodes.summary: Reports a pytest configuration added, removed or changed, or one that cannot be read after the change.

nodes.name: _python_reasons
nodes.summary: Compares one Python test or startup file by AST: startup hooks, module-level patches, shadowing new modules, then test and marker differences.

nodes.name: _facts
nodes.summary: Collects per-file facts from an AST: checks per function, collected tests and their returns, markers, module-level patches and pytest hooks or collection lists.

nodes.name: _checks
nodes.summary: Counts every assert, assert-style call and parametrize case under a node that can still fail, ignoring ones inside catch-all handlers or suppress blocks.

nodes.name: _markers
nodes.summary: Counts skip, xfail, mock and autouse shapes where they are used in an AST.

nodes.name: _is_patch
nodes.summary: True for a statement that changes another module state at import time (attribute or sys.modules or environ assignment, setattr, setenv and similar calls).

nodes.name: _test_reasons
nodes.summary: Reports removed or renamed tests, a lower test count, checks that were removed or can no longer fail, and added early returns.

nodes.name: _imported
nodes.summary: Collects the top-level module names the test and startup files import, used to flag a new test module that shadows one of them.

nodes.name: ScopeVerdict
nodes.summary: String enum of scope outcomes: allow, hitl (needs a person) or block.

nodes.name: ChangeScope
nodes.summary: Frozen description of a proposed change: its target component and the changed and deleted repository paths.

nodes.name: ScopeDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen scope verdict with every reason as a G6_E_SCOPE_* code and path.

nodes.name: classify_change_scope
nodes.summary: Returns the strictest verdict any path earns: block for no component, empty change, deletions, outside-repo, test-config or other-component paths; hitl for protected fragments.

nodes.name: Diagnosis
nodes.summary: Frozen diagnosis: component, failure class, description, suggested fix, the rule basis that fired and whether it blocks.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: Classifies one audit shortfall by fixed rules: maturity level and shape score first, then error text patterns, then a runtime_error fallback.

nodes.name: diagnose_audit
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs diagnose on the fields of an AuditResult.

nodes.name: ImprovementCycleResult
nodes.summary: What one improvement cycle did: stage, completion state, warning code and message, patch, evaluation, decision and the separate applied, remeasured, rolled-back and rollback-failed states; to_dict builds the library envelope.

nodes.name: _apply_phase
nodes.summary: Applies an approved patch, remeasures and keeps it only when the regression check answers False; otherwise rolls it back and reports a failed rollback as still applied.

nodes.name: run_improvement_cycle
nodes.summary: Public entry for one improvement cycle with injected sense, propose, evaluate, apply, remeasure, regression and snapshot callables; never raises and fails closed to blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: _cycle
nodes.summary: The cycle body: checks the stop and on/off settings, senses, proposes, evaluates, gates through govern_patch_promotion, snapshots and verifies the decision digest before handing off to the apply phase.

nodes.name: make_no_eval_report
nodes.summary: Returns an empty PatchEvalReport as an honest stand-in when nothing evaluated the patch, so the gate rejects it.

nodes.name: HarnessPatch
nodes.summary: A proposed harness change: target surfaces, permission, safety, data and external-action changes, review removal, reversibility and rollback method, touched paths and the concrete diff.

nodes.name: PatchEvalReport
nodes.summary: Caller-supplied evaluation of a candidate patch: targeted fix, regression pass rate, safety violations, injection resilience, metric improvement, evaluator confidence, independence and evaluator id.

nodes.name: PromotionDecision
nodes.summary: The gate decision: action, risk band, reliability label, whether a person is needed, auto-promotable flag, reasons and the digest of the patch decided on.

nodes.name: patch_digest
nodes.summary: sha256 over a patch diff, sorted touched paths and target surfaces, binding a decision to an exact change.

nodes.name: decision_matches
nodes.summary: True when a decision carries a digest equal to the patch digest; an applier checks this before applying.

nodes.name: classify_patch_risk
nodes.summary: Assigns the risk band R0-R5 as the maximum of per-surface base bands and effect-flag floors; unknown surfaces count as R3.

nodes.name: protected_paths_touched
nodes.summary: Lists touched paths that hit a protected fragment or cannot be placed inside the repository after normalisation.

nodes.name: _invalid_scores
nodes.summary: Rejects evaluation scores that are not finite numbers in range, so NaN cannot pass the thresholds.

nodes.name: _promotion_criteria_failures
nodes.summary: Lists every failed promotion criterion: targeted fix, regression pass rate, safety violations, injection resilience, metric improvement and evaluator confidence.

nodes.name: govern_patch_promotion
nodes.summary: Decides the promotion action for a patch, only ever tightening: rejects empty surfaces, blocks prohibited or hard-rule violations, rejects failed criteria, routes off-limits surfaces and non-independent evaluation to people, then maps the risk band to promote_auto, canary or a review path.

nodes.name: PromotionRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when ScorecardStore.promote refuses a promotion; the message says why.

nodes.name: ScorecardStore
nodes.summary: File-backed maturity scorecard: append_audit logs a result and sets the latest evidenced level, promote enforces flag and reviewed-audit rules, flag and resolve_flag manage holds, and audit_history reads the log.

nodes.name: _resolve_store_dir
nodes.summary: Requires an explicit store directory, using an absolute path as given and placing a relative one under the G6 state directory.

nodes.name: _promotion_refusal
nodes.summary: Explains why a promotion is refused: a flagged component cannot rise, and high levels need a latest audit that passed on a reviewed rubric.

nodes.name: regression_delta.py
nodes.summary: Compares a test-suite run that includes a change against a baseline run and returns passed, failed or unevaluable, counting new failures, tests no longer collected and newly skipped tests. Parses pytest FAILED/ERROR summary lines and converts a verdict into a patch-promotion evaluation report that never counts as an independent evaluation.

nodes.name: failing_node_ids
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of pytest node ids reported as FAILED or ERROR from a run's output, stripping ANSI colour codes first.

nodes.name: RunSummary
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one suite run: the failing, collected and skipped node ids, plus whether the run produced a verdict at all.

nodes.name: RegressionVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen regression verdict holding the state, new failures, lost and newly skipped tests and the reasons; converts itself into a PatchEvalReport with independent_eval set to False.

nodes.name: regression_delta
nodes.summary: Judges a change run against a baseline: unevaluable when the run gave no verdict, collected nothing or has no usable baseline; failed on new failures, lost tests or newly skipped tests; otherwise passed.

nodes.name: rubrics.py
nodes.summary: Scores a component's output against the structured shape assertions in a rubric and turns an audit into a maturity level from 0 to 5, capping unreviewed or unevaluable rubrics at level 3. Also provides a registry that loads rubrics from JSON files and records any file that fails to parse.

nodes.name: _resolve
nodes.summary: Walks a dot-separated path through nested mappings or object attributes and returns the value found and whether it was found.

nodes.name: _holds
nodes.summary: Applies one named check (not_empty, numeric comparisons, eq, contains, type_is, length_gte, in_set) to a value, raising on an unknown check or an unknown type name.

nodes.name: evaluate_assertion
nodes.summary: Applies one rubric assertion to an output, failing it with an error message when the field is missing or the check cannot be evaluated.

nodes.name: evaluate_rubric
nodes.summary: Computes the weighted share of a rubric's assertions that an output meets; a rubric with no assertions or zero total weight is marked unevaluable with score 0.

nodes.name: classify_tier
nodes.summary: Maps an invocation result and rubric score to a maturity level: 0 to 2 for not found, import failure or other errors, 3 when no reviewed rubric evaluated the output, and 4 or 5 for reviewed shape scores. It never returns level 6.

nodes.name: audit_output
nodes.summary: Scores one invocation the caller already ran against a rubric and packages the level, score, assertion results and timestamp into an AuditResult.

nodes.name: RubricRegistry
nodes.summary: Holds rubrics by component, with registration in code, lookup by component and op, listing, dict export, and bulk loading from a directory of JSON files that collects load errors instead of stopping.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for the maturity scorecard: shape assertions, rubric provenance, component rubrics, assertion and rubric scores, audit results, per-component maturity scores and the overall scorecard. Defines the level names (not-found through promoted), the publication threshold of 5 and the cap of 3 for unreviewed rubrics.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses frozen Pydantic v2 models (ConfigDict(frozen=True)) and typing.Literal unions so maturity levels and check names are restricted when a model is validated.

nodes.name: RubricAssertion
nodes.summary: One shape assertion: a check applied to the value at a dot-path field, with an optional expected value, a non-negative weight and a description.

nodes.name: RubricProvenance
nodes.summary: Records who reviewed a rubric and their notes; an empty reviewer means nobody reviewed it.

nodes.name: ComponentRubric
nodes.summary: The shape assertions, test input and provenance for one component op, with a reviewed property that is true only when a reviewer is named.

nodes.name: AssertionResult
nodes.summary: Result of applying one assertion: whether it passed, the actual value found and any error.

nodes.name: RubricScore
nodes.summary: A rubric applied to one output: the evaluable flag, weighted score, reviewed flag, per-assertion results and a reason. An unevaluable score is never read as a pass.

nodes.name: AuditResult
nodes.summary: One audit of a component op: the maturity level and name earned, whether it passed the threshold, the score, evaluability, review status, assertion results, error and timestamp.

nodes.name: MaturityScore
nodes.summary: A component's standing on the scorecard: current and highest-seen level and where the current one came from, audit and pass counts, last score details and any unresolved flag.

nodes.name: ComponentScorecard
nodes.summary: Scorecard of every scored component, with counts above and below the threshold and of flagged components.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.solver, which runs a goal through a fixed 15-step table of caller-supplied step callables and never labels a run above qualified-draft. Re-exports the planner, engine, schema, step executor, registries, constraint checks and quality checker, and lists which parts of the older solver were deliberately not ported.

nodes.name: agentic_evidence.py
nodes.summary: Builds the decision trace for a solver run, summarising for each planning decision whether a model or the deterministic fallback made it and counting degraded fallbacks. Redacts Windows and Unix absolute paths from details and rationales before they reach an envelope.

nodes.name: redact
nodes.summary: Replaces Windows drive paths and common Unix absolute paths in a value's text with a <path> placeholder.

nodes.name: summarize_agentic_evidence
nodes.summary: Normalises decision records and returns counts of model-made, fallback and degraded decisions, a per-decision map, and a warning for each decision that fell back even though a model was supplied.

nodes.name: agentic_runtime.py
nodes.summary: Optional model-backed planning for the solver: SolverPlanner decides task complexity, which steps run and which candidate answer is kept, each with a deterministic fallback when no model is supplied or its reply is invalid. Every decision records whether a model made it and whether it degraded, and the model is never asked for a completion state.

nodes.name: SolverDecisionError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a model reply is not a usable, validated planning decision; it extends ValueError.

nodes.name: Decision
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one planning decision: its name, whether a model was used, whether it degraded, a detail string and the rationale.

nodes.name: SolverPlanner
nodes.summary: Wraps an optional LLMCaller and makes three validated decisions (complexity, step plan, answer selection), falling back to the keyword classifier, the step profile or the first candidate on any model failure. A model plan always keeps the goal, construction and evaluation steps, and answer selection can only pick an existing candidate.

nodes.name: category_registry.py
nodes.summary: Defines component categories and a registry of named fallback runners per category, used when a solver step's own runner returns nothing usable. Builds an ordered, de-duplicated fallback chain across a step's categories.

nodes.name: ComponentCategory
nodes.summary: String enum of the fallback runner categories: context, safety, alignment, adaptation, agents, standalone, utility and orchestration.

nodes.name: CategoryRegistry
nodes.summary: Stores named fallback runners per category in registration order and returns the combined fallback chain for a list of categories, each runner name once.

nodes.name: complexity_classifier.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic heuristic that labels a goal simple, moderate or complex from surface features such as length, multi-part markers, domain words, list items and question or imperative openings. It decides how many solver steps run, not whether an answer is right.

nodes.name: TaskComplexity
nodes.summary: String enum of the three task complexity levels: simple, moderate and complex.

nodes.name: classify_task
nodes.summary: Scores a goal's word count, multi-part phrases, commas, domain keywords, list items and opening phrase to classify it; very short goals default to moderate, and imperative goals with domain words are never simple.

nodes.name: constraints.py
nodes.summary: Deterministically checks caller-supplied constraints (contains, excludes, max_chars, min_chars) against the solver's final answer. Reports any constraint that cannot be checked so the run is refused instead of silently ignoring it.

nodes.name: constraint_problem
nodes.summary: Returns why a ConstraintSpec cannot be checked (no kind, a missing value or threshold, or a parameter its kind does not use), or None when it can.

nodes.name: evaluate_constraint
nodes.summary: Checks one constraint against the answer and returns a deterministic NamedCheck that passes or fails, or is unchecked when there is no answer.

nodes.name: evaluate_constraints
nodes.summary: Runs every constraint against the answer and returns the checks plus a constraints_satisfied map keyed by the raw constraint text, leaving out unchecked ones.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: The solver orchestrator: plans complexity and steps, runs each planned step through the caller's runners with retries and category fallbacks, picks the final answer by a complexity-dependent step priority, runs the constraint checks and an optional quality check, and builds the labelled SolverOutput. Refuses empty goals, production mode, reviewer signatures and uncheckable constraints before any step runs.

nodes.name: RunPlan
nodes.summary: Frozen plan for a run: the complexity, the steps to run, the steps the caller skipped and the planning decisions made.

nodes.name: plan_run
nodes.summary: Decides a run's complexity (a caller override or the planner) and its step set, passing the caller's real constraints to the planner and removing caller-skipped steps, without running any step.

nodes.name: _refusal
nodes.summary: Returns the G6_E_* code and reason that refuse a run before any step: a goal under 3 characters, production mode, any reviewer signature, or a constraint that cannot be checked.

nodes.name: _final_answer
nodes.summary: Collects distinct answer texts from completed steps in priority order, lets the planner choose when there are two or more candidates, and otherwise falls back to the longest string a priority step returned.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Runs a full solver pass: rejects unknown runner names, applies the refusals, plans the run, executes or skips each of the 15 steps with read-only views of earlier outputs, derives the run status, selects and checks the answer, and returns a SolverOutput with agentic evidence.

nodes.name: llm_quality_checker.py
nodes.summary: Two-phase quality check of a solver answer: a deterministic red-flag scan first, then an optional model judgment of whether the answer is a genuine attempt. A missing model, a model error or an unparseable reply yields unchecked rather than acceptance, and no confidence number is reported.

nodes.name: QualityVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen quality verdict (pass, fail or unchecked) with the method used and the issues found; converts to a NamedCheck that is marked deterministic only for the red-flag phase.

nodes.name: LLMQualityChecker
nodes.summary: Runs the red-flag scan and then, if a model is supplied, asks it for a boolean acceptable field, treating any call failure or malformed reply as unchecked.

nodes.name: red_flag_detector.py
nodes.summary: Cheap deterministic detection of unusable output: empty text, refusal phrases and looping 3 to 5 word phrases, with a higher repetition bar on code steps and no repetition check for text that parses as Python. A flag shows an output is bad, but having no flags is never counted as a pass.

nodes.name: RedFlag
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one red flag: its name and a detail message.

nodes.name: is_refusal
nodes.summary: Returns whether text matches one of the refusal patterns, such as an apology followed by cannot or unable.

nodes.name: red_flags
nodes.summary: Returns EMPTY_OUTPUT, REPETITION and REFUSAL flags for a text, raising the repetition threshold to 6 on code steps 8 to 10 and skipping the repetition check for valid Python.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic request and result types for the solver plus its labelling rules: the completion state is limited to qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, so no run can claim verified. Derives typed failure records, the check outcome, the blocking G6_E_* code and the completion state, and renders a SolverOutput as a cross-surface reliability envelope with a warning card and evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: A Pydantic model_validator(mode=after) re-derives completion_state, outcome, success and failures on every construction, so callers cannot hand-set them; extra=forbid turns unread input fields into validation errors.

nodes.name: ConstraintSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen requirement on the final answer: raw text, a kind (contains, excludes, max_chars, min_chars) and its value or threshold; extra fields are rejected.

nodes.name: SolverInput
nodes.summary: One solver request: goal, context, constraints, an optional complexity override, steps to skip (validated to the range 1 to 15), run mode and reviewer signature; unknown fields are rejected.

nodes.name: NamedCheck
nodes.summary: One check that ran, or could not run, on the final answer, marked deterministic or model judgment, with a pass, fail or unchecked verdict.

nodes.name: StepResult
nodes.summary: What one of the 15 steps did: status, output, reason, attempt count, latency and whether a fallback runner produced it.

nodes.name: SolverFailure
nodes.summary: Typed degradation record naming the failed dependency, the fallback chosen, the confidence impact and the operator action required.

nodes.name: derive_solver_failures
nodes.summary: Builds one SolverFailure for each step that failed, had no runner, or completed only through a fallback runner, each naming the operator action required.

nodes.name: derive_outcome
nodes.summary: Returns failed if any check failed, passed only when at least one deterministic check ran and all of them passed, and unchecked otherwise, so a model judgment can lower the outcome but never raise it.

nodes.name: blocking_code
nodes.summary: Returns the G6_E_* code that blocks a run (refused, step failed, no answer, check failed), or an empty string when the run may stand as a qualified draft.

nodes.name: derive_completion_state
nodes.summary: Maps a run's visible fields to blocked-escalated when a blocking code applies and to qualified-draft otherwise; it never returns verified.

nodes.name: SolverOutput
nodes.summary: The result of one run, whose completion state, outcome, success, failures and degradation are re-derived on construction; to_envelope builds the reliability envelope with a G6_E_* warning card and evidence for checks, steps, failures and agentic decisions.

nodes.name: step_executor.py
nodes.summary: Runs one solver step through the caller's runner up to the step's maximum attempts, then tries each category fallback once, recording attempts, latency and which fallback was used. An output counts as usable only when it is a non-empty string or mapping that is not a refusal; a step with no runner is unavailable.

nodes.name: StepContext
nodes.summary: Frozen view a runner receives: goal, context, constraints, planned complexity, step metadata and the outputs of earlier completed steps.

nodes.name: answer_text
nodes.summary: Returns the first non-blank string found under the ordered answer keys (final_answer, value, result, answer and others) of a step output.

nodes.name: usable_output
nodes.summary: Normalises a runner's return value into an output mapping, rejecting None, non-string keys, other types, empty content and refusals with a reason.

nodes.name: execute_step
nodes.summary: Tries the step's runner up to max_attempts times and then each fallback runner, returning a completed, unavailable or failed StepResult with attempts, latency and de-duplicated failure reasons.

nodes.name: step_profiles.py
nodes.summary: Maps each task complexity level to the solver steps that run: steps 1, 8, 10 and 11 for simple tasks, those plus step 12 for moderate tasks, and all 15 for complex tasks.

nodes.name: ExecutionProfile
nodes.summary: Frozen pairing of a complexity level with its active steps, with a property giving the skipped steps.

nodes.name: profile_for
nodes.summary: Returns the deterministic ExecutionProfile for a complexity level given as an enum or a string.

nodes.name: step_registry.py
nodes.summary: Defines the fixed 15-step solver table (goal setting through metalearning), each step with a runner name, title, fallback categories and retry count, and a registry for looking steps up by number or name. Exposes a shared STEP_REGISTRY instance.

nodes.name: StepMeta
nodes.summary: Frozen metadata for one step: number, runner name, title, the fallback categories tried in order, and the maximum attempts (3 by default).

nodes.name: StepRegistry
nodes.summary: Iterable registry over the 15 steps in order, with lookups by number or runner name and helpers that list all names and numbers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Classifies a Python error into a category from its built-in exception class, attaches a fixed hint, and sets a posture of auto_heal, review or escalate that rules can only raise. An optional caller-supplied model can name a category the table could not and raise the posture; every result stays qualified-draft because it is not a diagnosis.

nodes.name: Triage
nodes.summary: Frozen triage result with category, hint, posture, reasons, source (table or model) and a qualified-draft completion state; requires_review is true for any posture above auto_heal.

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.summary: Returns the stricter of two postures in the order auto_heal, review, escalate, raising on an unknown posture.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Derives the category from the exception class name, raises the posture to review for unknown classes, messages pointing at another category, or errors touching the network, files or memory, and to escalate when a safety check refused the fix.

nodes.name: refine
nodes.summary: Asks a caller-supplied model for a category and posture in JSON, accepting a new category only where the table said unknown and only ever raising the posture; an unreadable reply leaves the result unchanged.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.workforce, a local coding mission under a frozen standard: a person allows execution and confirms the standard, the caller's agent submits a patch, and G6 runs the checks and states what the evidence supports. Re-exports the public functions of workforce.api and documents the limits of its isolation, approvals and labels.

nodes.name: acceptance.py
nodes.summary: Compiles a mission's acceptance contract (what counts as done) from the intent engine's contract and the mission's risk level, then measures it against facts gathered from ledger rows and applies it to the result. Unmet or unchecked requirements hold the result at qualified-draft, results below the required state become blocked-escalated, each check's mechanism and strength is recorded, and failure surfaces such as regressions or weakened tests are reported as passed, failed or not tested.
nodes.languageNotes: A pure module built from frozen dataclasses and lookup tables; contracts serialise to sorted, compact JSON so their SHA-256 digest is stable, and optional fields are emitted only when set so older contracts keep their digest.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen requirement that must hold for a mission to count as done: a name, a predicate from the closed set, its parameters, and a problem string explaining why it cannot be measured as written.

nodes.name: requirement
nodes.summary: Builds a Requirement from loosely written input, recording a problem instead of raising when the predicate is unknown or parameters are missing, extra or of the wrong type.

nodes.name: unit_requirements
nodes.summary: Turns a plan's per-unit checks into requirements, defaulting each predicate's unit to the unit itself or, for a verify unit, to the unit it judges.

nodes.name: AcceptanceContract
nodes.summary: Frozen acceptance contract for a mission: requirements, verification requirements, risk level, required completion state, cost and latency limits, deadline, approvals, objective verifiers, allowed degradations, derivation sources and revision. Serialises to canonical JSON with a SHA-256 digest and re-reads stored contracts through the same validation.

nodes.name: spec_complete
nodes.summary: Asks the intent engine's elicitor whether the owner's spec is complete, counting checkpoints as success criteria and never accepting a declined clarification that leaves nothing to check.

nodes.name: risk_code
nodes.summary: Returns a contract's risk code from R0 to R3, treating an unrecognised risk name as R3 so it fails closed.

nodes.name: derive
nodes.summary: Derives the risk code a task demands from the declared code, the strongest risk signals in the task's own words and any extra floors, recording each source; the highest wins and nothing lowers the declared value.

nodes.name: base_tier
nodes.summary: Returns the stakes a mission was accepted at before planning, from its declared and code-derived sources, falling back to the contract's own risk code.

nodes.name: code_floor
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum risk code that the task's own words and template demand of every step, or R0 when nothing does.

nodes.name: describe_standard
nodes.summary: Renders the standard in plain words: the stakes and the reasons that raised them above the declared value.

nodes.name: standard_words
nodes.summary: Describes a contract's standard in plain words, or returns an empty string for a contract kept before standards were derived.

nodes.name: weaker
nodes.summary: Lists in plain words every way a proposed contract would ask less than the current one: lower stakes, a weaker result, dropped checks, requirements, approvals or objective checks, or more allowed degradation.

nodes.name: strengthen
nodes.summary: Raises a contract to at least a given risk code and adds missing requirements as the next revision, appending what raised it; returns the same object when nothing rises and never lowers anything.

nodes.name: for_plan
nodes.summary: Raises the standard once the plan is known: the mission rises to its highest step, each raising step is recorded with its reversibility, and each irreversible step owes a state_confirmed requirement.

nodes.name: _deadline
nodes.summary: Parses a deadline as a timezone-aware ISO date-time and returns it in UTC, or explains why it cannot be read.

nodes.name: floor
nodes.summary: Ensures a contract never asks less than its mission's risk level: it adds that level's verification requirements, and at R3 requires a verified result, a person's approval and objective verifiers.

nodes.name: compile_contract
nodes.summary: Compiles the mission's AcceptanceContract from the owner's intent contract: derives the risk code, validates overrides so they can only raise what is required, turns checkpoints into predicate requirements and unnamed success criteria into uncheckable ones, and records spec completeness, the deadline and the budget limit.

nodes.name: unreadable
nodes.summary: Builds a fail-closed placeholder contract for a stored contract that cannot be read, holding the result at qualified-draft, or blocking it at R3.

nodes.name: cannot_check
nodes.summary: Returns the contract's requirements that no predicate can measure.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Produces the plain-text lines the owner reads before confirming what counts as done: the stakes and why they were raised, each requirement and whether G6 can check it, the verification requirements, the selected executor, constructed checks, declared functions and open questions.

nodes.name: mechanism_of
nodes.summary: Maps a check's kind, model-free flag and op to its ledger mechanism, such as test_execution, formal_proof_check, receipt_validation or human_review.

nodes.name: tally
nodes.summary: Counts passed and total tests when a check's answer carries a map from test ids to booleans.

nodes.name: mechanism_record
nodes.summary: Builds the ledger record of one check attempt: mechanism, check, judged unit, artifact, op, kind, the executed, independent and model-free flags, result and measurements, plus authority and failure surfaces when given.

nodes.name: unit_strength
nodes.summary: Rates one output's check strength from none to objective; objective needs an executed, independent, model-free objective check that passed, and a failure a person set aside never counts as a pass.

nodes.name: weakest
nodes.summary: Returns the weakest strength in a collection, or none when it is empty.

nodes.name: code_surfaces
nodes.summary: Reports a code change's failure surfaces as verify_task checked them: whether its tests pass, whether deliberate mutations were caught, and whether a test was weakened; surfaces that were not checked are left out.

nodes.name: exercised
nodes.summary: Returns the failure surfaces one executed check challenged and their status, including a test run's result for the original bug and a failed receipt check for an unconfirmed action.

nodes.name: unit_classes
nodes.summary: Returns the kinds of work a step does: code when a test check judges it, and external when one of its ops reaches outside or cannot be undone.

nodes.name: _acted
nodes.summary: Challenges a step that acts outside on its gate approvals and send receipts, marking approval_missing and action_unconfirmed as passed or failed.

nodes.name: surfaces_of
nodes.summary: Lists each do step's failure surfaces as passed, failed or not tested, combining check records with evidence about external actions; a surface no check exercised is never passed.

nodes.name: surface_text
nodes.summary: Renders a failure surface and its status in plain words: the claim, the failure, or the open question.

nodes.name: _counterexamples
nodes.summary: Counts the failures a check found from its own measurements: failed tests plus deliberate mutations its tests missed.

nodes.name: elicitation_record
nodes.summary: Builds one verify cycle's failure elicitation record: the surfaces targeted, the strategies and probes run, counterexamples, evidence gaps, confirmed failures and remaining unchecked surfaces, using only ids and counts.

nodes.name: Facts
nodes.summary: Frozen facts a contract is measured on: do units and their outputs, check records, gate approvals, send receipt states, degradations, timing, kinds of work and upstream gates.

nodes.name: _from_verdict
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a mechanism record from an older verdict row for a check that closed before ledger records were kept.

nodes.name: gather
nodes.summary: Collects the facts from ledger rows: each do unit's latest output, the newest check records on it (including a person's set-asides), gate decisions with re-asked questions treated as undecided, receipt states and degradations.

nodes.name: Measured
nodes.summary: Frozen result of measuring one requirement: name, status (met, unmet or unmeasured), reason and predicate.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.summary: Measures one requirement against the facts for each predicate (approved, receipt, check_passed, tests_passed, state_confirmed, output_present, fields_present, field_equals, each_has), returning met, unmet or unmeasured with a reason; nothing is met by default.

nodes.name: _verification
nodes.summary: Measures one verification requirement across every do unit's latest output, such as every result passing an independent or objective check, or a person approving a step.

nodes.name: _limits
nodes.summary: Measures a contract's deadline and maximum latency against when, and how quickly, the mission finished.

nodes.name: Evaluation
nodes.summary: Frozen record of how a mission met its contract: measured requirements, verification and limits, check records, per-output and overall strength, required state, acceptance, allowed degradations, failure surfaces and adjudicator; converts to and from dicts.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Applies a contract to a result: demotes it to qualified-draft for each unmet or unmeasured requirement, and to blocked-escalated when it is below the required state unless the only shortfall is an allowed degradation on objectively checked work; it never promotes.

nodes.name: activation.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in, read-only report on one owner's finished missions against fourteen tracked metrics, including stage coverage, standard activation, retrieval and reuse of learned checks, selection precision and recall, recovery, cost per verified outcome and human minutes per accepted task. Each metric carries its numerator, denominator and source missions, and a metric without data or ground-truth labels is reported unmeasured rather than as 0 or 1.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Builds the full metrics report for an owner's finished missions (optionally a single venture), computing each metric overall and per task class, placing toolset size beside recall, and adding the capability funnel.

nodes.name: _metrics
nodes.summary: Computes all fourteen metrics for a set of read missions, using only missions from the objective entry for the headline coverage.

nodes.name: _toolset
nodes.summary: Measures the mean number of candidate routes offered per mission in preflight shortlists, with a per-stage breakdown.

nodes.name: _precision
nodes.summary: Measures selection precision only against caller-supplied route labels, reporting it unmeasured without labels and keeping the count of selected routes that ran under a separate name.

nodes.name: _ran
nodes.summary: Decides whether the step or stage a scheduler decision chose shows an executed row: a closed output, an executed verdict, a decided gate, or valid reproduction receipts.

nodes.name: _silent
nodes.summary: Reports silent-error detection as unmeasured and separately counts how often a failure search caught a problem in proposals that had passed their agreed tests.

nodes.name: _recovery
nodes.summary: Counts each change of course after a failure (a send-back, or a route change on a failure trigger) and how many of them led to a later result that passed every check.

nodes.name: _recovered
nodes.summary: Checks whether one recovery attempt succeeded: a later artifact passed every verify check for the unit, or the reproduction then ran.

nodes.name: _history
nodes.summary: Reads every learning decision and mission start across all of an owner's ventures from the evidence table with SQL, ordered by time and then row.

nodes.name: _covering
nodes.summary: Returns the approved learned checks that covered a mission's task when it began, removing checks retired before that time.

nodes.name: _unpriced
nodes.summary: Counts the spending records in a mission that carry no known amount; each is treated as unknown, never as zero.

nodes.name: _cost
nodes.summary: Computes the known cost of finished missions per verified outcome, reporting it unmeasured when any amount is unknown or there is no verified outcome.

nodes.name: _minutes
nodes.summary: Measures terminal minutes per accepted task, reporting it unmeasured when any intervention's time was not measured.

nodes.name: _declared
nodes.summary: Reports the minutes people said their decisions on accepted tasks took, and how long questions waited for answers, each kept apart from measured time.

nodes.name: _funnel
nodes.summary: Counts how far each capability gets: present (a shipped contract), reachable (latest probe passed for this owner), invoked (called by a finished mission) and effective (always unmeasured), with a per-capability breakdown.

nodes.name: api.py
nodes.summary: Library facade for a local coding mission: bind the local stores, allow execution of a repository revision, create a mission with a frozen standard, confirm it, submit a patch, record decisions, and read the status and certificate. Every approval is recorded under the identity the approver callable returns and marked as unauthenticated.

nodes.name: NotConfirmed
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when the approver refuses or gives no identity, meaning nothing was recorded.

nodes.name: bind
nodes.summary: Opens, or creates, the local workforce stores and the owner's named venture under the workspace root, optionally setting the database directory, and returns a bound Workforce.

nodes.name: repository_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the directory that holds a venture's git repositories.

nodes.name: allow_execution
nodes.summary: Shows the approver what running a repository's code at its current revision and content means and records the permission, raising NotConfirmed on refusal; returns the repository, revision and content digest allowed.

nodes.name: create_coding_mission
nodes.summary: Validates the risk code and builds the repository scope, then compiles a coding objective into a mission with a frozen standard, baseline snapshot and required tests.

nodes.name: answer_clarification
nodes.summary: Records the answer to the one clarification a replay objective asks before its standard is frozen.

nodes.name: confirm
nodes.summary: Shows the frozen standard to the approver, records the confirmation under the identity returned, and advances the coding mission's checks.

nodes.name: submit_patch
nodes.summary: Submits the full new text of the permitted files so G6 checks the patch under the frozen standard.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Records a person's answer to a gate or to a disagreement between checks (approve, reject, uphold or set aside) and advances the mission.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Returns a mission's completion state, result and pending items, adding every step, check and receipt when detail is full.

nodes.name: certificate
nodes.summary: Returns the certificate kept when the mission closed, or issues one now on the latest patch.

nodes.name: bench.py
nodes.summary: The workforce's test bench capability: runs the named tests of a venture's repository in a scratch copy with a patch applied, refuses patches that edit tests, runner configuration or paths outside the copy, and compares the whole suite with the unpatched baseline to catch regressions. A second op runs named tests in place in a git repository; every result is an envelope in which unstarted or interrupted runs count as unmeasured, never as passes.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps a bounded, lock-guarded module-level cache of suite baselines keyed by repository path and content digest, with a per-key threading lock so concurrent callers share one baseline run.

nodes.name: ready
nodes.summary: Returns whether pytest can be found in this interpreter, which the bench needs.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Explains why the bench cannot run an op here: pytest is missing, or git is missing for the in-place op.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes run_tests: validates tests and files, copies the repository to a scratch directory, applies the patch, refuses test edits, runs each named test in isolation, compares the whole suite, checks that neither the original nor the scratch tests changed, and returns an envelope with per-test results, the suite comparison and any degradation.

nodes.name: _suite_baseline
nodes.summary: Runs the unpatched repository's whole suite once per distinct content in a scratch copy and keeps it in a bounded, lock-protected process cache, retrying runs whose runner never started.

nodes.name: _suite
nodes.summary: Compares the patched copy's whole suite with the baseline, failing on any previously passing test that still does not pass after a rerun for flaky tests, and reporting not_run when no comparison is possible.

nodes.name: _attributed
nodes.summary: Classifies the last isolated run of a test as not started, failed (timed out, exited early or missing the positive control), or reported.

nodes.name: _in_place
nodes.summary: Runs run_tests_in_place through repo_tests against the venture's git repository, refusing when a tracked file changed, and returns counts, the verdict and the interpreter source.

nodes.name: _files
nodes.summary: Validates a patch's files: paths must stay inside the repository and may not be tests, runner configuration, .pth files, pytest or standard-library module names, and each content must be text.

nodes.name: workspace_root
nodes.summary: Returns the workforce root directory from G6_WORKFORCE_DB_DIR, or the default G6 state path.

nodes.name: _repo
nodes.summary: Resolves a repository name to a directory under the venture's repos folder, refusing invalid names, unbound ventures and paths that escape it; returns None for the probe's own repository.

nodes.name: _tests_altered
nodes.summary: Returns the first test file whose bytes differ between the original repository and the scratch copy.

nodes.name: calls.py
nodes.summary: The single door through which a workforce worker calls a capability. Before invoking it refuses calls while G6 is stopped, outside the worker's allowlist, without a contract, with bad parameters, writing ops from read-only workers, costs that cannot be bounded under a strict budget, or anything the safety PolicyEngine denies; sent calls run inside a time window, get a cost entry recorded at once and come back only as an Outcome. It also provides a one-call, read-only prober for capability probes.

nodes.name: CallResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one door call: component, op, outcome, reply, model call counts, refusal and raise details, contract digest and cost entry.

nodes.name: venture_invoke
nodes.summary: Returns an invoke callable scoped to one venture, so the bench reaches only that venture's repositories, or that delegates to a scripted test world.

nodes.name: _engine_refusal
nodes.summary: Maps a policy engine decision to a refusal code: killed, budget, clock, ceiling or policy.

nodes.name: Door
nodes.summary: One worker's door for one attempt: checks the stop state, allowlist, contract, parameters, read-only rules, whether a cost can be bounded under a strict budget, the policy engine and an optional budget reservation, then invokes the op inside a contained time window, records its cost first and returns a CallResult. reply reshapes results for capability probes.

nodes.name: _Prober
nodes.summary: Forms a one-call, read-only prober worker for a probed pair, with the cost allowance its contract declares, and sends the probe through a fresh Door.

nodes.name: prober
nodes.summary: Returns the prober that Capabilities.probe calls, which forms a one-call, read-only worker per probed pair.

nodes.name: capabilities.py
nodes.summary: Capability readiness ladder for each component op (undeclared, declared, registered, loads, deps_installed, probe_passed, measured_suitable), stopping at the first rung it fails and saying why. Parses and validates ParamContract JSON files with a stable digest, and records probes per owner in an append-only SQLite table guarded by triggers.
nodes.languageNotes: The preflight_runs table has SQLite BEFORE UPDATE, BEFORE DELETE and duplicate-INSERT triggers that RAISE(ABORT), making probe rows append-only; shipped contracts are parsed once per process with functools.lru_cache.

nodes.name: _operational
nodes.summary: Validates a contract's operational block: exactly the expected keys, failure-mode claims each with a mode and a test id as evidence, distinct introduced failure modes, known state names, and a test id as state evidence.

nodes.name: ParamContract
nodes.summary: Frozen contract for one op: required and optional typed keys, probe parameters, the expected answer field, side effect, check method, digest and optional declarations (model-free, shadow probe, packages, cost ceiling, reuse window, operational block). from_dict validates every field and computes a stable SHA-256 over the declared parts.

nodes.name: shipped_contracts
nodes.summary: Returns the workforce's own shipped contracts from params/workforce.*.json, parsed once per process.

nodes.name: load_contracts
nodes.summary: Loads every contract JSON file in a directory, defaulting to the shipped workforce contracts.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Parses every matching contract JSON file in a directory, requiring each file name to match its component and op.

nodes.name: probe_verdict
nodes.summary: Judges one probe answer: it passes only when it is neither blocked-escalated nor degraded and carries the contract's expected field.

nodes.name: Readiness
nodes.summary: Frozen readiness reading for one component op with its level, reason and probe details; at_least compares positions on the ladder.

nodes.name: Capabilities
nodes.summary: One owner's live view of what can run: creates the preflight_runs table, computes each op's static rung (the bench or an injected registry), reads the latest probe row within its time to live, lists probes coming due, matches ready pairs, and runs probes through the door, recording each attempt.

nodes.name: chain.py
nodes.summary: Reads a component's reply envelope as a verdict of status, ok and reason: errors, unknown or timed-out answers, missing satisfiable or valid values, and degraded results without an answer are not measured; blocked-escalated results are a no; only a clean answer is ok. Vendored from an older venture module, keeping only StepResult and verdict.

nodes.name: StepResult
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one chain step: name, status, ok flag, reason and optional evidence.

nodes.name: verdict
nodes.summary: Interprets the component result inside an envelope as (status, ok, reason) and never trusts the envelope's ok flag alone: errors, unknown answers, ambiguous statuses and degraded results without an answer are not measured.

nodes.name: classes.py
nodes.summary: Maps every workforce failure code to one of the Ledger's 14 failure classes, and from the class derives the recovery step, whether the runtime may retry by itself, the stable G6_E_* code people see, and a four-part explanation of what failed and what would resolve it.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Returns the Ledger failure class for a failure code: empty for no failure and UNKNOWN for a code nobody mapped, so an unmapped code never reads as success.

nodes.name: recovery
nodes.summary: Returns the first recovery step the Ledger hierarchy calls for given a failure code's class, or empty when there is no failure.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Describes, in words a person can act on, what would resolve a failure with the given code at the time it is read.

nodes.name: problem
nodes.summary: Builds the structured four-part problem record (what failed and why, how material it is, what would resolve it, and the stable code) that the result contract renders.

nodes.name: explain
nodes.summary: Joins the four-part problem description into one message with the stable code placed last.

nodes.name: why_retry
nodes.summary: Explains why another attempt is worth its cost for a failure code, citing the evidence that a retry could succeed.

nodes.name: retried_by_runtime
nodes.summary: Tells whether the runtime may try a unit again by itself after a failure with this code.

nodes.name: surface_code
nodes.summary: Returns the stable G6_E_* code a person sees for a failure code.

nodes.name: coding.py
nodes.summary: Compiles a bounded Python repository objective into a governed coding mission: checks execution permission and a clean git state, freezes a standard (baseline snapshot, required tests, scope, permissions, budget, attempt limit), reproduces the failure, plans patch, check and regression units, and runs the repair ladder (feedback, focused brief, person) until the patch passes or the mission stops for a person.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python's ast module heavily to read test functions, assertions and function bodies from the customer's repository without importing or running it.

nodes.name: names_access
nodes.summary: Detects whether an objective mentions any access term in any spelling (hyphenated, underscored or joined), which routes a code change to the confirmation path or a refusal.

nodes.name: access_terms
nodes.summary: Returns the password or credential terms that send a code change to the high-consequence R3 route with a person's confirmation instead of a refusal, only when feasibility rates the objective risky and no other access term appears.

nodes.name: plan_problems
nodes.summary: Checks that any plan for a coding mission binds every coding obligation (frozen repository, required tests, candidate artifact, regression scope, human gate) to executable checks, whoever drew the plan.

nodes.name: access_reason
nodes.summary: Gives the confirmation question's reason for a password or credential fix, or an empty string.

nodes.name: frozen
nodes.summary: Returns the frozen coding standard stored in a mission's acceptance contract, or an empty dict when it has none.

nodes.name: retry_stop
nodes.summary: Decides deterministically whether the repair loop stops (a repeated proposal, no improvement, or the attempt limit) from scores and attempt counts, with no generation or execution.

nodes.name: snapshot_problem
nodes.summary: Reports a problem when the frozen snapshot's bytes no longer match the accepted baseline digest, checked at every execution boundary.

nodes.name: _reproduce
nodes.summary: Runs each required test once on the baseline through the chosen bench route, recording a receipt per test (executed, return code, seconds, test digest) and whether the failure reproduced; stops at the first test that did not execute and refuses if the source changed during the run.

nodes.name: _defined
nodes.summary: Resolves a dotted qualified name to the repository module file (root or src layout) and the function it defines, reading syntax trees only.

nodes.name: derive_scope
nodes.summary: Derives the function a coding change may edit by resolving only the repository functions called by tests that actually failed in the bench's copy, refusing when none or several are found.

nodes.name: _declared
nodes.summary: Validates the helper functions the caller declares the objective asks to change, so behaviour differences found in them are disclosed to the person rather than sent back as defects.

nodes.name: suite_words
nodes.summary: Produces the words a person reads beside a result about which tests the frozen standard did not count.

nodes.name: _counted
nodes.summary: Filters a repository's test functions to those pytest reports as plainly passed or failed, dropping skipped, expected-failure, errored or uncollectable ones and recording why each was not counted.

nodes.name: reuse_reference
nodes.summary: Reads the code-created harness-reuse reference from a mission's creation event, never trusting caller-supplied material.

nodes.name: _reuse
nodes.summary: Creates a coding mission that reuses a completed mission's Harness Pack after strictly validating the reference, the unchanged accepted standard, the same objective, risk and budget, and a bound construction receipt; never runs repository code.

nodes.name: clarification_request
nodes.summary: Returns the code-created intake clarification request from a mission's creation event, ignoring caller materials that could impersonate it.

nodes.name: clarification_status
nodes.summary: Builds the status view of a pending coding clarification: its question, repository revision and digest, state (unanswered, recorded or unsupported), permitted answers and the next tool to call.

nodes.name: _ask_replay
nodes.summary: Creates a coding mission that pauses while eliciting, asking the person a replay-semantics question before any standard is frozen.

nodes.name: clarify
nodes.summary: Resolves a coding clarification answer once: a supported replay interpretation or "not applicable" resumes preparation, an unsupported answer is recorded without substituting a narrower check, and changes to an accepted standard are refused.

nodes.name: content_digest
nodes.summary: Computes the content digest of a repository as the bench would copy it, which a person's permission to run that code is bound to.

nodes.name: execution_terms
nodes.summary: Describes what a person allows before G6 runs a repository's code: its name, revision, content digest and the lines they read, refusing repositories that start would refuse.

nodes.name: allow_execution
nodes.summary: Records a person's permission to run the code described by the execution terms as venture evidence, with who decided, why and when; identical terms allowed again keep the first record.

nodes.name: execution_allowed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a person allowed G6 to run a repository's code at exactly this revision and content digest.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Entry point for a coding mission: refuses unsupported options and dirty or unpermitted repositories, optionally runs the readiness assessment, asks a replay question when needed, else copies the repository to a scratch snapshot and prepares the frozen standard.

nodes.name: _prepare
nodes.summary: Collects the repository's test functions, runs the whole suite on a throwaway copy to find countable tests, runs model-free intake with feasibility and access checks, and hands everything on to freeze the standard.

nodes.name: _freeze
nodes.summary: Freezes the coding standard: resolves scope, optionally constructs an additive replay check, sets the effective risk level from the declared risk and the feasibility floor, snapshots the repository, records the standard and acceptance contract, then runs preflight and advances the mission.

nodes.name: unrouted
nodes.summary: Strips the route name from each receipt in a reproduction or derived scope before it is shown in a status or a worker brief.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Moves a confirmed coding mission forward: re-checks risky intent, verifies the snapshot digest, reproduces the failure through the scheduled route with reroutes, builds the patch, check and regression plan (with an approval gate at R3), records baseline controls when certificates are on, and runs the mission.

nodes.name: _unchecked
nodes.summary: Lists each check of a plan whose only route this mission found unavailable and returns the words for a person, so no worker is asked for a change nothing can check.

nodes.name: check_submission
nodes.summary: Checks a patch submission against the frozen standard's scope without executing any submitted file.

nodes.name: repair_turn
nodes.summary: Runs the repair ladder after a failed or repeated proposal: decides whether to stop for a person or which strategy (checks' feedback or a focused brief) the send-back uses, recording reconfiguration decisions.

nodes.name: repair_stop
nodes.summary: Returns the repair ladder's stop words, or records a continuing change at once for a caller with no veto.

nodes.name: repeated
nodes.summary: Handles a proposal that repeats an earlier one byte for byte: records it and uses an attempt without judging it again, then either sends a focused brief or holds the unit for a person.

nodes.name: focused
nodes.summary: Builds the focused repair brief: only the failing checks' evidence on the rejected proposal (failing tests with their assertions, or counterexamples), its digest and its difference from the baseline.

nodes.name: _assertions
nodes.summary: Extracts a test's assert statements as written from a pytest node id, walking nested test classes and ignoring parametrize suffixes.

nodes.name: regression_replays
nodes.summary: Collects, per module function, the inputs the regression check's probes executed across a mission's closed runs.

nodes.name: repaired
nodes.summary: Tells whether a coding mission found a failure and repaired it: an earlier proposal failed with counterexamples and the latest patch passed every verify unit undegraded.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Builds a coding mission's status: the frozen standard, intake, reproduction, every recorded check result and the stop reason, optionally with the Harness Pack and readiness state.

nodes.name: harness_pack
nodes.summary: Projects existing records into an owner-scoped Harness Pack for the mission's authorised reader, never a new verdict or store, with reuse references limited to local owned records.

nodes.name: coding_certificate.py
nodes.summary: Builds a code change's certificate when G6_WORKFORCE_CERTIFICATES is on: records negative controls by running the frozen tests on the unpatched baseline and on seeded defects, then certifies the latest patch under the frozen standard and rules whether the mission outcome may rise to verified.

nodes.name: policy
nodes.summary: Returns the certificate policy in force: founder-d2 only when the owner set exactly that, otherwise honest.

nodes.name: record_controls
nodes.summary: Runs each frozen required test not yet recorded on the unpatched baseline snapshot and records one control event per test, killed when the test ran and failed; idempotent per test.

nodes.name: caught
nodes.summary: Returns the tests whose body actually ran and failed in a whole-suite run, ignoring skips, expected failures and fixture or import errors.

nodes.name: _seeded_controls
nodes.summary: For tests that passed on the baseline, seeds defects into the repository's code one at a time, runs the whole suite on a scratch copy for each, and records a killed control for every test a defect made fail, up to a run cap.

nodes.name: certify
nodes.summary: Builds the certificate for the patch's latest bytes under the mission's frozen standard, refusing when there is no frozen standard event or no patch.

nodes.name: decided
nodes.summary: Computes the mission outcome under its certificate and what the close keeps: the certificate, or the reasons it was refused with the outcome unchanged.

nodes.name: ruled
nodes.summary: Applies the state rule: a verified certificate lifts a qualified-draft outcome to verified only when nothing is degraded, nothing is disclosed as unchecked, and every check passed.

nodes.name: coding_learning.py
