nodes.summary: Opt-in learned probes from regressions a coding mission caught and repaired: proposes candidates, validates them on externally labelled held-out variants, requires a person's approval, and replays approved probes on later patches, which can only lower a result and ask a person.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 digest of a value's canonical sorted-key JSON form.

nodes.name: store
nodes.summary: Opens this owner's probe store under the workforce root, scoped to the owner.

nodes.name: files_id
nodes.summary: Computes a change's instance id from each file's syntax tree, so a comment or layout edit of a training change counts as the same instance.

nodes.name: probe_of
nodes.summary: Returns the key and probe a stored theory holds, or None when it is not a well-formed coding probe.

nodes.name: propose
nodes.summary: Adds a candidate probe to the store from one executed counterexample, keyed to a repository function and tagged with its training instances.

nodes.name: learn
nodes.summary: Returns the candidate probes a closed, repaired coding mission yields from each executed differential-check counterexample; called explicitly, never from a background thread.

nodes.name: LabelledVariant
nodes.summary: A change to validate a probe on, holding the full new file texts, a regression label that came from a run the probe did not produce, and where that label came from.

nodes.name: _label_problem
nodes.summary: Explains why a variant's label cannot count for a probe, for example when it came from the probe's own replay.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Decides whether a candidate probe may be recommended by replaying it on held-out, externally labelled variants and comparing decisions with and without it; self-labelled evidence is refused.

nodes.name: approve
nodes.summary: Activates a probe only after a person reads what it checks and its evidence and names who decides; a probe that is not recommended is refused before anyone is asked.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Returns only active, person-approved probes for exactly the given repository function.

nodes.name: demote
nodes.summary: Lowers a verified mission state to qualified-draft when a learned probe disagrees or could not run; never raises the state.

nodes.name: _replay
nodes.summary: Replays one probe on a candidate change in a scratch copy of the frozen repository, only when execution was allowed and the baseline digest still matches.

nodes.name: replayer
nodes.summary: Returns a replay function bound to a coding mission's frozen repository copy.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Replays approved probes on a closed coding mission's last patch, records warnings and asks a person on disagreement, and returns an envelope whose completion state never exceeds qualified-draft.

nodes.name: _ask
nodes.summary: Records a learned-probe warning on the mission and asks a person a gate question bound to the exact probe and patch.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Records a person's answer to a learned probe's question (approve retires the probe, reject keeps it) under the identity the approver returns.

nodes.name: retire
nodes.summary: Retires the probe a recorded approval names, only when that approval answers this mission's question and is bound to the exact probe.

nodes.name: contracts.py
nodes.summary: Defines the workforce completion contract: the Outcome one layer hands the next (state, degradation, reasons, evidence) that only gets worse on the way up, the Verdict that is the only path to verified, and the down-only readers of a component reply's declared states.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation keep outcomes immutable, so demotion always produces a new value.

nodes.name: authority_rank
nodes.summary: Returns an authority class's place on the ladder, placing anything unmeasured or unknown with A0 so it fails closed.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Returns a reliability state's rank, where a lower rank is a worse state.

nodes.name: normalize_state
nodes.summary: Maps either state vocabulary to the canonical hyphenated reliability state and refuses anything else.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Immutable completion outcome with state, degraded flag, reasons and evidence ids; supports down-only demotion, storage round-trips, and reading a component reply's envelope without ever being better than what it declares.

nodes.name: combine
nodes.summary: Combines outcomes keeping the worst state, any degradation and every reason and evidence id, with order kept and duplicates dropped.

nodes.name: suite_limits
nodes.summary: Lists known limits on the bench's test comparison from explicit limitations, shared by new calls and historical receipt reads.

nodes.name: limited_outcome
nodes.summary: Applies evidence limits to an outcome down-only, so a failed check never becomes a qualified pass.

nodes.name: suite_receipt_limits
nodes.summary: Builds limits keyed by run, check, judged unit and artifact from owner-scoped closed-run details, leaving raw observations untouched.

nodes.name: current_suite_limits
nodes.summary: Returns limits only from receipts on each unit's latest closed output, which alone can qualify the mission's current result.

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.summary: One verifier's finding on one artifact (kind, result, executed, independence, model calls, reason, evidence) and the only way an outcome becomes verified.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Returns the component's own innermost result mapping beneath the envelope, or an empty mapping.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.summary: Looks up a dotted path through nested mappings and lists, returning whether it was found and the value.

nodes.name: verdict_from_reply
nodes.summary: Turns an oracle's reply into a Verdict: executed only when the component answered, pass only when its answer holds the expected value at the field path.

nodes.name: answered_field
nodes.summary: Checks whether the component's own nested answer carries a field, never searching the outer envelope's keys.

nodes.name: _declared
nodes.summary: Reads a declared completion state in either vocabulary down-only: any blocked or failure value is a block, any verified form is verified.

nodes.name: _blocks
nodes.summary: Explains why one level of a reply, or a state holder beside it, says the call did not succeed, or returns empty.

nodes.name: _levels
nodes.summary: Collects the reply and each nested result mapping, parsing JSON strings, up to a maximum depth, noting when deeper results were not read.

nodes.name: _unanswered
nodes.summary: Decides whether a component answered at all: a component error, an unknown solver or validity, an ambiguous status or a declared block counts as unanswered.

nodes.name: _usage_state
nodes.summary: Normalizes one declared state string into verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated, error or none.

nodes.name: _usage_declared
nodes.summary: Collects every state one level of a result declares, including pending for a job not finished.

nodes.name: _usage_levels
nodes.summary: Returns the result's top level and invoke_component's nested result, or None when the result is not a dict.

nodes.name: outcome_of
nodes.summary: Reads how a reply ended by the down-only rule: across every declared state the most degraded wins (block, unfinished, error, qualified-draft, verified); never raises.

nodes.name: decide.py
nodes.summary: Command-line tool (python -m g6.workforce.decide) where the owner lists pending questions, answers gates and adjudications, confirms what counts as done, and allows G6 to run a repository's code, taking an answer only when its key is typed back at an interactive terminal.

nodes.name: command_line
nodes.summary: Builds the argparse parser for the decide command (list, the decision verbs, correct, confirm, allow) and its options.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the decide command: binds the workforce, lists pending questions or, at an interactive terminal with the key typed back, records a confirmation, correction or decision with timing and principal, then advances a frozen coding mission.

nodes.name: _allow
nodes.summary: Handles "allow <repository>": shows what running the repository's code at its present revision means, requires its name typed back, and records the permission a coding mission needs.

nodes.name: decisions.py
nodes.summary: Stores human decisions for missions: gate approvals and verifier adjudications asked by the runtime and answered only by the human actor, each written append-only with its event and Ledger intervention row in one transaction, plus measures of human decision time.

nodes.name: kept_question
nodes.summary: Returns a question's text whole when it fits, else cut with a note saying so, within the question length limit.

nodes.name: principal
nodes.summary: Describes who decided as recorded beside a decision: the identity the channel gave and what it does not establish, since G6 authenticates no one.

nodes.name: declared_minutes
nodes.summary: Validates the minutes a person says an answer took: None when absent, else a number within the allowed range, refused otherwise.

nodes.name: said_minutes
nodes.summary: Collects the minutes people declared on a set of decision events, one per answer that gave a figure.

nodes.name: wait_seconds
nodes.summary: Computes, for each answered question, the seconds between its request and decision events, measuring how long it waited rather than how long anyone worked.

nodes.name: human_time
nodes.summary: Summarizes one mission's human decisions as three separate measures: the count of answers, the minutes people declared, and the recorded waiting time.

nodes.name: Decisions
nodes.summary: One owner's question-and-answer store beside the missions: asks idempotent gate or adjudication questions, re-asks gates, resolves the effective answer and its binding, records human-only answers with their events and interventions in one transaction, and records confirmations of what counts as done.

nodes.name: economics.py
nodes.summary: Pure types and integer arithmetic for workforce money, cost entries, budgets and human attention: amounts are whole minor units of one currency, unknown amounts stay None rather than 0, and budgets are read fail-closed.
nodes.languageNotes: Avoids floats entirely: money is held as integer minor units and divisions use exact integer arithmetic.

nodes.name: format_money
nodes.summary: Formats whole minor units and a currency as text such as "0.30 AUD" using integer arithmetic only.

nodes.name: size_of
nodes.summary: Returns the byte size of content as it is stored: sorted JSON encoded as UTF-8.

nodes.name: attention_cost
nodes.summary: Converts seconds of human attention to money at an hourly rate, in whole minor units rounded half up with integer arithmetic.

nodes.name: total
nodes.summary: Totals cost entries in one currency, optionally only those the mission budget binds, keeping unknown and other-currency entries apart.

nodes.name: call_cost
nodes.summary: Computes what one sent call cost from its contract's declaration: a declared zero is exact, a ceiling is charged as an estimate, no declaration is unknown.

nodes.name: owner_session_cost
nodes.summary: Cost entry for a unit written by the owner's own chat session: at least one model call at a cost G6 is not told.

nodes.name: abandoned_cost
nodes.summary: Cost entry for an attempt that stopped before it finished, whose spend is unknown.

nodes.name: hard_limit
nodes.summary: Reads a mission's hard machine-cost limit fail-closed: anything but a whole non-negative number becomes 0.

nodes.name: soft_limit
nodes.summary: Computes the soft stop limit as a fixed fraction of the hard limit, rounded down with exact integer arithmetic.

nodes.name: budget_policy
nodes.summary: Builds a mission's BudgetPolicy with its ceiling read fail-closed.

nodes.name: context_record
nodes.summary: Builds per-attempt context telemetry with token and cache figures left unknown rather than zero.

nodes.name: attention_total
nodes.summary: Totals recorded human interventions, putting a money value on them only with a configured hourly rate and only when every one was timed.

nodes.name: parse_hourly_rate
nodes.summary: Parses a rate such as "6000 AUD" into Money, otherwise returns no rate at all.

nodes.name: Money
nodes.summary: An amount in whole minor units of one ISO-4217 currency, validated on creation, with dict round-trips.

nodes.name: CostEntry
nodes.summary: One measurable variable cost (category, source, amount, currency, estimate flag, method, provider, quantity) with stored-detail round-trips and a check of whether the mission budget binds it.

nodes.name: CostTotal
nodes.summary: What a set of entries cost in one currency: the known part and the unknown, estimated and other-currency entries that keep the total from being known.

nodes.name: BudgetPolicy
nodes.summary: A mission's derived budget policy (hard and soft machine-cost limits, attention, attempt, worker and concurrency caps) that reports soft-budget or exhausted pressure.

nodes.name: HumanIntervention
nodes.summary: One time a person spent attention on a mission, with kind, actor, reason and outcome, and a duration that is either measured exactly or unknown, never inferred.

nodes.name: AttentionTotal
nodes.summary: The sum of a mission's interventions by kind, with known seconds, the unmeasured count and an optional cost; its seconds are None if any intervention was untimed.

nodes.name: graph.py
nodes.summary: Materializes a mission's reserved plan revision as task tracker units in units.db, installing a unique index and a finality trigger, and enforces the plan's dependencies on every claim.

nodes.name: default_units_path
nodes.summary: Returns the default units.db path in a workforce folder beside the default database.

nodes.name: WorkGraph
nodes.summary: One owner's units for the missions they can see: materializes and extends plan revisions into tracker rows and edges, lists claimable units by priority once their dependencies complete, and moves units through claim, complete, escalate, fail and supervisor reopen, refusing moves from stale attempts.

nodes.name: missions.py
nodes.summary: The persistent mission store in the venture database: owner-scoped missions with objective, intent contract, state-machine status, risk level, budget and outcome, plus acceptance contracts, plan revisions, materialization and runner leases, and append-only mission events.

nodes.name: stamp
nodes.summary: Formats a lease time as one UTC text form so stored times compare in time order.

nodes.name: LeaseLost
nodes.summary: Raised when a runner's lease is no longer the mission's (taken over, released or the mission finished), so its write is refused and nothing changes.

nodes.name: check_actor
nodes.summary: Validates an actor string: code, chat, human or worker:<id>.

nodes.name: LeaseHeld
nodes.summary: Raised when another runner holds the mission's lease, until it expires or is released.

nodes.name: Lease
nodes.summary: A runner's hold on one running mission, with holder, fence token and expiry time.

nodes.name: MissionStore
nodes.summary: Owner-scoped mission store: creates and lists missions, accepts and strengthens acceptance contracts, validates and stores plan revisions, manages materialization and runner leases with fencing, moves the state machine, and appends and reads mission events and messages.

nodes.name: mutation_check.py
nodes.summary: Seeds small deliberate changes into the customer's code (comparison, arithmetic and return-value mutations) and runs the customer's own tests against each, recording which changed versions the tests caught and which survived as result card limitations.

nodes.name: Mutant
nodes.summary: One single-change version of the code: its line, the snippets before and after, and the changed source.

nodes.name: _transform
nodes.summary: Returns the one mutation a syntax node admits, applied to a copy, or None; optionally turns a single-argument call into its argument.

nodes.name: _on
nodes.summary: Checks whether a node lies on the given lines, counting an operator by any line between its operands.

nodes.name: mutants
nodes.summary: Generates up to a limit of distinct single-change versions of the code, spread evenly in source order and optionally restricted to changed lines.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Runs the customer's tests against changed versions of their code within a wall-time budget and returns the record of caught and surviving changes.

nodes.name: limitations
nodes.summary: Turns the changes the customer's tests did not catch into result card limitation lines.

nodes.name: objective.py
nodes.summary: Compiles supported objectives into workforce missions (only code_change, when a repository is named) and runs the seven-question mission preflight: probing route readiness, ranking routes per stage with the scheduler, and recording replan decisions and the frozen invariants.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Classifies an objective as code_change when a repository is named, otherwise as no supported class.

nodes.name: compile
nodes.summary: Starts a coding mission when a repository is named, otherwise creates a mission the caller plans itself.

nodes.name: in_place_eligible
nodes.summary: Checks whether in-place test runs are safe: the repository is clean, at the frozen revision, and its test files match the frozen digests.

nodes.name: route_options
nodes.summary: Builds scheduler execution options for each route of a stage, with declared cost, measured chance of executing from earlier probes, operational claims, and exclusion reasons for routes below the authority floor, unready, unsafe in place, or writing beyond scratch.

nodes.name: _replanned
nodes.summary: Detects a cross-run replan: when the earlier mission of the same task chose another route and a declared cost changed under an unchanged standard, records a reconfiguration decision and returns replan metadata.

nodes.name: _unobserved
nodes.summary: Returns a route's derived operational fields with no observed history, every amount unknown rather than zero.

nodes.name: preflight
nodes.summary: Runs and records the mission preflight once: notes that no learned guards apply, probes route readiness, chooses a route per stage with the scheduler, and answers the seven preflight questions with sources, cost and invariants.

nodes.name: workforce.run_tests.json
nodes.summary: Parameter contract for the workforce run_tests bench op: required repo and tests, optional files and regression scope, a probe test, read-only side effect, model-free, and operational claims (mitigates unreproduced failures, introduces the in-process runner risk, writes only scratch).

nodes.name: workforce.run_tests_in_place.json
nodes.summary: Parameter contract for the workforce run_tests_in_place bench op that tests a repository where it is: required repo and tests, optional roots and timeout, read-only and model-free, with operational claims including the live working tree risk.

nodes.name: patch_checks.py
nodes.summary: Bounded differential check run by the bench: compares a patch's changed functions before and after on inputs taken from changed comparisons or replays, reporting counterexamples, disclosures for declared functions, and naming everything left unchecked.

nodes.name: _names
nodes.summary: Lists the names a module-level statement that is not a function defines or imports, or its kind of code when it has none.

nodes.name: _unchecked_in
nodes.summary: When a module's imports, constants or classes changed, returns each differing statement and each unchanged function reading those names, since nothing compares them.

nodes.name: _name_unchecked
nodes.summary: Names whatever an unmeasured comparison left unchecked in the probe and in its reason.

nodes.name: could_not_compare
nodes.summary: Tells whether a probe that did not run stopped for want of a comparison it could derive, as opposed to one it began and could not finish.

nodes.name: _in_scope
nodes.summary: Runs the in-scope function before and after the change on inputs from the change's own comparisons, disclosing any behaviour difference to the person rather than passing or failing.

nodes.name: _inputs
nodes.summary: Synthesizes numeric inputs (each literal and its neighbours) from comparisons that differ between the old and new single-argument function, or none when they cannot be derived.

nodes.name: _observe
nodes.summary: Writes a temporary pytest probe that calls a function on given inputs, runs it isolated, and returns the JSON values with an execution receipt.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bench entry for the regression check: finds changed functions per file, compares baseline and candidate outputs in scratch copies, separates counterexamples from disclosures, discards results if the repository changed, and returns pass, fail, not_applicable or not_run.

nodes.name: plans.py
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a mission's plan as data: do, verify and gate units with edges, refusing unknown fields and reporting every problem at once; enforces risk floors, delegation limits, parameter contracts, the authority ladder and gate rules, and routes consumers through verify units.

nodes.name: higher
nodes.summary: Returns the highest of the given risk levels, treating any unrecognised value as R3 so a garbled level can only ask more.

nodes.name: effect_of
nodes.summary: Returns the worst declared side effect of a set of component operations, counting an op without a contract as external.

nodes.name: unit_floors
nodes.summary: Sets each drafted unit's risk from the standard without ever lowering it: inherited for delegated children, at least the floor, and at least what its ops' side effects demand.

nodes.name: highest_risk
nodes.summary: Returns the highest risk level any unit of a drafted plan names.

nodes.name: PlanRejected
nodes.summary: Exception for a plan code will not store, carrying every problem found with its unit and rule.

nodes.name: UnitSpec
nodes.summary: Specification of one plan unit: key, kind, goal, inputs, output schema, capabilities, verifies, checks, risk, budget, attempt limit and priority.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: A validated plan of units and edges with its digest; computes dependencies with consumers moved onto verify units, a topological order, transitive upstream units and canonical JSON.

nodes.name: _unit
nodes.summary: Validates one raw unit object field by field, appending each problem with its unit and rule, and returns a UnitSpec or None.

nodes.name: _start_time
nodes.summary: Normalizes a unit's not_before time to one UTC text form, refusing times without a zone.

nodes.name: smt_sort
nodes.summary: Normalizes a declared variable type the way the solver reads it.

nodes.name: _facts
nodes.summary: Validates a formal oracle's facts, mapping solver variables to unit field paths read as equality assertions.

nodes.name: _step
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a unit's call (do units) or oracle (verify units), returning None when absent or broken.

nodes.name: _delegation
nodes.summary: Checks that every delegated child unit stays within its parent's capabilities, verifiers and limits.

nodes.name: _edges
nodes.summary: Validates plan edges as [from, to] pairs of known, distinct unit keys and returns them sorted and deduplicated.

nodes.name: _contract_problems
nodes.summary: Finds parameter contract violations in a unit's call or oracle: wrong static types, undeclared keys, or required keys neither set nor bound.

nodes.name: _authority_problems
nodes.summary: Applies the authority ladder: refuses any A0 op and any op that can act below A2, while capping rather than refusing low-authority verifier oracles.

nodes.name: _gate_problems
nodes.summary: Refuses units naming external or irreversible ops with no human gate upstream of them by input or edge.

nodes.name: parse_plan
nodes.summary: Validates a drafted plan against the mission's risk level, budget, capability readiness, side effects, contract and authority, returning a Plan or raising PlanRejected with every problem.

nodes.name: readiness.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic pre-task readiness with no model calls or execution: decides whether to ask a question before a coding objective, and projects mission events into an observational cognitive state of hypotheses, assumptions and unknowns.

nodes.name: Readiness
nodes.summary: Result of the readiness assessment: decision, understanding, skills consulted, question, items not asked, version and interpretation.

nodes.name: Hypothesis
nodes.summary: A check's observation about one target artifact, with supporting and refuting evidence that never cancel each other.

nodes.name: CognitiveState
nodes.summary: Observational view of a mission's recorded task understanding: goal, accepted standard digest, interpretation, assumptions, hypotheses, unknowns, unavailable checks and next question.

nodes.name: state
nodes.summary: Projects a mission's ordered events into a CognitiveState, invalidating observations on standard changes and limiting patch receipts to the latest artifact.

nodes.name: assess
nodes.summary: Assesses an objective and repository against failure-mode skills, asking a question only when the answer changes an obligation, otherwise taking the fast path.

nodes.name: reconfigure.py
nodes.summary: Changes course inside the frozen standard: reroutes a stage whose tool failed its re-probe or switches the repair strategy, recording each as a reconfiguration event and refusing any change that would alter the outer contract's digested invariants.

nodes.name: ReconfigurationDecision
nodes.summary: Record of one change of course: what was observed, why the strategy became inadequate, what changed, and the invariants before and after.

nodes.name: invariants
nodes.summary: Digests the outer contract: the acceptance contract, tests, permissions, baseline, proposal limit and the route's authority floor.

nodes.name: in_force
nodes.summary: Computes the invariants as they stand now, re-reading the contract and the proposal limit in force.

nodes.name: frozen
nodes.summary: Returns the invariants recorded when the mission's standard froze, computing them for a mission that has none.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Writes one reconfiguration decision as an idempotent mission event.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Records a change of course idempotently, refusing and recording as refused any change whose invariant digests differ.

nodes.name: decided
nodes.summary: Returns every reconfiguration decision recorded for a mission, refused ones included.

nodes.name: changes
nodes.summary: Returns only the reconfiguration decisions that changed course, never a refused one.

nodes.name: unavailable
nodes.summary: Lists the routes this mission found unavailable after a failed re-probe.

nodes.name: strategy
nodes.summary: Returns the repair strategy in force: the last change's, else the ladder's first.

nodes.name: no_check
nodes.summary: Records a no-eligible-alternative decision for check stages whose only route is unavailable and returns the words for the person.

nodes.name: reroute
nodes.summary: Re-probes a route that did not run; if it still fails, selects another ready route meeting the authority floor and records the decision, or returns why a person is needed.

nodes.name: on_settle
nodes.summary: Runtime hook when a coding unit settles: decides whether a repeated proposal, or a check whose tool failed its re-probe, should fail or escalate instead of the usual move.

nodes.name: _never_started
nodes.summary: Detects a regression search that answered "not run" because its runner never started.

nodes.name: repo_tests.py
nodes.summary: Reads a caller's repository change from git and runs its pytest tests in place or in a bounded copy, with a scrubbed environment, timeouts, JUnit-based counts, failure blame, and detection of tracked files changed during the run; also replays old tests against current code.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps git and pytest as subprocesses with read-only git options, a scrubbed child environment and JUnit XML parsing, and uses context managers for bounded scratch copies.

nodes.name: RepoRefused
nodes.summary: Exception for a repository or request that cannot be run, carrying a stable G6_E_* code.

nodes.name: _git
nodes.summary: Runs one read-only git command in the repository with fixed options, a cleaned environment and a timeout.

nodes.name: shape_problem
nodes.summary: Explains why a value cannot name a path inside a repository, without touching the disk: control characters, option shapes, argument files, pathspecs, absolute or upward paths.

nodes.name: checked_repo
nodes.summary: Validates a path as a full path to a git work tree folder and returns its top folder, or refuses.

nodes.name: inside
nodes.summary: Resolves a path or file::test id to something inside the repository, checking its shape first and then where it resolves.

nodes.name: is_test_file
nodes.summary: Tells whether a relative path is a default pytest test file (test_*.py).

nodes.name: Change
nodes.summary: The change in a repository against a base: commits, changed files, test texts before and after, sources, runner files and renamed tests.

nodes.name: change
nodes.summary: Reads the change in a repository against a base ref from git, including untracked files and each changed test file's text before and after.

nodes.name: _moves
nodes.summary: Finds test files moved since the base, both as git pairs them and as moves on disk of unchanged text.

nodes.name: changed_lines
nodes.summary: Returns the lines of a source file the change added or rewrote, or every line of a file new since the base.

nodes.name: derive_tests
nodes.summary: Selects the tests a change touches: its changed test files, then test files naming a changed module, up to a limit.

nodes.name: diff_text
nodes.summary: Produces the change as one unified diff, including untracked files as added lines up to a size cap.

nodes.name: _digest
nodes.summary: Digests a file's bytes in blocks, or a nested repository's snapshot; an unreadable file reads the same before and after.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures what a test run may not change: HEAD, the index, git's skip marks, and digests of differing, marked and untracked files.

nodes.name: child_env
nodes.summary: Builds the tests' whole environment from a few system variables, scratch home and temp folders, the paid-model block, and dead proxies when network is refused.

nodes.name: interpreter
nodes.summary: Chooses the Python that runs the tests: the repository's own .venv or venv, else the one running G6.

nodes.name: _module_here
nodes.summary: Tells whether a module's top package belongs to the repository on the run's import path.

nodes.name: _blame
nodes.summary: Classifies one failure in the report as coming from outside the repository (such as a missing dependency) or from inside it.

nodes.name: _counts
nodes.summary: Reads pytest's own tallies from its JUnit report, one outcome per test, or None when no readable report was written.

nodes.name: _judge
nodes.summary: Gives one verdict for a run: files changed under it decide first, then the time bound, the exit code and tallies that must agree with each other.

nodes.name: _bounded
nodes.summary: Runs the test command with merged output streamed to a log under a timeout, returning None on a local timeout and propagating operator stops.

nodes.name: _output
nodes.summary: Returns what a run printed: all of it when short, else its head and tail with the size of the cut.

nodes.name: _configures_pytest
nodes.summary: Tells whether a folder holds a pytest configuration file with a pytest section.

nodes.name: _config_args
nodes.summary: Keeps pytest's configuration inside the repository by pinning the root and conftest limit to an empty config when no repository config is found.

nodes.name: _progress
nodes.summary: Merges the boot plugin's collected, started and finished counts into the tallies, taking interrupted tests off the passes.

nodes.name: _said
nodes.summary: Returns the sentence a person reads for a verdict that did not run normally (changed files, a timeout, pytest missing).

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs tests against the working tree in place and reports what pytest found, flagging any run under which tracked files, HEAD or the index changed.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Shared execution path: snapshots the repository, builds the pytest command, environment and config arguments, runs it bounded, and judges the counts and output.

nodes.name: CopyNotRun
nodes.summary: Raised when a repository copy exceeds its file, byte or time cap before anything is executed.

nodes.name: outside_temp
nodes.summary: Picks a temporary folder outside the repository, refusing when none exists.

nodes.name: repository_copy
nodes.summary: Context manager that copies git's tracked and non-ignored untracked files into a scratch folder under file, byte and time caps, with optional overlays of old test texts.

nodes.name: _copy_snapshot
nodes.summary: Digests every non-ignored file of a repository within the copy caps.

nodes.name: _base_revision
nodes.summary: Context manager that temporarily restores all base-revision differences in the bounded replay copy.

nodes.name: run_before
nodes.summary: Runs the old changed or deleted tests against a copy of the current code, one fresh copy per file, never overwriting the caller's tests.

nodes.name: probe_repo
nodes.summary: Creates a one-test git repository in scratch for the census probe, reading nothing of the owner's.

nodes.name: result_card.py
nodes.summary: Defines the shareable result card: grades a result envelope and prints a card of state, qualifications, evidence sources, independent evaluation and rejected alternatives only when every required field was recorded; also sanitizes task titles.

nodes.name: Graded
nodes.summary: Grading result for one envelope: state, whether it is printable, missing fields, the rendered card and the values read.

nodes.name: _evaluation
nodes.summary: Validates an independent evaluation record, requiring a named evaluator unless the evaluation was not run.

nodes.name: _limits
nodes.summary: Returns what is qualified: the envelope's known limitations, else the job's named failed checks, excluding the generic default.

nodes.name: card_or_gaps
nodes.summary: Grades one envelope against the card: returns the printable card only if every required field was recorded, otherwise names the fields that were not.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the card text from a reliability state and recorded values.

nodes.name: clean_task_title
nodes.summary: Makes a customer's title safe to print: removes control characters, collapses whitespace and caps its length.

nodes.name: stamp_task_title
nodes.summary: Puts the customer's title on a result both flat and nested, or makes sure none is present when there is no title.

nodes.name: result_view.py
nodes.summary: Defines the single result contract that renders every mission or task return as four token-budgeted markdown layers: the answer, the trust state with the checks performed, what remains uncertain or failed, and the evidence. It also converts job-pack, coder and coding-agent envelopes into a ResultView, reading the worst declared state down-only, and renders the G6 Trust Report.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses validate their allowed state, coverage and provenance vocabularies in __post_init__, so an invalid view cannot be constructed.

nodes.name: wire_tokens
nodes.summary: Conservatively estimates the tokens a chat agent receives for a value: one token per three characters of its JSON form, rounded up, with no tokenizer dependency.

nodes.name: estimate_tokens
nodes.summary: Estimates the token count of a text by passing its string form to wire_tokens.

nodes.name: _clip
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the longest start of a text that fits a token budget together with a trailing ellipsis.

nodes.name: fit
nodes.summary: Keeps lines within a token budget, cutting at whole lines (clipping one oversized line) and appending a note that says how many lines were cut and how to ask for the rest.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one check actually performed, in plain words, with passed set to true, false, or None when it ran and could not decide.

nodes.name: Problem
nodes.summary: Frozen record of what failed, why, how material it is, what would resolve it and a stable code, with a text() method that renders it in that order.

nodes.name: Interpretation
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one reading of a result that the checks could not settle.

nodes.name: Evidence
nodes.summary: Frozen evidence item whose provenance label and supplier are validated against fixed vocabularies when it is constructed.

nodes.name: Surface
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one failure surface G6 challenged or did not, with its status validated as passed, failed or not_tested.

nodes.name: ResultView
nodes.summary: Frozen view of everything one result says (answer, state, checks, coverage, caveats, problems, interpretations, evidence, attempts, cost, attention, tests, standard, surfaces); it validates state, coverage and agreement, and an empty field means not recorded.

nodes.name: comparison_of
nodes.summary: Maps a stored reviewer agreement value to its displayed wording, or 'not recorded' when none was stored.

nodes.name: render_layers
nodes.summary: Renders a ResultView into the four default markdown layers (answer, trust, caveats, evidence): content is escaped, jargon lines move to a counted technical-details note, an unverifiable result always says what failed, and each layer is fitted to its token budget.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Produces the default result payload: state, label and glyph, confidence words, the joined markdown layers and a hint for how to ask for more.

nodes.name: render_trust_report
nodes.summary: Renders the plain-text G6 Trust Report from a view (task, standard, verdict, tests, failure challenges, what was not tested, attempts, cost, human intervention, evidence count), each value recorded or 'not recorded' and the whole clipped to the trust budget.

nodes.name: _state
nodes.summary: Reads the worst completion state an envelope or its trust holders declare, down-only, and falls back to blocked-escalated when none, an unknown one, or a failed call is present.

nodes.name: _answer_of
nodes.summary: Extracts the answer text from an envelope's answer or summary fields, a deliverable summary, a result string, or a description of the check's verdict.

nodes.name: _evidence_of
nodes.summary: Builds Evidence items from an envelope's evidence list (tool executions as Calculation, other items as Source) or from a recorded source count.

nodes.name: from_envelope
nodes.summary: Converts a job-pack, coder or coding-agent envelope (including a stored job's nested response) into a ResultView that is never better than the worst declared state, hides a withheld answer, and collects checks, caveats, problems with stable codes, evidence and coverage.

nodes.name: attach_result_view
nodes.summary: Adds the rendered result contract to an envelope dict as result_view without touching any other field, falling back to a could-not-verify rendering if the view cannot be built; it never raises.

nodes.name: unbuilt
nodes.summary: Renders a blocked-escalated result explaining that the summary could not be built; every surface falls back to it so a return is never lost to its own summary.

nodes.name: reuse.py
nodes.summary: Decides whether a verified result saved by an earlier mission of the same owner may be reused instead of being made again, refusing with a plain-language ReuseRefused clause unless the result is current, verified by a verifier-grade check, made under unchanged contracts and inputs, within its validity period, and resting on premises that pass the same rules. It also walks recorded provenance to list every op in an output's ancestry.

nodes.name: ReuseRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass whose message completes 'cannot be reused: ...' in plain words for the person.

nodes.name: Reused
nodes.summary: Frozen record of an approved reuse (artifact, source mission, verdict ids, valid-until time) with a provenance() method giving what a reading unit records about it.

nodes.name: _read_by_checks
nodes.summary: Lists the plan inputs that the verifying checks read besides the output they judged, so those premises are checked too; refuses when the plan or unit no longer matches.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Returns a Reused record when a saved result may be reused now, otherwise raises ReuseRefused with the first failed rule: ownership, latest output, an equal or higher risk level, a verifier-grade passing verdict, recorded provenance, unchanged contracts and inputs, recursively verified premises, and the validity period.

nodes.name: lineage
nodes.summary: Walks recorded provenance up to the depth bound and returns every component op that made an output or anything it was built from, collecting content digests and failing closed on unreadable, missing, changed or looping ancestry.

nodes.name: rungs.py
nodes.summary: Carries out one attempt at a work unit. The deterministic rung calls a do unit's capability through its worker's door with parameters bound from upstream outputs; the verify rung runs a separate read-only oracle against the produced output and turns its reply into a VerdictRecord with an earned authority class, capped when the check is not independent of what it judges or its answer was disclosed to the producer.

nodes.name: RungResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one rung attempt: outcome, produced artifact, call records, model call count, failure code, verdict record, per-call costs and check mechanism records.

nodes.name: _bound
nodes.summary: Binds a step's parameters from upstream artifacts and appends each declared fact as an SMT equality assertion, returning a reason instead when a value cannot be read or is not a finite number.

nodes.name: shown_answer
nodes.summary: Serializes an oracle's answer as JSON for the worker, trimming a long list of broken suite tests so the text still parses within the length cap and noting how many were left out.

nodes.name: smt_number
nodes.summary: Converts a finite number into an SMT-LIB numeral (integer or decimal, negatives as a negation), refusing anything non-numeric, infinite, fractional where an integer is needed, or longer than 64 characters.

nodes.name: _fold
nodes.summary: Collects the comparable leaves of a nested value: numbers normalized as decimals and strings case- and whitespace-folded, leaving out booleans, empty values, 0 and 1.

nodes.name: _answers
nodes.summary: Finds what a recorded message carried of one check's own answer, from an 'oracle answered' reason or a focused brief's failing tests and counterexamples.

nodes.name: disclosed
nodes.summary: Determines from the mission's recorded messages and verdicts whether a send-back to a producer carried a check's own answer that either contains a value the check judges in the new output or held a counterexample, probe or expected output.

nodes.name: reads_its_artifact
nodes.summary: Checks that a verify unit's oracle binds at least one parameter or fact from the artifact of the unit it verifies.

nodes.name: run_do
nodes.summary: Runs a do unit on the deterministic rung: binds its call parameters, calls the capability through the door and returns the answer as an artifact demoted to at most a qualified draft.

nodes.name: independence
nodes.summary: Explains why an oracle cannot certify an output independently (it appears in the output's lineage, it made a result with identical bytes, or it is a receipts check), returning an empty string when it can.

nodes.name: oracle_authority
nodes.summary: Returns the authority class a check carries into its verdict, capping a verifier-grade op at A3 with the reason when it is not independent of the judged output.

nodes.name: run_verify
nodes.summary: Runs a verify unit on the verify rung: binds the oracle to the produced output, earns its authority class, runs premise-consistency and non-falsifiability calls for solver oracles before the main check, and builds the VerdictRecord, outcome demotions, plain failure reasons, mechanism record, test receipts and regression probe data.

nodes.name: runs.py
nodes.summary: The attempt ledger: SQLite tables and triggers for worker instances, runs, artifacts, verdicts and cost entries in the venture database, all owner-scoped through missions. RunLedger opens, closes and abandons attempts under the mission's runner lease, and the database itself refuses a verified verdict unless an executed, independent, read-only, model-free oracle passed on the unit's latest artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrity rules (run once, end once, never delete, verdict preconditions) are enforced by SQLite triggers, so no Python code path can write a disallowed row.

nodes.name: outcome_of
nodes.summary: Reads a stored run row's outcome, treating an open or empty one as blocked because nothing finished.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Frozen identifiers of one opened attempt: run id, worker instance id and attempt number.

nodes.name: VerdictRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen record of what a verify run found about one artifact, whose outcome() demotes a verified verdict to qualified-draft when the oracle is not model-free, lacks verifier-grade authority, or is not independent.

nodes.name: RunLedger
nodes.summary: One owner's attempt ledger over the mission store's connection: creates and migrates its tables, opens, closes and abandons runs under the runner lease, reserves and records call costs, and reads runs, attempts, instances, artifacts, verdicts, makers by digest and cost totals.

nodes.name: runtime.py
nodes.summary: The mission runtime: it steps one attempt at a time over a mission's work graph, forming each worker under the mission's ceiling, opening a run, executing the rung, closing the run with its artifact and verdict, and moving the unit. It also handles chat-written pull units, gates and person decisions, delegation, retries and escalations, crash reconciliation under a single runner lease, and a worst-wins roll-up of the mission's final state.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes across two SQLite files follow a fixed, resumable order (open run, claim, execute, close run with artifact and verdict, move unit), so reconcile can finish any step a crash interrupted.

nodes.name: ceiling_for
nodes.summary: Builds a mission's trusted RuntimePolicy ceiling (no shell, no direct file writes, no privilege, fixed step and call limits) with its budget read fail-closed and lowered to each delegating ancestor's budget in turn.

nodes.name: judged_latest
nodes.summary: Tells whether a given verifier passed exactly the given output, so a pass on an older output does not count.

nodes.name: own_budget
nodes.summary: Computes what a unit keeps for its own worker: its budget minus what it carved out for its delegated children.

nodes.name: _keepable
nodes.summary: Blocks an attempt whose output exceeds the ledger's per-step size limit, recording an output_too_large failure while keeping its calls and costs as they happened.

nodes.name: Runtime
nodes.summary: Mission runtime that holds the runner lease and steps a mission's work graph one attempt at a time: reconciles interrupted attempts, picks and claims units, forms workers, runs rungs, records verdicts and costs, takes pull submissions, delegation, gates and disagreements, decides retries, escalations and reuse, and closes the mission with a worst-wins roll-up.

nodes.name: scheduler.py
nodes.summary: Cost-aware scheduler that records one SchedulerDecision per plan step: it builds candidate ExecutionOptions and chooses a route that respects the assurance floor, the resource mode's escalation ceiling and required risk coverage, preferring objective checks and then the lowest expected cost per accepted outcome. It loads and validates the resource levels and modes from its bundled JSON file and decides escalations after a failed check; it is pure apart from that one file read.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fractions.Fraction for acceptance chances and expected cost per accepted outcome, so ranking never relies on floating-point precision.

nodes.name: ordered
nodes.summary: Returns reason codes once each in decision step order, rejecting any code that is not a known reason code.

nodes.name: Tier
nodes.summary: Frozen description of one resource level: name, strategy types, reliability class, whether it binds the budget, whether it is chosen automatically, and what it covers.

nodes.name: Mode
nodes.summary: Frozen resource mode expressed as real limits: the highest level reached without a person, a per-step attempt cap, added verification and the soft budget percentage.

nodes.name: Tiers
nodes.summary: Frozen container for the loaded resource levels, low-cost ceiling and modes, with a mode(name) lookup that rejects unknown modes.

nodes.name: load_tiers
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the resource-level JSON file: exact fields, the eight levels and four modes in order, strategy types, reliability classes, attempt caps and soft limits, reporting every problem at once in one ValueError.

nodes.name: default_tiers
nodes.summary: Returns the shipped resource-level configuration, loaded once per process through an LRU cache.

nodes.name: ExecutionOption
nodes.summary: Frozen candidate route for one step with its strategy, resource level, capabilities, cost or unknown, measured acceptance chance, risk coverage, permissions and verification plan; it validates its fields and computes the expected cost per accepted outcome.

nodes.name: NoRoute
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when no option is open, carrying each rejected option and the reason it was rejected.

nodes.name: Choice
nodes.summary: Frozen result of choose(): the selected option, rejected options with reasons, the rule that decided, and whether a costlier open option was passed over.

nodes.name: choose
nodes.summary: Selects a route: rejects options below the assurance floor, missing required risk coverage, above the mode's ceiling or measured never to succeed, prefers objective checks, then ranks by expected cost per accepted outcome when every option has one in a single currency, otherwise by level order.

nodes.name: SchedulerDecision
nodes.summary: Frozen decision record for one plan step: candidate options, selected option, ordered reason codes, budget before and after, risk level, acceptance contract reference, timestamp, policy version and metadata.

nodes.name: chat_option
nodes.summary: Builds the option where the owner's chat writes the step: the high-reasoning level, a draft until its check judges it, not bound by the mission budget.

nodes.name: person_option
nodes.summary: Builds the option where a person decides the step, at the human level with the gatekeeper worker.

nodes.name: planned_option
nodes.summary: Turns the route a plan names for a step into an ExecutionOption with its reason codes: gates and acting ops need a person, model-free calls are deterministic, model-free oracles are objective checks, and other ops get the low-cost or standard level by declared cost.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Produces one SchedulerDecision per plan step in plan order, recording the candidates weighed, why the planned route suffices, and reason codes for reused results, consequential risk, mode-added verification and deadline pressure.

nodes.name: mode_of
nodes.summary: Reads a mission's resource mode from its creation record, defaulting to balanced for a missing or unknown value.

nodes.name: settings
nodes.summary: Returns the Mode settings for a named resource mode from the shipped configuration.

nodes.name: with_mode
nodes.summary: Adds a mode's extra verification requirements to an acceptance contract without ever removing any, returning the same contract when nothing new is added.

nodes.name: budget_for
nodes.summary: Applies a resource mode to a budget policy: its soft cost limit, per-step attempt cap and the highest level allowed without a person's approval.

nodes.name: limited
nodes.summary: Returns the plan with each step's attempts capped by the mode and never above what the plan asked, leaving the stored plan and its digest unchanged.

nodes.name: escalation
nodes.summary: Records the decision after an executed check fails a code step: repeating the same call is rejected, the owner's chat rewriting it is preferred unless the step acts outside the machine or exceeds the mode's ceiling, and otherwise a person decides, with soft budget pressure respected.

nodes.name: retry_codes
nodes.summary: Returns the reason code for another attempt: a retry after a transient failure, a strategy failure after a check sent the result back, or none.

nodes.name: service.py
nodes.summary: The library facade for running missions: bind() wires a venture's MissionStore, WorkGraph, RunLedger, Capabilities and Runtime from environment settings into a Workforce, and plain functions let the owner's chat create, accept, plan, review, run, delegate, submit and read the status of missions. Every change is recorded with the chat as actor, and status returns lead with the rendered result while technical detail waits for the full view.

nodes.name: certificates_enabled
nodes.summary: Reports whether mission certificates decide coding missions' states; on unless the environment setting is a plain no.

nodes.name: readiness_enabled
nodes.summary: Reports whether the deterministic readiness checkpoint runs; on unless the environment setting is a plain no.

nodes.name: WorkforceUnbound
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when the process environment names no venture or no venture database exists.

nodes.name: Workforce
nodes.summary: Frozen binding of one venture's mission store, work graph, run ledger, capabilities and runtime, plus its database directory, optional hourly attention rate and the certificate and readiness switches.

nodes.name: bind
nodes.summary: Builds the Workforce for the venture named in the environment: opens the venture store, resolves the venture through its owner, and wires the mission store, work graph, run ledger, capabilities and runtime.

nodes.name: capabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the planning brief: every declared capability with its readiness, inputs, side effect, model-free flag and authority, plus the plan format text.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Runs one capability's contract probe through the door as the chat and returns its readiness.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a mission the caller plans itself with an objective, risk level, budget and materials, and returns its status.

nodes.name: accept
nodes.summary: Fixes the clarified contract, compiles what counts as done, moves the mission to awaiting its plan and records requirements G6 cannot check as unmet demand; a pending coding clarification is answered instead.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Validates and stores a drafted plan (recording unavailable capabilities as unmet demand when it is rejected), materializes the work graph, records the schedule review and returns status with the plain timeline.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Computes and records the scheduler decisions for the stored plan once per revision and returns the person-facing timeline with each step's reasons and strategy.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Steps the mission now through the runtime unless another runner holds its lease, then returns status.

nodes.name: delegate
nodes.summary: Hands part of an awaited unit to child units through the runtime as the chat, then returns status.

nodes.name: submit
nodes.summary: Records what the chat wrote for an awaited unit as a draft attempt, advancing a frozen coding standard when one applies.

nodes.name: attention
nodes.summary: Summarizes the owner's attention on a mission: interventions by kind, measured time, cost only with a configured rate, and person decision timings.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Assembles the full mission status: coding and clarification state, the rendered result first, outputs, units and delegation tree, runs, verdicts, awaited work, decisions, schedule, attention, acceptance, an optional stage map, the runner lease and armed wakes.

nodes.name: trim
nodes.summary: Reduces a full status to the default summary fields and names what the full detail adds.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Returns the trimmed default status of a mission.

nodes.name: unmet_demand
nodes.summary: Lists what the venture's missions asked that G6 cannot check or meet here, oldest first, for product-fit measurement; read-only.

nodes.name: _brief
nodes.summary: Builds what the chat needs to write a pull unit: goal, output shape, the outputs of its inputs, attempts left, verifier messages, coding standard details, any input reuse problem and the originally planned call.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: Owner-scoped SQLite store for ventures and their append-only evidence history, with triggers that forbid updating, deleting or replacing evidence rows and an idempotency key so a retried write lands once. OwnerScope resolves every venture id through its owner before any read or write and gives the same not-found answer for unknown and foreign ventures.

nodes.name: default_db_path
nodes.summary: Returns the default venture database path in the workforce folder of the G6 state directory.

nodes.name: VentureStore
nodes.summary: SQLite store for ventures and their evidence: creates tables and append-only triggers, adds the idempotency column when missing, offers a query-only reader, owner-keyed venture records and idempotent evidence appends.

nodes.name: OwnerScope
nodes.summary: One owner's handle on a VentureStore that resolves every venture id through its owner before reading or writing, raising a uniform not-found error for unknown or foreign ventures.

nodes.name: unscoped
nodes.summary: Returns the underlying store and the owner scope, or None, for accessors that accept either a store or a scope.

nodes.name: doer.json
nodes.summary: Worker template for do units: produces one unit's output by calling the capabilities the plan named, in code, on the deterministic rung, with no shell, file writes or privilege, at most 10 steps and tool calls, one retry and a 300-second runtime.

nodes.name: gatekeeper.json
nodes.summary: Worker template for gate units: records a person's approve or reject decision, with their reason, as the gate's single attempt on the human rung; read-only, calls no component and allows only the owner's decide action within one step and 60 seconds.

nodes.name: prober.json
nodes.summary: Worker template for capability probes: runs one capability's contract probe once on the deterministic rung to learn whether it can execute here, read-only, with one tool call, no retries, a zero cost allowance and a 60-second limit.

nodes.name: puller.json
nodes.summary: Worker template for pull units: hands a unit that has no code call to the owner's chat session and records what it submits as a draft until it is judged; it may delegate, calls no component and allows only the chat's submit action.

nodes.name: verifier.json
nodes.summary: Worker template for verify units: judges one do unit's output with an executed oracle, independently of its producer, on the verify rung; read-only, asks no model, with up to 5 steps and tool calls, no retries and a 120-second limit.

nodes.name: tiers.json
nodes.summary: Declares the scheduler's eight resource levels, from reusing a verified result and model-free deterministic ops up to multi-worker, specialist and person decisions, each with its strategy types, reliability class and budget binding, plus the low-cost ceiling and four resource modes (fast, balanced, thorough, critical) that cap escalation and attempts and add verification.

nodes.name: timeline.py
nodes.summary: Turns a stored plan and its scheduler decisions into the plain-language timeline a person approves before a mission runs: the stages, each step with how it will be done and how it will be checked, and the steps that wait for their approval. Pure, with no I/O and no model.

nodes.name: plan_timeline
nodes.summary: Builds the approval timeline: completed understanding stages, waiting doing and checking steps each described in plain words from their reason codes or strategy, the steps that need approval, and the next instruction.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Reconstructs one mission from its own stored rows into the eleven required trace fields (objective, plan, workers, capabilities, attempts, cost, evidence, verdict, failure, recovery, human intervention), marking a field absent with a reason rather than inventing a value. It also maps the same rows to a fifteen-stage loop with the ids of the rows that show each stage, and derives an environment signature including the G6 build read from git files; it writes nothing.

nodes.name: trace
nodes.summary: Reconstructs one of the owner's missions into its trace by gathering its rows and assembling the fields.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Lists the required trace fields a trace could not reconstruct, in their fixed order.

nodes.name: gather
nodes.summary: Collects the rows a mission trace is built from: the mission, its keyed events, plan revisions, runs, optional worker instances, verdicts, cost entries and learning episodes.

nodes.name: _candidates
nodes.summary: Reads the learning-candidate episode rows recorded for a mission, returning none when the store has no episodes table.

nodes.name: assemble
nodes.summary: Builds the trace from gathered rows: the eleven fields, task class, environment signature, learning decisions and selections, and the list of missing fields.

nodes.name: _plan
nodes.summary: Builds the plan trace field: revisions, units with kinds and capabilities, and the latest schedule decisions, or absent when no plan was stored.

nodes.name: _capabilities
nodes.summary: Builds the capabilities trace field from planned capabilities, worker allow-lists and the calls actually made with their contract digests.

nodes.name: _cost
nodes.summary: Builds the cost trace field: the economic total and every cost entry, or absent when no cost row was recorded.

nodes.name: _evidence
nodes.summary: Builds the evidence trace field from kept outputs with digests and sizes and the checks recorded when runs closed.

nodes.name: _verdict
nodes.summary: Builds the verdict trace field from every verdict row and, once the mission closed, its final state and reasons.

nodes.name: _failure
nodes.summary: Builds the failure trace field: failed attempts with their codes, classes and reasons, and the stop reasons of a blocked mission.

nodes.name: _recovery
nodes.summary: Builds the recovery trace field: retries, send-back messages, failures a person set aside and the recovery step each failure code calls for.

nodes.name: _human
nodes.summary: Builds the human-intervention trace field: interventions, questions asked of a person and the attention total.

nodes.name: stages
nodes.summary: Maps a mission's rows to each stage of the fifteen-stage loop as ran, not applicable or not run, with the ids of the rows that show it and a plain reason.

nodes.name: elicits
nodes.summary: Tells whether a unit is a check that searches for hidden failures: a verify unit whose oracle carries a regression parameter.

nodes.name: _Seen
nodes.summary: Read model over gathered rows for the stage rules: task class, plans, runs, verdicts, costs, closing events, latest outputs and the coding standard, with helpers for final outputs and the verdicts on them.

nodes.name: _retrieve
nodes.summary: Stage rule for retrieval: whether learned checks were looked up and whether each selected one actually ran, citing its receipts.

nodes.name: _execute
nodes.summary: Stage rule for execution: whether every do step produced an output, naming the steps that did not.

nodes.name: _verify_progress
nodes.summary: Stage rule for progress checks: for a code standard, a failure reproduced on the frozen baseline and a judged proposed change; otherwise checks on outputs before the final one.

nodes.name: _reconfigure
nodes.summary: Stage rule for reconfiguration: whether a failure or unrun check was followed by a recorded change of course, retry, escalation or stop, telling cost-driven re-routing apart.

nodes.name: _checks
nodes.summary: Stage rule shared by the hidden-failure search and final verification: whether every matching check executed on the latest output it verifies.

nodes.name: _adjudicate
nodes.summary: Stage rule for settlement: whether G6 itself settled the closed result, excluding cancels by the chat or a person, citing adjudication decisions.

nodes.name: _learn
nodes.summary: Stage rule for learning: whether a learning candidate was recorded for a newly caught failure, and whether a replayed learning round promoted a check.

nodes.name: _replayed
nodes.summary: Tells whether a learning decision's fit replay executed every receipt, reading both the current and the older record shapes and failing closed.

nodes.name: _environment
nodes.summary: Builds the environment signature: recorded G6 build, contract digests of calls made, scheduler policy version, and cost providers and resources, each absent with a reason when unrecorded.

nodes.name: g6_build
nodes.summary: Returns the G6 build this process runs, as a git commit or a version string, read once and cached.

nodes.name: _commit
nodes.summary: Reads the checked-out commit from the nearest git work tree's files, following a worktree's gitdir and common dir, without running git.

nodes.name: _resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a git ref to its commit from loose or packed refs in the first base directory that holds it.

nodes.name: tracker.py
nodes.summary: Vendored SQLite unit store that the work graph keeps a plan's units in: tasks, dependency edges with cycle detection, an event log and a caller-keyed refusal log, with fixed status transitions and owner checks on reads and mutations.

nodes.name: TaskTrackerStore
nodes.summary: SQLite store for a plan's units with validated status transitions, dependency edges with cycle checks, event logging, owner-checked reads and mutations, and refusal logging keyed by the denied caller so no refusal writes into another owner's rows.

nodes.name: truth.py
nodes.summary: Decides what a seed venture may truthfully claim: a claim is true only when the test it is bound to exists and passes in a sealed, isolated pytest subprocess, and text is scanned for bound claims and unbound assertive shapes such as certifications, usage counts, percentages and guarantees. It provides the isolated single-test and whole-suite runners, with a network guard and a positive control, that the workforce test bench relies on.
nodes.languageNotes: Boots pytest from an inline script run with python -I and appends a deliberately failing control item, so a run whose record does not show the control failing cannot report a clean pass.

nodes.name: _LastRun
nodes.summary: Thread-local mutable mapping holding the last sealed test run's diagnostics, so concurrent runs on different threads each read only their own.

nodes.name: Extraction
nodes.summary: Frozen pair of the bound claim ids and the unbound assertive phrases found in a text.

nodes.name: tally
nodes.summary: Parses pytest's closing tally line into outcome counts, an empty result when no tests ran, or None when no tally was reported.

nodes.name: recorded
nodes.summary: Turns an isolated run's own per-test record into tally counts, returning None when there is no record or the positive control was not recorded failing.

nodes.name: run_isolated
nodes.summary: Runs one test node in a sealed python -I subprocess with real pytest imported first, an empty outside config, no plugin autoload, a minimal environment with paid model providers blocked and a network guard, passing only when the runner's own record shows a pass with the control failing.

nodes.name: run_suite
nodes.summary: Runs a repository's whole tests directory once under the same isolated rules and returns each test's pytest outcome, collection errors, timing, and why it did not run when it did not.

nodes.name: Truth
nodes.summary: Frozen seed claim table that loads from a seed's truth.json, checks a claim by running its bound test in isolation, and extracts bound and unbound claims from text while ignoring negated phrasing.

nodes.name: is_false_claim
nodes.summary: Lists the false claims in a text: bound claims whose tests fail plus every unbound assertive phrase.

nodes.name: verify.py
nodes.summary: Independent verification sensors for coding-agent work: it derives its own pytest run set from git changes, detects weakened tests by AST (removed or guarded asserts, early returns, new skips or mocks, changed pytest config), checks protected-file scope, workspace path containment and that cited files and tests exist, and validates the result.json contract and queued outward actions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the ast module to compare test functions before and after a change, so weakening is judged structurally rather than by a text diff.

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.summary: Frozen verification verdict with an ok flag, a kind code, a reason and detail.

nodes.name: changed_files
nodes.summary: Lists files changed since HEAD plus untracked files via git, falling back to every Python file when the directory is not a usable git repository.

nodes.name: head_snapshot
nodes.summary: Exports the tracked files at HEAD into a fresh temporary directory as the pristine copy a working copy is judged against, or returns None outside git.

nodes.name: run_set
nodes.summary: Derives the verifier's own test run set: changed test files plus test files that name a changed module's stem, ignoring __init__, conftest and setup modules.

nodes.name: _test_functions
nodes.summary: Collects module-level test functions and Test-class methods from a parsed module, keyed by qualified name.

nodes.name: _asserts
nodes.summary: Lists the asserts a test really makes, discounting any guarded by a catch-all exception handler, including in nested try blocks.

nodes.name: _markers
nodes.summary: Counts skip, xfail, importorskip, pytestmark and mock usages anywhere in a module or a test.

nodes.name: _returns
nodes.summary: Counts return statements in a test's own body, ignoring returns inside nested functions, classes and lambdas.

nodes.name: test_integrity
nodes.summary: Fails when tests were weakened between the original and the working copy: removed or changed asserts, removed tests or files, early returns, new skips or mocks, or added or changed pytest configuration anywhere.

nodes.name: _config_findings
nodes.summary: Adds nested conftest and pytest configuration findings from the safety engine's weakening detector, skipping paths already judged and reporting unreadable trees as findings.

nodes.name: weakened_tests
nodes.summary: Applies the test-integrity rules to before and after test sources, reporting deleted files, unparsable sources, removed tests, removed or changed asserts, added early returns and new markers in existing tests.

nodes.name: scope_check
nodes.summary: Fails when a protected file named by the seed differs from the pristine copy.

nodes.name: cited
nodes.summary: Collects the cites a result makes: top-level cites as written and outward actions' cites shaped like repository files or test ids, flagging malformed fields.

nodes.name: contained
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative path inside the working directory through links and junctions, returning an error text for escapes, the directory itself or protected paths.

nodes.name: _has_test
nodes.summary: Checks by AST that a file defines the named test function or class method.

nodes.name: cites_exist
nodes.summary: Fails when anything a result cites is absent: a file outside the working copy, a test id whose function is missing or whose file was not in the run set, or a malformed cites field.

nodes.name: result_schema
nodes.summary: Validates the result.json contract: a non-empty summary, a list of artifact paths, and well-formed outward actions of allowed types with text bodies or experiment registrations.

nodes.name: queued_action
nodes.summary: Fails when any outward action the agent claims to have queued does not exist according to the injected lookup.

nodes.name: view.py
nodes.summary: Builds a mission's owner-facing ResultView from its stored rows: the answer (final outputs, or what the mission waits for), the checks performed in plain words, coverage and reviewer comparison, caveats, stopped-step problems, disagreement interpretations, evidence with provenance, cost and the owner's attention. It translates stored internal reasons into plain language and is read-only and clock-free, so two processes render a mission identically.

nodes.name: _said
nodes.summary: Translates one stored reason into plain words through a table of regular-expression patterns, dropping internal notes and translating captured parts in turn.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Returns the rendered default result of a mission return from its built view.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds a mission's ResultView from its plan, runs, events, acceptance evaluation, decisions and verdicts: answer, state, checks, coverage, reviewer comparison, caveats, problems, interpretations, evidence, cost, attention, test counts, standard and failure surfaces.

nodes.name: _surfaces
nodes.summary: Lists each failure surface the steps were challenged on, in plain words and at its worst status across steps, skipping entries outside the current vocabulary.

nodes.name: _text
nodes.summary: Renders an output for a person: text as it is, a file patch as one fenced block per file, a single string field as its value, otherwise indented JSON.

nodes.name: _finals
nodes.summary: Finds the mission's final outputs: each top-level do step's latest output that no other do step consumes, in plan order.

nodes.name: outputs
nodes.summary: Returns each final output of a done mission in full, marking the outputs of an unverifiable result as unverified or as a draft the checks rejected.

nodes.name: _answer
nodes.summary: Composes the answer text: final outputs for a done mission, or what an unfinished mission waits for (clarification, plan, chat writing, approvals, decisions, timers or files), and nothing for a blocked result.

nodes.name: _checks
nodes.summary: Lists the checks actually performed in plain words, with pass counts and set-asides, plus measured requirements of what counts as done.

nodes.name: _coverage
nodes.summary: Rates evidence coverage as Strong, Partial or Weak from output strengths and met requirements.

nodes.name: _agreement
nodes.summary: Computes the reviewer comparison from independent model or person review records: Disagreement, Mixed, Agreement, None ran, or not recorded.

nodes.name: _caveats
nodes.summary: Lists caveats: checks not run or not applicable, work that ran in a reduced way, failures a person set aside, and requirements not established or not met.

nodes.name: _problems
nodes.summary: Builds the problems list: a cancelled mission, each stopped step with its plain reason and stable code, steps stopped for a person said once and first, and a result short of what counts as done.

nodes.name: _disputes
nodes.summary: Turns a pending adjudication between disagreeing checks into two interpretations and the command a person runs to decide.

nodes.name: _evidence
nodes.summary: Lists each do step's latest output with its provenance label and supplier, any reused saved results, and recorded assumptions.

nodes.name: _cost
nodes.summary: Formats the mission's known cost, its unknown or estimated portions and pending reservations as one line of text.

nodes.name: wakes.py
nodes.summary: Records what a waiting workforce mission waits for (a start time, an inbox file, a chat submission, a person's decision or a draft retry) and wakes it in one SQLite transaction under the runner's lease. Wake rows live in a mission_wakes table whose triggers make each wake armed once, ended once and never deleted.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds SQLite DDL with BEFORE UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT triggers that enforce the wake lifecycle inside the database, and moves mission state by compare-and-set so only one of several racing runners can fire a waiting mission.

nodes.name: WaitStale
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a mission's attempts changed while its runner was deciding to wait, telling the runner to look again before arming any wake.

nodes.name: Want
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing what holds one unit back: the wake kind (timer, file, submission, approval or retry), the unit key, and an optional time or file name.

nodes.name: Wakes
nodes.summary: Per-owner store of mission wakes beside the missions database: arms wakes when a mission moves to waiting, reports which are due from the clock, the inbox and recorded decisions, and fires or ends a waiting episode atomically with a single wake event.

nodes.name: workers.py
nodes.summary: Defines workers as bounded execution policies: a WorkerSpec pairs a non-empty (component, op) allowlist with a safety-engine RuntimePolicy that may only narrow the mission's ceiling. Loads worker templates from JSON, validates them field by field, and forms a worker for one unit with a stable SHA-256 digest.
nodes.languageNotes: A NARROWING table holds one comparison per RuntimePolicy field, so a new policy field without a narrowing rule is caught by a test; frozen dataclasses use object.__setattr__ in __post_init__ to normalise fields and store a canonical digest.

nodes.name: narrow
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the ceiling RuntimePolicy carrying the requested values, refusing unknown fields, wrongly typed values or any value that would widen the ceiling.

nodes.name: _template
nodes.summary: Validates one parsed template JSON object (name pattern, purpose, rung, read_only, may_delegate, allowlist and policy fields) and returns a Template, gathering every problem into a single ValueError.

nodes.name: load_templates
nodes.summary: Loads every worker template JSON file from the templates folder, validating each one and requiring the file name to match the template name.

nodes.name: form_worker
nodes.summary: Forms a WorkerSpec from a named template for one unit or probed pair: checks each capability has a ParamContract, keeps read-only workers to read effects, merges forbidden paths and the unit budget, and narrows the policy under the mission ceiling.

nodes.name: WideningRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass raised when a worker asks for more than its ceiling allows or names a policy field that does not exist.

nodes.name: WorkerSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one worker (template, purpose, rung, allowlist, policy, read-only flag); its post-init check enforces a valid rung, a non-empty allowlist equal to the policy's allowed tools and zero write limits for read-only workers, then computes a canonical SHA-256 digest.

nodes.name: Template
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a parsed worker template: name, purpose, rung, read-only flag, optional fixed allowlist, policy overrides and delegation flag.

nodes.name: export_public.py
